Deploy on opponent's side of table; their total battle and duel destiny is +3.

title: Jeroen Webb
lore: Native of Ralltiir. Spy for Ralltiir's underground network after his homeworld was subjugated.
gameText: If deploying to opponent's mobile site, deploys -2 as an Undercover spy. Nevar Yalnal may not target spies here. Opponent's total influence here is -1 for each of your spies at sites.

title: Ki-Adi-Mundi
lore: Cerean Jedi trained by Yoda since the age of four. Only Jedi Council member who is a Jedi Knight. Freed his homeworld from a group of rogues without any bloodshed.
gameText: While Maul present, Ki-Adi-Mundi is Heroic. Obi-Wan's Cape, Obi-Wan's Journal, and [Virtual Set 9] Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Ki-Adi-Mundi. Once per game, may exchange two cards from hand with any one card in Lost Pile.

title: Master Qui-Gon
lore: Jedi Master currently not on the Council. Although he serves the Council well, there have been times when he has defied their wishes to pursue a path he believes is right.
gameText: Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force to opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.

title: Orrimaarko
lore: Dresselian Scout and resistance leader. Worked tirelessly to combat the subjugation of his homeworld before Bothans brought him into contact with the Alliance.
gameText: Once per game, may take a rifle and/or an Interrupt with 'scout' in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Unless Undercover, while alone at an exterior site, opponent's weapon destiny draws here are -2. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Precise Hit
lore: 'Luke, trust me.'
gameText: USED: If you just hit a target with a non-lightsaber non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon, may place target (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn.

title: Rebel Leadership
lore: In times of greatest need, the Rebellion relies on the brilliant leadership provided by commanders fighting for freedom.
gameText: Take an admiral or a non-Jedi general into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Once per game, deploy a war room from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your admiral or non-[Episode I] general is in battle, may add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny (their battle destiny draws may not be canceled).

title: At Peace
lore: To recover from the strenuous Jedi training routine and revitalize the mind and body, an apprentice must rest to be calm and at peace.
gameText: Deploy on Yoda's Hut. You may not deploy [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] cards. May lose 2 Force to cancel an attack. May place [Endor] Leia from hand on bottom of Reserve Deck. May use 1 Force to deploy a Jedi Test from under your Starting Effect. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Red Squadron 7
lore: Incom starfighter flown by Keir Santage. Flew twelve sorties against Imperial shipyards at Fondor.
gameText: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. Once per game may place a non-[Immune to Alter] Effect at same system in owner's Used Pile. Corran Horn and Keir Santage deploy -1 aboard; while either piloting, immune to attrition < 4.

title: Yoda, Senior Council Member
lore: Senior Jedi Council member. Responsible for the early training of Obi-Wan Kenobi. When Qui-Gon brought Anakin before the Council, Yoda voted not to train the boy.
gameText: Deploys only to [Episode I] sites. While at Jedi Council Chamber, immune to attrition, Jedi are deploy -2 here, and (unless a Dark Jedi here) other Jedi may deploy to [Episode I] battleground sites.

title: 3,720 To 1
lore: What are the odds of having a Corellian, a Wookiee and a protocol droid together with an Alderaanian princess who happens to be the daughter of the Dark Lord of the Sith?
gameText: Deploy on table. Droids are destiny +1. Once per turn, may place the bottom 2 cards in Lost Pile out of play to deploy (from Lost Pile) Forced Servitude, a character weapon, a location, or an Effect that deploys on a location (without 'lose' in game text). (Immune to Alter.)

title: At Last We Are Getting Results

titleComponents.name: At Last We Are Getting Results

lore: First sign that your blockade is going well: the Queen's on the comlink.
gameText: If Invasion on table, deploy on table. Maul ignores objective deployment restrictions. Your [Presence] droids are defense value +2. Your starships are deploy -1. Immunity to attrition of opponent's cards is -3. Immune to Alter.

title: Aurra Sing
lore: Bounty hunter. Former student of the Force. After failing her Jedi training, Aurra became known for hunting down and killing Jedi Knights.
gameText: During opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Blown Clear
lore: Vader was nearly killed when Han damaged his TIE fighter during a surprise attack in the Death Star trench.
gameText: Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if an admiral or logistics agenda here, may subtract X from a starship's forfeit and immunity to attrition for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.

title: Bounty
lore: One of the most profitable occupations in the galaxy is hunting down and capturing wanted beings. The more notable the quarry, the more profitable the venture.
gameText: Deploy on a just captured character without a bounty. During your control phase, may transfer captive to a related prison (take this card into hand) to retrieve 4 Force. If released, place captive (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. Your Force drains are +1 here. (Immune to Control.)

title: Colonel Wullf Yularen
lore: Imperial Security Bureau (ISB) officer assigned to brief Tarkin. Also ordered to ensure absolute loyalty to the Emperor. Leader. Will stop at nothing to fulfill Emperor's will.
gameText: Imperial Council Member. Agendas: logistics. ISB Agents are forfeit +1. While at Conference Room with Sim Aloo, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from an opponent's just drawn non-Epic Event destiny.

title: Coordinated Attack
lore: 'Stay in attack formation.'
gameText: USED: If you just hit a target with a non-lightsaber non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon, may place target (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. LOST: Cancel Heroic (and any immunity to attrition) on a character or starship this turn.

title: Crush The Rebellion
lore: After dueling his son and seizing control of a city in the clouds, Vader resumed his quest to destroy the Alliance.
gameText: Deploy on table. May place an Imperial Council Member here from hand. Once per turn, if a general or logistics agenda here, may subtract X from the forfeit and immunity to attrition of a character at a site for remainder of turn, where X = total influence at Conference Room.

title: Changing The Odds
lore: Qui-Gon used his Jedi abilities to insure that there was no 'chance' involved with the use of Watto's chance cube.
gameText: If a player is about to draw destiny for an Epic Event, Interrupt, Objective, or weapon, that player must first activate 1 Force and shuffle their Reserve Deck. OR If both players just drew one battle destiny, cancel and redraw both destiny draws.

title: Dark Jedi Lightsaber
lore: Multifaceted jewels focus light into a deadly blade. Projects a meter-long beam of pure energy. A lightsaber is constructed personally by a Jedi as a part of training.
gameText: Deploy on Aurra Sing or Sidious. May add 1 to Force drain at an [Episode I] site where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Add number of Jedi present. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Daultay Dofine
lore: Neimoidian Trade Federation captain who gained his current position through political backstabbing and family connections. Not favored by Darth Sidious.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Blockade Flagship is immune to attrition < 9. While piloting Blockade Flagship and your [Theed Palace] Admiral's Order on table, Blockade Flagship may not be targeted by weapons or have its power reduced. Once per game, may take Gunray or Haako into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Forced Servitude
lore: The Empire often uses droids for nefarious purposes. Imperials compel droids to do jobs that are repugnant to humans. An automaton has no ethical conscience.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your troopers are Heroic. Opponent's total weapon destiny targeting your Heroic cards is +2. When opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). (Immune to Alter.)

title: I'm Sorry
lore: 'I'm sorry, too.'
gameText: Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control 2 cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. Immune to Alter.

title: Imperial Code Cylinder
lore: Imperial officers are issued coded cylinders which access computer information via Scomp links. Each cylinder is coded to the officer's own security clearance.
gameText: USED: Take Executor: Control Station, Homing Beacon, or Kessel into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If Conference Room on table, deploy Ord Mantell, Death Star: War Room, There Is No Try, and two always [Immune to Alter] Effects (except Endor Shield or You Cannot Hide Forever). Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Janus Greejatus
lore: Imperial council member. Very cruel at heart. Has lusted for power his entire life. Predictable and controllable.
gameText: Agendas: logistics, rule. Once per turn, if at Conference Room and you just drew a non-Epic Event destiny < your total Influence here, may use 2 Force to cancel and redraw that destiny or use 4 Force to add 2 to that destiny.

title: Laser Gate
lore: Security corridors are guarded by a grid of laser emplacements which can be activated upon demand to seal off sensitive areas from intrusion.
gameText: Deploy between two non-exterior Death Star sites. Unless aboard a Lift Tube, for opponent's character to pass opponent must first lose 1 Force. At adjacent sites: weapon destiny draws are -1, your Force generation may not be limited, and opponent's characters are deploy +2.

title: Maneuver Check
lore: 'Luke, at that speed will you be able to pull out in time?'
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, if Alderaan 'blown away,' may target a system; unless opponent has a capital (or [Episode I]) starship there, Objectives treat that system as a Subjugated planet. Starships may not move the turn they are deployed (or carried) to Death Star. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
lore: Spy. Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named 'Arica' in order to sneak into Jabba's palace.
gameText: While Luke or Emperor on table, power +1 and she moves for free. Permanent weapon is •Mara Jade's Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).

title: Obsidian 10
lore: Recalled to defend second Death Star during construction. Stationed aboard Thunderflare.
gameText: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. OS-72-10 deploys -2 aboard. When lost from Endor, a mobile system, or a sector, may place this starship (and cards aboard it) in owner's Used Pile.

title: Chewie, Enraged
lore: Smuggler. Very few people need to be told that angry Wookiees should be given a wide berth.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While present at a site with Han or Leia, Chewie is Heroic and, unless hit, may be forfeited to satisfy all remaining attrition and battle damage against you. Once per game, may take Kashyyyk or Falcon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Officer Evax
lore: This Imperial Intelligence leader has a proven track record for predicting Rebel fleet movements. His coordination of starship maneuvers has saved many vulnerable bases.
gameText: Imperial Council Member. Agenda: logistics. Once per turn, if at Conference Room, may target an opponent's starship on table with power < total influence here. Opponent must use +2 Force to move target (or initiate battle there) this turn.

title: Stinger
lore: Constructed by a secretive Surronian hive craftguild. Equipped with H2-1 hyperdrive system and emergency braking jets. Guri's personal starship. Gift from Prince Xizor.
gameText: May add 1 pilot. Guri deploys -3 aboard. While Guri piloting, during any control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck (if Chewie or Leia on table, Force Pile instead) and immune to attrition < 5.

title: There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement
gameText: Deploy on Conference Room. Revolution is canceled here. You may not deploy aliens (except Mara Jade and bounty hunters), [Episode I] cards, or Luke? Luuuuke!. Emperor and your admirals, generals, and moffs are Imperial Council Members and influence +1. While present, each Imperial Council Member adds one [Dark Side Force]. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take one Laser Gate, an Imperial Council Member, or a Political Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your cards may deploy to table from Political Effects. May place your canceled Political Effect in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)

title: You Want This, Don't You?
lore: 'I can feel the hate swelling in you now...'
gameText: If opponent just drew a card for destiny, deploy on table and stack that card face up here. Opponent may lose 3 Force to take card stacked here into hand; place this card in Used Pile. (Immune to Control.)

title: Commando Training
lore: Han's Rebel strike team on the forest moon of Endor was highly trained in the use of blasters and explosives.
gameText: Deploy on table. Ben Kenobi is deploy +1. Your C-3PO, Lando, and Rebels (except [Death Star II] Jedi) ignore location deployment restrictions (and 'power -1') in their game text and apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location. Once per game, may deploy a [Virtual Set 3] Effect from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Crash Site Memorial
lore: Mos Eisley was built around wreckage of the colony ship Dowager Queen. The wreck remains as a monument where residents leave junk for Jawa scavengers.
gameText: Deploy on table. Dune Sea, Hutt Canyon, Jawa Camp, and Jawa Canyon are deserts. At deserts you occupy with a Jawa, Rontos and Sandcrawlers are power +1 and forfeit +2, and opponent's Force generation is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Debnoli
lore: Good-natured patron of Mos Eisley cantina, until the Empire impounded his starship. Expert marksman. Seeking revenge on the Empire.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While with an Imperial, you may initiate battle here for free. Permanent weapon is blaster rifle (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).

title: Diversionary Tactics
lore: Rebel pilots understand that what they lack in numbers, they must make up for in strategy. They often use diversions to remove dangerous opponents from a conflict.
gameText: USED: Target one piloted starship at a system. That starship is hyperspeed -1 for remainder of turn. LOST: If you have two unique (•) piloted Rebel (or [Republic]) starfighters in battle at a system, draw destiny. Exclude one starship from that battle if destiny < 4.

title: Endor: Ewok Village
locationDarkSideGameText: No starships or vehicles here. If no Ewoks on Endor, Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Non-unique Ewoks are Heroic. While you occupy, gains one [Light Side] icon. No starships or vehicles here.

title: Alderaan (Blown Away)
gameText: May not be deployed if an Alderaan site (or sector) on table. Star Cruisers ignore location deployment restrictions in their game text.
locationLightSideGameText: May not be deployed if an Alderaan site (or sector) on table. Star Cruisers ignore location deployment restrictions in their game text.

title: Perimeter Scan
lore: 'It's a good bet the Empire knows we're here.'
gameText: If two related unique (•) sites are on table, deploy the related system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Peek at a face down card on table. OR If a character or starship's power was just reduced, reset that card's power to its printed power for remainder of turn.

title: Redemption: Command Post
gameText: Light: During your move phase, may relocate your leader here to a site you occupy. Dark: While Redemption is at a system you do not occupy, you may only deploy spies here.
locationDarkSideGameText: While Redemption is at a system you do not occupy, you may only deploy spies here.
locationLightSideGameText: During your move phase, may relocate your leader here to a site you occupy.

title: Through The Force Things You Will See

titleComponents.name: Through The Force Things You Will See

lore: One training exercise for a Jedi's apprentice is to invert one's view to see things from a different perspective. 'The future, the past. Old friends long gone.'
gameText: If you are about to recirculate at the end of your turn, and you have fewer cards in Used Pile than Force Pile, place your Used Pile under your Force Pile instead. OR Place the top card of your Used Pile on top of your Force Pile.

title: Abyss
lore: Careless abuse of the Force by a young Jedi trainee can have dire consequences. When hanging from the weather vane of Cloud City, Luke's balance was his only hope.
gameText: Plays on table. Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) use 1 for your total battle destiny instead. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.

title: AT-AT Deployment Platform
gameText: Dark: May deploy Biker Scout Gear here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Biker Scout Gear is here, 'deploy for free' in its game text may be treated as 'deploy from Reserve Deck for free.' Light: Your characters may enter/exit here for 2 Force each. Unless you occupy, AT-AT's immunity to attrition is +1 (or immune to attrition if non-unique).
locationDarkSideGameText: May deploy Biker Scout Gear here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Biker Scout Gear is here, 'deploy for free' in its game text may be treated as 'deploy from Reserve Deck for free.'
locationLightSideGameText: Your characters may enter/exit here for 2 Force each. Unless you occupy, AT-AT's immunity to attrition is +1 (or immune to attrition if non-unique).

title: Carida: ISB Training Academy
gameText: Light: Imperial Council Members are forfeit +2 here. Immune to Revolution. Dark: Once per game, if opponent just played an Interrupt with 'Rebel' in title, may stack it here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per game, if opponent just played an Interrupt with 'Rebel' in title, may stack it here.
locationLightSideGameText: Imperial Council Members are forfeit +2 here. Immune to Revolution.

title: ComScan Detection
lore: The Imperial Navy boasts the best communications network in the galaxy. Sophisticated control technology allows the Empire to dispatch armed forces without delay.
gameText: If two related unique (•) sites are on table, deploy the related system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Peek at a face down card on table (except a Hidden Base indicator). OR If a character or starship's power was just reduced, reset that card's power to its printed power for remainder of turn.

title: Coruscant: ISB Central Office
gameText: Light: Unless Blount present, Empire's Sinister Agents may not flip. Immune to Revolution. Dark: If your spy here, you may play non-[Virtual Set 8] Interrupts with 'advisor' in title for 1 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: If your spy here, you may play non-[Virtual Set 8] Interrupts with 'advisor' in title for 1 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Unless Blount present, Empire's Sinister Agents may not flip. Immune to Revolution.

title: Dungeon (Prison)
gameText: Dark: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, or a Rebel Base. Whenever you imprison a captive (without a bounty) here, may retrieve 2 Force (once per captive). Light: If you control, instead of Force draining, may release one imprisoned captive here.
locationDarkSideGameText: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, or a Rebel Base. Whenever you imprison a captive (without a bounty) here, may retrieve 2 Force (once per captive).
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, instead of Force draining, may release one imprisoned captive here.

title: ISB Sector Office
gameText: Dark: Your total weapon and battle destiny here is + X, where X = highest printed influence at Conference Room. At related sites, may apply the ability of one Imperial Council Member here toward drawing battle destiny. Light: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk, Ralltiir or Yavin 4.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your total weapon and battle destiny here is + X, where X = highest printed influence at Conference Room. At related sites, may apply the ability of one Imperial Council Member here toward drawing battle destiny.
locationLightSideGameText: May not deploy to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth, Kashyyyk, Ralltiir or Yavin 4.

title: Chasm
lore: At Cloud City, Luke came face to face with his own destiny. Looking into the abyss, he made his decision.
gameText: Plays on table. Substituted battle destinies do not count against battle destiny limits. If all your battle destinies were canceled (and not redrawn) use 1 for your total battle destiny instead. Once per game, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect.

title: Kessel: Spice Mines - Docking Bay
gameText: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force (free if your smuggler present). Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if your smuggler present).
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if your smuggler present).
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force (free if your smuggler present).

title: Kessel: Spice Mines - Extraction Facility
gameText: Light: If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a 'spice' card out of play. Dark: During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a 'spice' card in owner's Used Pile.
locationDarkSideGameText: During your control phase, may use 1 Force to place a 'spice' card in owner's Used Pile.
locationLightSideGameText: If you occupy, may use 3 Force to place a 'spice' card out of play.

title: Kessel: Spice Mines - Prison
gameText: Light: If you control, may release any captives imprisoned here (may retrieve 1 Force for each). Dark: Whenever a droid is imprisoned here, may retrieve 3 Force (once per captive).
locationDarkSideGameText: Whenever a droid is imprisoned here, may retrieve 3 Force (once per captive).
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, may release any captives imprisoned here (may retrieve 1 Force for each).

title: Quietly Observing
lore: Bounty hunters watch from the shadows.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, may deploy Bluffs from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Bluffs gains [Light Side Force] and [Dark Side Force]. Once per battle, may deploy a bluff card (if it is a character or vehicle) as a react. To reveal a bluff card, opponent must first use X Force, where X = 4 - number of bluff cards. Immune to Alter.

title: Ralltiir: Imperial Supply Route
gameText: Light: If you control, opponent's Imperial Supply Route game text is canceled. Dark: Place all devices (and Effects) on your characters just lost from table in owner's Used Pile.
locationDarkSideGameText: Place all devices (and Effects) on your characters just lost from table in owner's Used Pile.
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, opponent's Imperial Supply Route game text is canceled.

title: Watch Your Back!
lore: 'Fighters above you, coming in!'
gameText: Deploy a Virtual Set 13 site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just modified your battle destiny draw, cancel and redraw it (and it may not be modified). OR If opponent just canceled your battle destiny draw, make that destiny = X instead, where X is the number of battlegrounds you occupy.

title: Coruscant: Senate Landing Platform
gameText: Light: Starships may deploy here. Once per turn, may deploy a starship site from Reserve Deck if its starship card is on table; reshuffle. Dark: Unless you occupy, [Virtual Set 9] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them ignores starship and holosite sites.
locationDarkSideGameText: Unless you occupy, [Virtual Set 9] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them ignores starship and holosite sites.
locationLightSideGameText: Starships may deploy here. Once per turn, may deploy a starship site from Reserve Deck if its starship card is on table; reshuffle.

title: Dantooine: Base - Docking Bay
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here is free.

title: Darklighter Spin
lore: Biggs improvised this maneuver shortly after joining the Alliance. By spinning his starfighter while firing all four cannons, he was able to destroy multiple incoming targets.
gameText: Deploy a Virtual Set 13 site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just modified your battle destiny draw, cancel and redraw it (and it may not be modified). OR If opponent just canceled your battle destiny draw, make that destiny = X instead, where X is the number of battlegrounds you occupy.

title: Eyes In The Dark
lore: 'I don't like the look of this.'
gameText: Deploy on a holosite. [Virtual Set 9] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them ignores this site. 'Effect' on Alter may be treated as 'Mantellian Savrip.' The game text of your Effects here may not be suspended. Except during battles here, may play your Interrupts here as if from hand.

title: Jek Porkins
lore: Piloted Red 6 at Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing runs. Served in Tierfon Yellow Aces squadron at Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Free trader from Bestine system.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 6: it is Heroic, immune to attrition < 4, Jek draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and during your control phase, may use 1 Force to retrieve a Rogue squadron pilot or an X-Wing.

title: Lieutenant Williams
lore: Pilot of the Radiant VII. Was personally requested by Captain Madakor to assist in the transportation of the Jedi ambassadors.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Radiant VII, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle at a system, if about to draw a battle destiny here, may instead draw two and choose one; if at opponent's system, may take the other destiny into hand.

title: Outpost
gameText: Light: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Non-Jedi scouts are landspeed +1 when moving from here. Dark: Unless opponent's matching operative is at same or adjacent site, those sites are immune to No Escape.
locationDarkSideGameText: Unless opponent's matching operative is at same or adjacent site, those sites are immune to No Escape.
locationLightSideGameText: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Hoth, Kessel or Tatooine. Non-Jedi scouts are landspeed +1 when moving from here.

title: Admiral Ackbar
lore: Mon Calamari leader of Rebel fleet. Master military strategist. Early prisoner of Grand Moff Tarkin. Convinced his people to join the Alliance.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. It's a Trap! is destiny +2. Adds one battle destiny while piloting a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser. Once per game, may deploy a capital starship to a system (even as a 'react') from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Put That Down
lore: Lord Vader interceded between the trigger happy mercenary and his target.
gameText: If your character or starship is about to be captured or lost during the weapons segment of a battle, it is hit instead and may not be captured or lost until the damage segment. OR If opponent just played an Interrupt during battle, activate 2 Force.

title: Obi-Wan In Radiant VII
lore: Optimized for diplomatic missions with sensor-proof pods that have ejection capabilities. Easily identified by its red coloration.
gameText: May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.

title: Red Leader
lore: X-wing pilot Garven Dreis. Led Red Squadron at the Battle of Yavin, and fired an unsuccessful shot at the Death Star thermal exhaust port. Served at Dantooine Rebel base.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting at Dantooine system, when opponent deploys a character to a related site, they choose: opponent must lose 1 Force. OR that character may not battle or move this turn.

title: Taking Them With Us
gameText: Each player may, once per battle at a system, lose 1 Force to target two participating unique (•) piloted starships with immunity to attrition (one from each player); both starships lose all immunity to attrition this turn. When deploying to capital starships, your Mon Calamari pilots are deploy = 1.

title: Wesa Ready To Do Our-sa Part

titleComponents.name: Wesa Ready To Do Our-sa Part

gameText: Deploy on Endor system or Naboo system. Your total power here is +1 for each Ewok or Gungan at related sites. Once per turn, may place your just lost Ewok or Gungan in Used Pile. Immune to Alter.

title: Yoda, Master Of The Force
lore: Jedi Council member.
gameText: Deploys only to battlegrounds. Power +3 in defensive battles. You may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi. While with a Wookiee, adds one battle destiny. Once per game, may lose 2 Force from Force Pile to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Immune to attrition.

title: Accuser
lore: Modified for optimal crisis response time. Veteran crew experienced at monitoring shipping lanes and Imperial port traffic.
gameText: Deploy -3 if Death Star II on table. May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2. Power and forfeit +1 for each Rebel starship here. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Admiral Ozzel
lore: Leader of the Emperor's Death Squadron assigned to hunt down and crush the Rebellion. As clumsy as he is stupid. Has just failed Darth Vader for the next-to-last time.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a capital starship at a battleground system, in each battle a player's first battle destiny draw may not be canceled or reduced and if opponent canceled a just drawn battle destiny, they lose 1 Force.

title: After Her!
lore: 'This one's a decoy!'
gameText: Plays on table. Unless present at a site, [Reflections III] Leia's game text is canceled. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. Once per game, may take [Virtual Set 3] Astromech Shortage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Black 3
lore: TIE/ln fighter of pilot DS-61-3. Stylized image of Corellian slice-hound painted on inner hatch.
gameText: Heroic. May add 1 pilot. When this starship is targeted by Tallon Roll, 'Rebel' in its game text may be treated as '[Independent Starship]' or '[Republic]'. While DS-61-3 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.

title: Antilles Maneuver
lore: As their war with the Empire continued, Rebel pilots learned ways to counter standard Imperial tactics such as the Tallon Roll.
gameText: For remainder of turn, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon and opponent's starship weapon destiny draws are -1. OR During opponent's deploy phase, [download] a Rebel of ability < 3 (except an admiral) aboard your starship.

title: Captain Yorr
lore: Former member of Imperial Demonstration Team. Flew test flights during development of various TIE prototypes. Jendon's wingman. Has scored 24 combat victories.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if piloting any starfighter). If your starship participating in a battle is about to be excluded (even if that starship may not participate in battle) or made lost by opponent, you may choose for it to be 'hit' instead.

title: Comlink
lore: Hand-held communication device. Military comlinks have scrambling and variable frequency programming for secure communication during battles or emergencies.
gameText: Deploy on an Imperial. While present at a battleground (or deployed on Emperor), Imperials lost from Life Force satisfy an additional 2 Force loss. If Luke deploys using your objective, he deploys to Vader's site (if possible). Once per game, may take Rise, My Friend into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Commander Nemet
lore: ogistics officer for the Avenger, member of the Line Branch of the Imperial Navy. Relays important scanner information to Captain Needa. Fiercely competitive.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting at a battleground system, your Force drains here may not be canceled. While piloting at a system with a 'probe' card, during your deploy phase (or if just forfeited), may be placed as a 'probe' card at any system.

title: Conquest
lore: One of the Imperial cruisers that chased the Millennium Falcon from Tatooine. It scanned the Falcon just before Han punched his starship to lightspeed.
gameText: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles, and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to cancel an Interrupt targeting a starship here. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Death Star Gunner
lore: Most gunners in the Imperial Navy once aspired to be TIE pilots, but lacked sufficient skills to fly starfighters. A few were assigned to the Death Star to man the main artillery.
gameText: While on Death Star: cancels opponent's game text on your non-docking bay Death Star sites, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Dominator
lore: Victory-class hull overhauled with powerful thrusters and latest hyperdrive technology. Engineered to support task forces combating Rebel starfighters.
gameText: Destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. May add 2 pilots, 4 passengers, and 2 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May reveal this starship from hand to place on Used Pile. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Grand Admiral Thrawn
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Your [Independent] starships are lost. Once per turn, if at a system of parsec > 6, may deploy a Dreadnaught here from under your Starting Effect. Once per turn, if opponent's alien at same or related location, may peek at opponent's hand.

title: I Can't Shake Him!
lore: 'You've picked one up... watch it!'
gameText: For remainder of turn, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon and opponent's starship weapon destiny draws are -1. OR During opponent's deploy phase, [download] an Imperial of ability < 3 (except an admiral) aboard your starship.

title: Much Anger In Him
lore: 'Adventure, heh. Excitement, heh. A Jedi craves not these things. You are reckless.'
gameText: Use 4 Force to deploy on opponent's non-droid, non-Jedi Master character (or 2 Force on a Rebel). Character's game text is canceled and they draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Opponent may lose three cards from hand (may not be reduced) to cancel this Effect.

title: Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield

titleComponents.name: Nothing Can Get Through Our Shield

gameText: Starships may not have their deploy costs reduced below their printed deploy costs. During battle, may place 3 Defensive Shields from under your Starting Effect out of play to make your starship immune to attrition this turn. At sites related to systems you occupy, your total battle destiny is +1.

title: Balanced Attack
lore: Alliance starfighter pilots cross-train with other starship types to maximize combat efficiency.
gameText: If your corvette, cruiser, and frigate are in battle together, cancel an opponent's non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. OR Deploy a frigate (deploys -2) from Reserve Deck to same system as your corvette and cruiser; reshuffle. OR Deploy a cruiser (deploys -3) from Reserve Deck to same system as your corvette and frigate; reshuffle.

title: Sith Fury
gameText: USED: If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. LOST: Once per game, use 4 Force to deploy a Dark Jedi from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Trade Federation Tactics
gameText: USED: For remainder of turn, if your starship is about to be hit (or lost), that action may instead affect your character aboard that starship. LOST: If your [Episode I] character is about to be hit (or lost), that action instead affects your other [Episode I] character present.

title: Warrant Officer M'Kae
lore: Hard-working Avenger signal officer. Coordinates and tests tractor beam operations. Apprises Executor of his ship's activities and relays orders from the flagship to his captain.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If your starship is about to be lost, may place devices aboard in owner's Used Pile. Once per turn, may deploy a device that deploys on a starship from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, if just forfeited, may take the bottom card of your Lost Pile into hand.

title: Where Are Those Droidekas?!
gameText: Deploy on table. Scum And Villainy is canceled. Non-unique destroyer droids are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. While all your characters at sites are destroyer droids, opponent's characters are defense value -1 for each destroyer droid present. Immune to Alter.

title: Capital Support
gameText: Starships may not have their deploy costs reduced below their printed deploy costs. During battle, may place 3 Defensive Shields from under your Starting Effect out of play to make your starship immune to attrition this turn. At sites related to systems you occupy, your total battle destiny is +1.

title: General Walex Blissex
lore: Engineer who worked with Jan Dodonna to design the A-wing starfighter. Given honorary rank due to his service to the Rebellion.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a capital starship at a battleground system, in each battle a player's first battle destiny draw may not be canceled or reduced and if opponent canceled a just drawn battle destiny, they lose 1 Force.

title: Lieutenant Blount
lore: Wingman of Colonel Cracken. Spy and scout. Former agent of the Imperial Security Bureau. Defected and joined Rebel Intelligence. Seasoned combat veteran.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Double Agent is a Used Interrupt. Once per game: may take Double Agent into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR if you just targeted with Double Agent, may add 2 to your total destiny. OR may target opponent's bounty hunter with Double Agent instead of their spy.

title: Millennium Falcon
lore: Modified YT-1300 freighter. Owned by Lando Calrissian until won by Han in a sabacc game. 26.7 meters long. 'She may not look like much, but she's got it where it counts.'
gameText: May add 2 pilots. Chewie deploys -3 aboard. If Falcon is about to use hyperspeed, draw destiny; if destiny < 3, hyperspeed = 0 this turn. Immune to attrition < 4 if Han or Chewie piloting (< 9 if both).

title: Mon Calamari Star Cruiser
gameText: For each Imperial starship on table, deploys -1 (to a minimum of 3). May add 5 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 3 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Our Only Hope
gameText: If your [Death Star II] objective on table, USED: Deploy Luke from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR during your move phase, relocate Luke to a site opponent occupies. LOST: If your Rebel of ability > 2 just won a battle or duel, take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (if Rebel is Luke, may also retrieve any one card).

title: Anger, Fear, Aggression
lore: 'The dark side of the Force are they. Easily they flow, quick to join you in a fight.'
gameText: Deploy on table with 12 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Thrice per game, may play a Defensive Shield or deploy (at any time) [Virtual Set 9] The Professor from here (as if from hand). Players do not draw or activate using Drop!. Unless [Virtual Set 15] Knowledge And Defense on table, each time a player attempts to deploy or take a card for free (except their first time per game) they must first use 1 Force.

title: Fixer
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to same site as Camie. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to place a card from Crash Site Memorial in Used Pile. If Crash Site Memorial leaves table (except by your card), place all cards on it in Used Pile.

title: Harvest
lore: 'Harvest is when I need you the most. It's only one season more. This year we'll make enough on the harvest that I'll be able to hire some more hands.'
gameText: USED: Deploy a device from under your Starting Effect. STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, deploy from Reserve Deck a farm, two devices, and two Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.

title: Hidden Base
gameText: Hidden Base: Deploy a battleground system (with Hidden Landing Site there) and Uncharted Settlements. Choose: Rebel/Rebel starship, Alien/[Independent Starship] starship, Republic/[Republic] starship. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except vehicles, Jedi Masters, and the pair you chose. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {While} this side up, once per turn, may deploy from Reserve Deck a Rebel Cell site and/or a character of ability 2 or 3 to a Rebel Cell site; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if you occupy three Rebel Cell sites (and opponent controls no Rebel Cell sites). Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V): {While} this side up, your Force drains are +1 at each battleground system. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at an opponent's location. At Rebel Cell sites, sectors, and each battleground system: your characters of ability < 4, [Hoth] artillery weapons, and starships are immune to attrition < 4 (or add 2 to immunity). Koensayr Manufacturing and Incom Corporation instead affect all your non-unique starships (except squadrons and corvettes) and T-47s. {Flip} this card if opponent controls two Rebel Cell sites.

title: Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers

titleComponents.name: Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers

gameText: Hidden Base: Deploy a battleground system (with Hidden Landing Site there) and Uncharted Settlements. Choose: Rebel/Rebel starship, Alien/[Independent Starship] starship, Republic/[Republic] starship. {For} remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except vehicles, Jedi Masters, and the pair you chose. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {While} this side up, once per turn, may deploy from Reserve Deck a Rebel Cell site and/or a character of ability 2 or 3 to a Rebel Cell site; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if you occupy three Rebel Cell sites (and opponent controls no Rebel Cell sites). Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V): {While} this side up, your Force drains are +1 at each battleground system. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at an opponent's location. At Rebel Cell sites, sectors, and each battleground system: your characters of ability < 4, [Hoth] artillery weapons, and starships are immune to attrition < 4 (or add 2 to immunity). Koensayr Manufacturing and Incom Corporation instead affect all your non-unique starships (except squadrons and corvettes) and T-47s. {Flip} this card if opponent controls two Rebel Cell sites.

title: IL-19
lore: Spy.
gameText: May deploy without presence or Force icons. While at a non-Hoth site, adds one [Light Side Force]. If just forfeited, may use 1 Force to place this droid in Used Pile.

title: Insurrection
gameText: Deploy on table. "Battleground system" on your [Virtual Set 15] objective is treated as "unique battleground site." When targeted by weapons, your characters of ability = 3 may use the defense value of your other character present. Once per turn, may deploy No Disintegrations! from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Alter.

title: Lando Calrissian
lore: Former owner of the Millennium Falcon. Despite a notorious past, has become a successful chief administrator of a Tibanna gas mining facility. Scoundrel and Gambler.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if piloting Falcon). May convert opponent's Lando present at a site. While with Leia, Lando is Heroic. During battle, may use 1 Force to cancel the game text of opponent's character of ability < 5 (or with a [Permanent Weapon]) at same site.

title: Lars' Hydroponics Station
lore: Grows fruits and vegetables. Very efficient water use. Often underground. Feeds moisture farm families, but excess vegetables are often sold at markets.
gameText: Deploy on a farm. During your draw phase, while no 'crop' here, may use 1 Force to stack a 'crop' (any one card from Lost Pile) on this device. While you occupy this site, if any just drawn destiny matches destiny of 'crop', may place 'crop' in your Used Pile.

title: Lars' Vaporator
lore: Essential for life on desert planets. Condenses water vapor from atmosphere. Has purification filters and coolant tanks. Protects against drought and harsh conditions.
gameText: Deploy on a farm. Characters at same site are immune to Sandwhirl. Whenever you are about to activate Force from Beru Stew or Blue Milk, you may first take into hand from Reserve Deck Biggs, Camie, Crell, Fixer, Moisture Farmer, a Lars, or a [Special Edition] Tatooine site.

title: Learn About The Force, Luke
lore: Luke relied on Obi-Wan's knowledge and advice to learn the ways of the Force. Obi-Wan continued to counsel Luke long after the old Jedi's apparent 'death.'
gameText: Deploy on table. Your non-[Jabba's Palace] Interrupts with 'alone' in game text are Used Interrupts, but if played during battle you draw no more than two battle destiny. Wherever you have a card with 'skill' in its game text, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Luke's Hunting Rifle
lore: Czerka 6-2Aug2. Extended barrel provides long-range targeting without expensive laser sight. Sturdy construction, but no match for a Tusken Raider's gaderffi stick.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on Crell, Luke (of ability < 5), or Owen Lars. May target a character or creature using 1 Force. Draw destiny. If destiny + X > defense value, target's power = 0 (lost if a creature), where X = the number of your devices at same and related locations.

title: Alderaan Consular Ship
gameText: May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Opponent must use +2 Force to initiate battle here. Once per game, may deploy a senator aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Melas
lore: Sarkan smuggler. Smokes an Essoomian gruu pipe to heighten awareness. Exiled from his home planet of Sarka for displaying curiosity in other aliens. Misses his homeworld.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'smoke pipe' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; Melas is power and defense value +2, but cannot move this turn (if during your draw phase, may instead peek at the top two cards of any Reserve Deck.)

title: Owen Lars
lore: Guardian of Luke Skywalker. Husband of Beru Lars. Brother of Obi- Wan Kenobi. Farmer of moisture. Disapprover of Luke's desire to leave Tatooine.
gameText: Opponent activates no Force from Beru Stew. While present with Lars' Vaporator: during your control phase, may use 3 Force to exchange one card from hand with one 'crop' card; cards with 'lightsaber' in title may not deploy here.

title: Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site
gameText: Light: Your starfighters may deploy here (for -1 Force), and take off and land here for free. Incom Corporation and Koensayr Manufacturing may deploy here. Dark: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Dantooine, Endor, Hoth, or Subjugated Planet. Rebel Cell sites are immune to Revolution and No Escape. Limit one copy on table.
locationDarkSideGameText: May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Dantooine, Endor, Hoth, or Subjugated Planet. Rebel Cell sites are immune to Revolution and No Escape. Limit one copy on table.
locationLightSideGameText: Your starfighters may deploy here (for -1 Force), and take off and land here for free. Incom Corporation and Koensayr Manufacturing may deploy here.

title: Rebel Cell - Monitoring Station
gameText: Light: Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site. While you occupy, your Force drains may not be modified by opponent's objective. Dark: Unless you control, each of your weapons at Rebel Cell sites may fire only once per battle.
locationDarkSideGameText: Unless you control, each of your weapons at Rebel Cell sites may fire only once per battle.
locationLightSideGameText: Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site. While you occupy, your Force drains may not be modified by opponent's objective.

title: Rebel Cell - Perimeter
gameText: Light: Your [Hoth] artillery weapons at Rebel Cell sites are powered, forfeit +2, fire for free, and are placed in Used Pile when forfeited. Dark: Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site.
locationDarkSideGameText: Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site.
locationLightSideGameText: Your [Hoth] artillery weapons at Rebel Cell sites are powered, forfeit +2, fire for free, and are placed in Used Pile when forfeited.

title: Rebel Cell - Situation Room
gameText: Light: Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site. For each of your characters here, your power is +1 at related system. Dark: For each of your characters here, your power is +1 at related system.
locationDarkSideGameText: For each of your characters here, your power is +1 at related system.
locationLightSideGameText: Deploys only to same planet system as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site. For each of your characters here, your power is +1 at related system.

title: Republic Corvette
gameText: May add 3 Republic pilots and 4 passengers. Quad Laser Cannons may not deploy aboard. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. While with an Imperial-class Star Destroyer, power +1. Has ship-docking capability.

title: Republic Trooper with Blaster Rifle
gameText: Deploys -1 to same site as your Republic leader. Permanent weapon is blaster rifle (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and forfeit -2, if destiny +1 > defense value).

title: Skull
lore: Bidlo Kwerve was involved in both the procurement and (posthumously) the loss of the rancor.
gameText: During opponent's control phase, your pack attacks. Weapons may only target the lead creature. Pack may then move to an adjacent site. OR If a card was just 'eaten,' card's owner loses 2 Force. OR Use 3 Force to retrieve a creature.

title: Talon Karrde
lore: Smuggler and information broker. Operates intelligence network. Pragmatic businessman. Strong sense of personal honor. Bounty placed on his head by Grand Admiral Thrawn.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If your [Virtual Set 15] objective on table: aliens are forfeit +2 at Rebel Cell sites; Yerka Mig may deploy on a Rebel Cell site, ignores Jedi, is Immune to Alter, and for remainder of game, you retrieve Force with it only once per turn.

title: Artillery Remote
lore: Although artillery weapons have a manual firing mechanism, this optional device allows weapons operation from a remote location. Uses coded signals.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on your warrior. Your artillery weapons at same and related sites are Heroic and may be targeted by weapons like a vehicle (use armor = 4). May place this device in Used Pile to add 2 to a just drawn artillery weapon destiny.

title: Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm
gameText: Light: Once per game, may deploy a non-[Reflections 2] Lars here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While a Lars present here with a hydroponics station or vaporator, your Force generation here is +1 (+2 if with both). Dark: While No One To Stop Us This Time on table, Imperials are deploy -1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: While No One To Stop Us This Time on table, Imperials are deploy -1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Once per game, may deploy a non-[Reflections 2] Lars here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While a Lars present here with a hydroponics station or vaporator, your Force generation here is +1 (+2 if with both).

title: Tatooine Utility Belt
lore: Survival gear, food and tools are stored in small compartments. Made from bantha hide. Used by Luke and other Tatooine inhabitants.
gameText: Deploy on Han or a Lars. Character cannot be targeted by [Permanent Weapon] weapons or be captured. If just lost, place this device in Used Pile. Force loss from ...Or Be Destroyed must come from Reserve Deck (if possible) and may not be reduced below 2.

title: Theron Nett
lore: Experienced smuggler from Ord Mantell. Piloted Red 10 at the Battle of Yavin. Long-time wingman of Garven Dreis.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your deploy phase, if piloting Red 10, may target one of your starships; deploy a non-[Theed Palace] astromech or matching pilot aboard target from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Uncharted Settlements
gameText: Deploy on [Virtual Set 15] Hidden Base. [Virtual Set 8] Ellorrs Madak, Organized Attack, S-foils, and Your Destiny (unless you chose Rebel/Rebel Starship) are canceled. You may not deploy operatives or [Virtual Set 6] Rebel Planners. Opponent's combat vehicles, droids, Imperials, and Maul are deploy +2 to Rebel Cell sites. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Wedge Antilles
lore: Highly decorated Corellian. Piloted Red 2 at the Battle of Yavin. A wealthy orphan, he bought a freighter with his inheritance. First joined the Alliance as a weapons smuggler.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Pulsar Skate, it is maneuver +2 and Wedge draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While at Tatooine (or with Booster, Luke, or Mirax), Set For Stun may not target characters here and Overwhelmed may not be played here.

title: Wes Janson
lore: Served for many years as a gunner with friend Jek Porkins in the Tierfon Yellow Aces. Expert marksmanship helped the Alliance earn some of its earliest victories.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 3, it gains [Nav Computer] and Wes draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While aboard a starship or vehicle, its total weapon destiny is +1; if with Jek and it hits a target, opponent loses 1 Force from Reserve Deck.

title: YT-1300 Transport
lore: Reliable and durable, Widely used freighter made by Corellian Engineering Corporation. Sales have dramatically increased in proportion to the fame of Han Solo's ship.
gameText: May add 1 pilot and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. While all your ability is provided by aliens, Jedi, and [Independent] starship pilots, this starship is forfeit +1, maneuver +1, and immune to attrition < 4.

title: Abyssin Ornament & Wounded Wookiee
gameText: USED: Creature attacks at pits are immune to At Peace and Yarna d'al' Gargan until end of your next turn. (Immune to Sense) OR Cancel an attempt to target a rancor with a character weapon. OR Use 1 Force (2 if a rancor on table) to deploy Nal Hutta from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. STARTING: If Great Pit Of Carkoon on table, deploy from Reserve Deck an Effect that is always [Immune to Alter] and choose to deploy from Reserve Deck: Rancor Pit and a rancor there, OR Power Of The Hutt and Sarlacc. Place this Interrupt in hand.

title: Arica
lore: Mara Jade posed as a dancer at Jabba's Palace in an attempt to complete her master's task and kill Luke. Musician. Spy. Unable to convince Jabba to take her on his skiff.
gameText: Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.

title: Bib Fortuna
lore: Twi'lek leader and majordomo of Jabba's palace. Succeeded Jabba's last majordomo, Naroon Cuthus. Plotting to kill Jabba.
gameText: Opponent's non-Jedi characters are deploy +1 to [Jabba's Palace] sites. Once during your control phase, you may place three cards from hand in Used Pile to reveal top card of Reserve Deck; if it is an alien, take it into hand.

title: Artoo
lore: Counterpart to C-3PO. Spy. Obstinate, headstrong and always full of surprises. R2-D2 was an integral part of Luke Skywalker's rescue plans.
gameText: Heroic. Death Star Plans ignores objective game text, but only draws one destiny. Leia may not move (or be carried) the turn she is released. Once per game, may deploy Trash Compactor from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May not be Undercover, 'choked,' or targeted by Emperor.

title: Chokk
lore: Klatooinian bodyguard currently in the paid service of Jabba the Hutt. Chokk takes pride in his work, and he is very good at it.
gameText: Deploys -1 to Tatooine. While with your non-droid character, if a battle was just initiated here, may use 1 Force to place Chokk in Used Pile; Interrupts may not be played until the weapons segment ends.

title: Collateral Damage
lore: Blast vests and helmets with blast shields cannot protect Rebel soldiers from grenades, panel explosions and other combat hazards.
gameText: If you just initiated battle where you have at least two characters (one a trooper and the other a leader), add two battle destiny. Opponent takes no battle damagethis battle. OR Deploy one Dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Cyclone 1
lore: Enclosed armored transport adapted for hot climates by replacing tertiary weapons systems with additional Sienar t23 heat dissipation units.
gameText: Power +1 for each Sandtrooper present. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 2. May add 7 passengers. Once per game, may deploy a vehicle site or vehicle weapon aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Danz Borin
lore: Cocky gunner and bounty hunter. Maintains a residence on Nar Shaddaa, the spaceport moon of the Hutt homeworld. To his companions' delight, he's nearly as good as he boasts.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May add 1 to Force drains at same Nal Hutta location. Danz is a matching pilot for any [Independent Starship] starship and while piloting one, may not draw more than one battle destiny here (your battle destinies here may not be canceled or modified by opponent).

title: Dark Reconnaissance
lore: On her assignment to kill Sharad Hett, Aurra used her patience and cunning to help track down the Jedi Master.
gameText: Deploy on opponent's location. Wherever you have two Mistryl, your Force drains are +1. 'Stolen' on Swilla Corey is treated as 'placed in owner's Used Pile' and it may target a weapon instead of a device. Your Force drains here cannot be modified or canceled by opponent.

title: Devastator
lore: Supported the devastating subjugation of Ralltiir. While under the command of Darth Vader, chased and captured the traitor Princess Leia Organa aboard the consular ship Tantive IV.
gameText: May add 6 pilots and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 1. May follow an opponent's starship that just moved from same system (if within range). Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Dewback
lore: Protected by hard skin composed of tough armored scales. Frequently ridden by sandtroopers stationed in desert environments.
gameText: If just drawn for a non-lightsaber weapon destiny, opponent loses 1 Force. Deploys only to Tatooine. May add 1 'rider' (passenger). Ability = 1/4. During battle, may make a character here defense value -1.

title: Force Push
lore: A fully-trained Sith warrior has more weapons at his disposal than just a lightsaber.
gameText: During battle, use 2 Force to target your Dark Jedi and opponent's character of equal or lesser ability present. Both targets are excluded from battle. OR Exchange two cards from hand with any one card from Force Pile; reshuffle.

title: Gravel Storm
lore: Tatooine's twin suns cause turbulent storms that strike with little or no warning. Strong winds whip rocks through the air with enormous force.
gameText: Lose 1 Force to target a desert or non-interior Tatooine site. For remainder of turn, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.

title: Imperial Detainment
lore: 'There'll be no escape for the princess this time.'
gameText: Deploy on table. We Have A Prisoner is a Used Interrupt. TIEs are deploy +1 to Launch Bay. During your deploy phase, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or retrieve) one Besieged or a Launch Bay; reshuffle. Once per turn, when your Imperial captures a character, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Beru Lars
lore: Wife of Owen Lars and guardian of Luke Skywalker. Quietly lobbied Owen to allow Luke to attend Academy. Maintains Lars' farm hydroponics labs.
gameText: Once per turn, if present at a farm and a destiny was just drawn that is within 1 of the destiny of your 'crop,' may use 1 Force to place 'crop' in Used Pile. Whenever you play Beru Stew or Blue Milk, may draw top card from your Reserve Deck.

title: Imperial Entanglements
gameText: Deploy Tatooine (with Devastator there) and a non-Jabba's Palace Tatooine battleground site. For remainder of game, you may not deploy systems, non-Imperial characters, non-Imperial starships, or Jabba's Palace sites. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy a Tatooine battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Opponent loses no Force to Tatooine Occupation or your Force drains at Tatooine system. Flip this card if you control three Tatooine sites and opponent controls less than three Tatooine sites.

title: No One To Stop Us This Time

titleComponents.name: No One To Stop Us This Time

gameText: While this side up, wherever you have a trooper riding a dewback, add one battle destiny. [Virtual Set 2] Local Trouble may be played at exterior Tatooine sites. Once during your control phase, may peek at the top X cards of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of Tatooine locations you occupy; take one into hand and reshuffle. Opponent's characters require +1 Force to move from Tatooine sites using their landspeed. Flip this card if opponent controls more Tatooine sites than you.

title: Imperial Pilot
lore: Among the Empire's best pilots. Loyal and fearless. Use superior numbers to overwhelm opponents. Trained under combat conditions. Wear sealed, high-gravity flight suits.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Matching pilot for TIE Avenger. While piloting a TIE: it is maneuver +2, it moves for free, and when this character is just lost, may use 1 Force to place her in Used Pile. Corvettes are deploy +1 here.

title: Knowledge And Defense
lore: 'A Jedi uses the Force for knowledge and defense, never for attack.'
gameText: Deploy on table with 12 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Thrice per game, may play a Defensive Shield or deploy (at any time) [Virtual Set 11] Restricted Access from here (as if from hand). Players do not draw or activate using Thrown Back. Each time a player attempts to deploy or take a card for free (except their first time per game) they must first use 1 Force.

title: Let's Pass On That
lore: 'Uu a'kingsa riika pagh bagla bis kachata weenow con bantha poodoo.'
gameText: During opponent's control phase, your ferocious creature attacks. At end of turn, if that creature is at an unoccupied site and did not move, opponent loses 1 Force and you retrieve 1 Force. OR Use 3 Force to retrieve a creature.

title: Look Sir, Droids
lore: Trooper 1124, Davin Felth, discovered droid plating dropped by R2- D2 and C-3PO when exiting escape pod.
gameText: USED: Take into hand from Reserve Deck a non-[Droid with Presence], non-[Permanent Weapon] droid. OR Place a card from hand on Used Pile. STARTING: Deploy from Reserve Deck two Effects which are always immune to Alter. If you have only one location (with < 3 [Dark Side Force]) on table, may deploy from Reserve Deck Central Office or Mos Eisley. Place this interrupt in hand.

title: Maul's Sith Speeder
lore: Attain speeds of up to 600 kph. 3 meters long. Extremely difficult to control at high speeds. Dengar rode a similar swoop when injured in a race with Han at Agrilat.
gameText: May add Maul as driver. May deploy with Maul as a 'react'. During battle, Maul may disembark (place this vehicle in Used Pile) to cancel the immunity to attrition of a Jedi here. Immune to attrition.

title: No Bargain
lore: 'Zeet tu seet. Jabba no tuzindy honkabee.'
gameText: Deploy on your [Reflections II] Objective; 'Xizor' on it (and on Guri) is treated as 'Shada'. Non-[Lightsaber] alien females are Mistryl and Black Sun agents. You may not deploy cards with ability except Mistryl and [Independent] starships. Unique (*) Mistryl (except Kitik) are power +2. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Raider Craft
lore: Modified light freighter. Length 20 meters. Heavily armored for a landing craft. Has ion cannon mounts. Often carries speeder bikes for reconnaissance purposes.
gameText: May add 2 alien pilots, 4 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Any Mistryl or smuggler is a matching pilot (while aboard, adds at least 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise).

title: Sandtrooper
lore: Equipped for harsh, high-temperature environments. Primarily assigned to search-and-destroy missions, but sometimes beaks up local disputes or recover stolen droids.
gameText: Deploys only to Tatooine or any desert. Immune to Sandwhirl. Your desert locations are destiny = 4. While 'riding' a dewback, power +3 and may not be targeted by lightsabers.

title: Scout Mercenary
lore: Opportunists work with corrupt governments and Raithal casino operators. Keep the Empire informed of local Alliance activity, for a price.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots (3 if a speeder bike). During battle, unless Gall on table, may use 1 Force to fire a DH-17 blaster twice (for free), separately or combined. While piloting a vehicle, she may use its defense value and may not go missing (except from your card).

title: Beru Stew
lore: Moisture farmers grow enough food to sustain Tatooine's population. Beru Lars has devised many dishes using herbs and roots naturally found in Tatooine's desert.
gameText: USED: Activate 1 Force (2 if a Lars on table). OR During battle at a farm, add the destiny number of your device on this farm to your total power. LOST: During battle at a farm, after battle destinies are drawn, place a 'crop' out of play to make attrition against you = 0.

title: SD-17 Homing Missile
lore: Originally developed by smugglers and pirates as defense against starfighters. Adapted by the Empire to serve as onboard defense for slow moving bombers.
gameText: Deploy on Boba Fett, Jodo Kast, or your character with a Jet Pack. May place this weapon in Used Pile to target a character or vehicle using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Character lost if destiny -1 > defense value. Vehicle hit if destiny +2 > defense value.

title: Sebulba
lore: Bad tempered Dug from Pixelito. He was about to turn Jar Jar into orange goo, until Anakin intervened.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots. Brisky Morning Munchen is canceled. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per turn, if any podrace total > 0, may take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.

title: Shada
lore: Female spy and thief.
gameText: May deploy Shada and [Virtual Set 15] No Bargain instead of Xizor with your [Reflections II] Objective. While that Effect on table, Force loss from your [Reflections II] Objective is +1 and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force to add a battle destiny anywhere. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Sith Probe Droid
lore: Patrol droids utilized by the Sith. Each droid has several multispectral imaging devices and a communications package. Used by Maul to track down Amidala.
gameText: When drawn for destiny during a battle or duel involving a Dark Jedi, destiny +2. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Dark Jedi (with any captives they are escorting) to same site; place this droid in Used Pile.

title: Stunning Leader
lore: Stormtroopers are trained to stun, not kill, priority targets in order to split enemy forces and hold the leaders for interrogation. Stun effects wear off, requiring efficient action.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) a Mistryl from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your Mistryl present during battle, use 1 Force to reveal the top three cards of opponent's Reserve Deck. Add the destiny number of the highest-destiny male revealed (if any) to your total power. Replace revealed cards.

title: Tatooine: Mos Eisley
gameText: Dark: Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force  Light: Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per turn, when a player's Landing Craft takes off or lands here, that player may retrieve 1 Force
locationLightSideGameText: Immune to Revolution. If a stormtrooper here, you must first use 2 Force to deploy a weapon or device at same or adjacent site.

title: The Mandalorian
lore: Trade Federation.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy Jet Pack on him for free from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. He moves using it for -1 Force. Permanent weapon is Dual Blasters (may lose 1 Force to target a Jedi; until end of turn, choose: target may not fire weapons OR target loses immunity to attrition).

title: Trained In The Jedi Arts
lore: While Qui-Gon spent years maintaining peace, Maul was sharpening his combat skills. Those years of training came to fruition in one fateful moment.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your lightsaber and [Maintenance] cards are lost. 'Vader' on your Interrupts may be treated as 'Maul or Mara Jade.' Wherever you have an Effect with 'skill' in its game text, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Booster In Pulsar Skate
lore: Owned by legendary Terrik family of smugglers. Used to chase down the pirates who killed Wedge's parents. On Corellian Security's most wanted list. 37.5 meters long.
gameText: May add 1 pilot and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Booster, who provides ability of 3. May not be targeted by weapons or Utinni Effects. Once per game, may deploy Mirax here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 5.

title: Brainiac
lore: BoShek nicknamed this male Siniteen 'Brainiac' due to his ability to calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. 'He's the brains, sweetheart!'
gameText: X = Light Side cards in hand. Y = Dark Side cards in hand. If X < Y, your Force generation is +1. If X = Y, adds one battle destiny. Once per turn, if X > Y, may lose a card from hand to make a just drawn weapon or battle destiny = π.

title: Dantooine: Base - Operations Center
locationDarkSideGameText: Your characters are deploy +1 here. While More Dangerous Than You Realize on table, you must control three Dantooine locations to flip it back, and Dantooine system gains one [Dark Side Force].
locationLightSideGameText: Your T-47s may move as a 'react' to Dantooine sites. Rebels are deploy -1 here (-2 if a leader). Immune to Revolution.

title: Bail Organa
lore: Senator from Alderaan. A founder of the Rebel Alliance.
gameText: Agenda: rebellion. Adds one battle destiny with Leia. Your [Coruscant] senators and [Coruscant] Political Effects are lost. While at Senate: unique Rebels of ability < 4 are power +2, and, if opponent just lost Force to a Force drain by a Rebel, may retrieve 1 Force.

title: Supreme Chancellor Palpatine
gameText: Agendas: ambition, order. While on Coruscant, Ambush is a Used Interrupt and, each time you initiate a Force drain with a clone, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. During your turn, may make an additional regular move. Valorum is lost.

title: We Have A Plan
gameText: Deploy Coruscant system (may not be converted) and Blockade Flagship: Prison with Palpatine imprisoned there. May deploy Security Control. For remainder of game, your Force generation is +1 at Coruscant battlegrounds. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, clones are immune to Monnok. While this side up, at Blockade Flagship sites, imprisoned captives may not be transferred. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground site to Coruscant. Flip this card if Palpatine on Coruscant.

title: They Will Be Lost And Confused

titleComponents.name: They Will Be Lost And Confused

gameText: Immediately take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, whenever a card of ability > 2 is lost, its owner loses 1 Force. While you control two battlegrounds with clones, opponent must have two cards with ability (or two [Presence] droids) to initiate a Force drain. Once per turn, may deploy a clone from Lost Pile. Clones are immune to attrition < 4. Flip this card if Palpatine is about to be captured, lost, missing, or removed from table.

title: Bowcaster
gameText: Deploy on your Wookiee. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (may take drawn card into hand). Target hit if destiny + X > defense value, where X = number of Kashyyyk sites you control.

title: Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -2 to Kashyyyk. While stacked on Grrrghrrrgh!, Wookiees are power and forfeit +1. While hit, Chewie's power is doubled. If you have 8 or more cards in hand, add one destiny to total power in any battle involving your Wookiee.

title: Grrrghrrrgh!
gameText: Deploy on table. If your Wookiee just lost, may stack it here. Wookiees are deploy -1, immune to attrition < X and defense value +X, where X = number of cards here. During any battle, may place a card here out of play to add one destiny to total power. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Kashyyyk
locationLightSideGameText: If this was your starting location, once per turn may deploy one Grrrghrrrgh! and/or a site to Kashyyyk from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May not be converted.

title: Kashyyyk: Sacred Forest
locationDarkSideGameText: Unless Mosep on table, Force lost from your Force drains here must come from hand, if possible. While opponent has less than 13 cards in hand, Wookiees are immune to Monnok.
locationLightSideGameText: At start of your turn, may draw a card from top of Reserve Deck for each Kashyyyk site where all your ability is provided only by Wookiees.

title: Kashyyyk: Wookiee Haven (Forest)
locationDarkSideGameText: At end of opponent's deploy phase, if opponent controls this site with at least two Wookiees and has 8 or more cards in hand, lose 1 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Your Force generation is +1 at Kashyyyk sites where you have a Wookiee.

title: Wookiee
gameText: Deploys -1 to Kashyyyk. May move as a 'react.' During battle, if he fires a bowcaster, adds one destiny to your total power. If about to be lost from table, may place any cards on him in owner's Used Pile and may draw top card from Reserve Deck.

title: Wookiee Guide
gameText: Stack a Wookiee from your Lost Pile on Grrrghrrrgh!. OR Deploy a Wookiee stacked on Grrrghrrrgh! to Kashyyyk (as if from hand). OR Once per game, draw X cards from top of Reserve Deck, where X = number of cards stacked on Grrrghrrrgh!.

title: Senator Jar Jar Binks
gameText: Agendas: justice, order. At same and related sites, vehicle weapon destiny draws are -2. Once per turn, may deploy an electropole, a [Coruscant] Naboo location, or a [Theed Palace] vehicle from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If at Senate, may place Jar Jar and a [Coruscant] Political Effect out of play.

title: Wookiee Roar
gameText: If a battle was just initiated involving a Wookiee, add one destiny to your total power (two if alone). That Wookiee is defense value +3 for remainder of turn. OR If you have 8 or more cards in hand, cancel a Force drain.

title: Yarua
gameText: Agenda: taxation. Deploys -2 to Coruscant or Kashyyyk. At end of your deploy phase, if with a Wookiee on Kashyyyk and you have 8 or more cards in hand, opponent must lose 1 Force. Your Wookiees on Kashyyyk move for free.

title: A Jedi's Patience
gameText: USED: If a captive on table, activate 3 Force. LOST: Once per game, if a Dark Jedi present with Leia or a Jedi (even as a non-frozen captive), they duel. Both players draw 2 destiny; add ability. Higher total wins. Loser may not participate in battle or move this turn.

title: Artoo, Brave Little Droid
gameText: May 'fly' (landspeed = 2). Once per game, may target up to two opponent's droids present; owner must place targets in Used Pile or lose 4 Force. While aboard an [Episode I] starship, it is power +3 and immune to attrition < 4.

title: Blue Squadron 5
gameText: Heroic. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield (and/or deploy a weapon on this starship) from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand).

title: BoShek's Modified Light Freighter
gameText: May add 2 pilots. While BoShek piloting: maneuver and hyperspeed +2; immune to attrition < 4; and if at a battleground system, may add 1 to Force drains here.

title: Bravo Fighter
lore: Flown by an unknown pilot who likes to spin a lot. Played the deciding role in the attack against the Droid Control Ship.
gameText: Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. May add 1 astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Immune to attrition < 3.

title: Corellia
locationDarkSideGameText: Each of your starships are hyperspeed +1 when moving from here.
locationLightSideGameText: Once per turn, if you occupy with a Corellian, may activate 1 Force.

title: Corellian Engineering Corporation
lore: Only one of the 'Big Three' starship manufacturers to sell primarily to civilians. CEC employees take great delight in calling their highly modifiable designs 'stock'.
gameText: Deploy on table if [Virtual Set 9] Watch Your Step on table. X = number of spaceport sites controlled by Corellians. While you control Corellia, your total battle destiny is +X, and once per turn, if you are about to lose Force (except from your card), may reduce loss by X. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber
locationDarkSideGameText: If your non-battleground site on table with no related locations (or if you do not control a battleground site), [Virtual Set 9] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them is suspended.
locationLightSideGameText: May not be deployed if your Senate on table. If you just deployed a Jedi Council Member here, may take any one card into hand from Used Pile; reshuffle.

title: Senator Leia Organa
gameText: Agendas: justice, rebellion. When deployed, may play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect (as if from hand). While aboard Alderaan Consular Ship, it is immune to Lateral Damage and attrition. Attrition against opponent is +2 here.
