gameText: If Center Of Tyranny on table, deploy on Coruscant. Once during your control phase, if you occupy Main Power Plant, may draw destiny. If destiny > 5, Planetary Shield 'disabled' (place this device out of play; opponent loses 3 Force). May not be lost.

title: Bacta Infirmary
lore: Medical wonder invented centuries ago by the Vratix insectoid species. Gelatinous red bacta is suspended in a synthetic solution to create a healing bacterial medium.
gameText: If Center Of Tyranny on table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and, if just lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any character from here into hand. [Immune to Alter.]

title: Use The Force
lore: 'Use the Force. Yes... Now, the stone. Feel it.'
gameText: Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = number of cards stacked on Communing: Peek at the top card of any deck or pile; may then shuffle it. OR Draw 2 cards from Reserve Deck. OR Retrieve 1 Force. OR Activate X Force. OR Your next destiny draw this turn is +X.

title: The Shield Is Down!
lore: Lando's confidence in the Rebel strike team on the forest moon was rewarded, and proved to be a decisive factor at the Battle of Endor.
gameText: If [Virtual Block 7] Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Your [Endor] Epic Event total is +1 for each of your non-Jedi scouts at Bunker. For each of your non-Jedi scouts in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. While opponent's [Endor] objective on table, Bunker may not be converted. Once per turn may take Bunker into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Coruscant: Lower Levels
gameText: Light: If your Insurgent present, Force drain +1 here. Dark: Characters of ability > 4 are defense value -1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Characters of ability > 4 are defense value -1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: If your Insurgent present, Force drain +1 here.

title: Coruscant: Main Power Plant
gameText: Light: Attempts to 'disable' the Planetary Shield are +2 for each Rogue Squadron pilot here. Dark: While Center Of Tyranny on table, you generate no Force here.
locationDarkSideGameText: While Center Of Tyranny on table, you generate no Force here.
locationLightSideGameText: Attempts to 'disable' the Planetary Shield are +2 for each Rogue Squadron pilot here.

title: Coruscant
gameText: LIGHT: If just converted, may raise this system to the top. DARK: If your Coruscant system was converted, your Force generation is +1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: If your Coruscant system was converted, your Force generation is +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: If just converted, may raise this system to the top.

title: Center Of Tyranny
gameText: Center Of Tyranny: Deploy [Virtual Block 7] Coruscant, Main Power Plant, Lower Levels, Planetary Shield, and Rogue Insertion. For remainder of game, Rogue Squadron pilots are Insurgents and may fire blasters for free. Your destiny draws for [Virtual Block 1] Sabotage are -1 and may not be further reduced. Your characters of ability > 4 are deploy +4. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to deploy a Coruscant battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Planetary Shield 'disabled.' A Liberated World: Immediately retrieve into hand (or take from Reserve Deck; reshuffle) any one card. While this side up, '1' on Declaration of Rebellion is treated as '2'. Your Force generation at Coruscant system is +2. While you occupy a system, your Force drains are +1 at each related battleground site you control with a Rogue Squadron pilot. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a starship from a system, you may lose 1 Force to steal it into hand. Once during your turn, if you just forfeited a Rogue Squadron pilot, may use 1 Force to take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: A Liberated World
gameText: Center Of Tyranny: Deploy [Virtual Block 7] Coruscant, Main Power Plant, Lower Levels, Planetary Shield, and Rogue Insertion. For remainder of game, Rogue Squadron pilots are Insurgents and may fire blasters for free. Your destiny draws for [Virtual Block 1] Sabotage are -1 and may not be further reduced. Your characters of ability > 4 are deploy +4. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may use 1 Force to deploy a Coruscant battleground site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Planetary Shield 'disabled.' A Liberated World: Immediately retrieve into hand (or take from Reserve Deck; reshuffle) any one card. While this side up, '1' on Declaration of Rebellion is treated as '2'. Your Force generation at Coruscant system is +2. While you occupy a system, your Force drains are +1 at each related battleground site you control with a Rogue Squadron pilot. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a starship from a system, you may lose 1 Force to steal it into hand. Once during your turn, if you just forfeited a Rogue Squadron pilot, may use 1 Force to take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Rebel Strike Team
gameText: Rebel Strike Team: Deploy Endor system, Back Door, and [Virtual Block 7] The Shield Is Down!. For remainder of game, your [Episode I] characters and [Virtual Block 3] rifles are lost. Your Force generation is +1 at your Endor sites. May use 1 Force to take an [Endor] Epic Event into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, your Force drains on Endor are -1. Your Bunker gains one [Light Side Force]. If you occupy Bunker at the end of a battle you just won there, may use your [Endor] Epic Event to attempt to 'blow away' Bunker. Flip this card if Bunker 'blown away.' Garrison Destroyed: While this side up, Endor Shield is canceled. May raise your converted Endor to the top. If Establish Secret Base on table, Force generation at Endor locations may not be canceled. At Endor sites you occupy with a scout, your Force drains may not be modified by opponent. Whenever you initiate a battle with a scout, may retrieve 2 Force. Once per game, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or deploy from hand) a Rebel starship for half its printed deploy cost (round down); reshuffle.

title: Garrison Destroyed
gameText: Rebel Strike Team: Deploy Endor system, Back Door, and [Virtual Block 7] The Shield Is Down!. For remainder of game, your [Episode I] characters and [Virtual Block 3] rifles are lost. Your Force generation is +1 at your Endor sites. May use 1 Force to take an [Endor] Epic Event into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, your Force drains on Endor are -1. Your Bunker gains one [Light Side Force]. If you occupy Bunker at the end of a battle you just won there, may use your [Endor] Epic Event to attempt to 'blow away' Bunker. Flip this card if Bunker 'blown away.' Garrison Destroyed: While this side up, Endor Shield is canceled. May raise your converted Endor to the top. If Establish Secret Base on table, Force generation at Endor locations may not be canceled. At Endor sites you occupy with a scout, your Force drains may not be modified by opponent. Whenever you initiate a battle with a scout, may retrieve 2 Force. Once per game, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or deploy from hand) a Rebel starship for half its printed deploy cost (round down); reshuffle.

title: IG-100 MagnaGuard
gameText: Shockstaff deploys and fires for free on this droid. While on Blockade Flagship or Coruscant (or with Grievous), this droid is Heroic and power +2. Your characters here are immune to Ambush, Clash Of Sabers, and attrition < 4.

title: ISB Sector Commander
lore: ISB leader.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, when deployed, may retrieve up to two Imperials (or one into hand). While present at a site you control, Effects with 'Celebration' in title at related system are suspended and, once per turn, may use 1 Force to deploy a trooper from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Moruth Doole, Kessel Administrator
gameText: Deploys -1 to Kessel. While at a Kessel battleground site, your Force drains are +1 at X related locations, where X = number of 'spice' cards on Spice Mine Operations, and once per turn, may use 3 Force to take a 'spice' card you own into hand.

title: Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man

titleComponents.name: Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man

lore: You should not have come back.
gameText: USED: Cancel an attempt to remove a just-lost character from owner's Lost Pile (unless it is being placed out of play or retrieved). LOST: If you just deployed a character to same site as a Jedi, take any one card from your Used Pile into hand; reshuffle.

title: Grievous' Lightsabers
gameText: Deploy on Grievous. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not satisfy attrition (or be removed from Lost Pile this turn), if total destiny > defense value.

title: Sidious' Lightsaber
gameText: Deploy on Sidious (even as a 'react'). While at a battleground site, adds one [Light Side]. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not satisfy attrition (or be removed from Lost Pile this turn), if total destiny > defense value.

title: Combined Fleet Action
gameText: Unique (•) starfighters are immunity to attrition +2 for each non-unique starship of their class present with them. Unique (•) capital starships are defense value +1 for each non-unique starship present at same system. For each of your unique (•)/non-unique starship pairs of the same class present at same system, your battle destiny draws there (and at related sites) are +1.

title: Booster Terrik
lore: Corellian information broker.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Starships here with a Rogue Squadron pilot aboard may move as a 'react.' Star Destroyers he pilots are hyperspeed +2. Unless Corellia on table, once per game, may steal an Imperial-class Star Destroyer from opponent's Lost Pile into hand.

title: Mace Windu, Master Of The Order

titleComponents.name: Mace Windu, Master Of The Order

lore: Senior Jedi Council member who maintains rigorous adherence to the Code. Sent Qui-Gon to Naboo to accompany the Queen and learn more about the mysterious 'dark warrior'.
gameText: * = 1 or number of Jedi on table (to a maximum of 3), whichever is higher. Mace's forfeit may not be reduced and his total weapon destiny is +1. If a Dark Jedi was just lost from table, may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to attrition.

title: Artoo & Threepio
lore: Threepio's extensive experience 'talking' to the Falcon's computer allowed him to pilot the freighter while on Coruscant. Artoo, an R-unit droid, provided moral support.
gameText: When deployed, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. Unless hit, may re-target a weapon targeting Chewie, Leia, or Luke (of ability < 5) to this droid (targeting may not be canceled). If this droid was just forfeited during opponent's turn, may take it into hand.

title: Motivator
gameText: Deploy on your non-[Reflections 2] astromech droid. Droid is power +2, gains [Presence Droid], and if present at a site, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During any move phase, may place this device in Lost Pile to [upload] one What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? or R2-D2.

title: Hindsight
lore: "I'm backwards! You fleabitten furball...only an overgrown mophead like you would be stupid enough—"
gameText: Unless Imperial Atrocity on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 6 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Control. OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack one just-played Interrupt here.

title: Rebel Sacrifice
lore: 'You can't win Darth. If you strike me down I shall become more powerful than you can possibly imagine.' Obi-Wan's sacrifice gave the Rebels time to escape.
gameText: Deploy on table if Obi-Wan 'communing.' 'Tatooine' on Obi-Wan is treated as 'Death Star.' Your Death Star sites gain one [Light Side], and if opponent loses Force to battle damage (or a Force drain) at such sites, stack the first card lost face-down here. Attack Run is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)

title: OOM Command Battle Droid
lore: Commander. Leader.
gameText: [Pilot] 2: any vehicle. While piloting a [Theed Palace] vehicle at a battleground site, adds one [Dark Side] and may add 1 to your Force drains here. Once per game, may [upload] a card with 'fire' in title.

title: Temporary Foothold
lore: Echo Base heavy weapons units provided covering fire, allowing Alliance personnel to escape Hoth.
gameText: Deploy on a battleground. While you occupy at least two battlegrounds, your Force drains here may not be canceled. During battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile to draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck.

title: Lucky Shot
lore: AT-ATs are nearly impervious to infantry fire, but occasionally a blaster bolt hits between the plating. It's one shot in a million, but such odds are a familiar to the Rebellion.
gameText: If opponent's Effect of any kind was just lost or canceled due to its own game text, place it out of play. OR Until end of turn, Do They Have A Code Clearance? may not modify forfeit. OR Cancel Close Call. OR Cancel Outflank (you may activate 1 Force).

title: Yavin 4
gameText: Light: Once per game, if a Critical Mission here, may deploy an Effect on Yavin 4 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Dark: Yavin 4 and starships here are immune to Lateral Damage.
locationDarkSideGameText: Yavin 4 and starships here are immune to Lateral Damage.
locationLightSideGameText: Once per game, if a Critical Mission here, may deploy an Effect on Yavin 4 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Baktoid Armor Workshop
lore: Once begun, the occupation of Naboo was swift, and devastatingly effective.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your [Theed Palace] vehicles are defense value and immunity to attrition +1. May [download] Deployment Orders. Once per game, if Deployment Orders on table, may [download] an exterior battleground site not on table. Once per game, may retrieve a [Theed Palace] vehicle into hand. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Tibanna Floating Refinery
lore: Refines Tibanna gas at mines like those at Cloud City. Also used for moisture collection on dry planets.
gameText: Deploy on a cloud sector. Your Force generation is +1 at cloud sectors you occupy. Once during your control phase, if you occupy this sector and a battleground site, may draw destiny. If destiny > 2, retrieve 1 Force. If lost from table, place this Device in Used Pile.

title: Desperate Counter
lore: The Empire relied on the skill of its pilot corps to defend the Death Star reactor core from attack.
gameText: Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may [upload] any one card. [Immune to Control.] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack a just-played Interrupt here.

title: Occupied Territory
lore: 'I advise everyone to leave before more Imperial troops arrive.'
gameText: Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).

title: Shadows Of The Empire
lore: Imposing. Ominous. Intimidating. Instrument for the evil Emperor's sinister reach across the galaxy. Used on a secret frequency of the Imperial HoloNet.
gameText: Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game, may [upload] Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to [download] Imperial Square, and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter.]

title: Where Are You Taking This ... Thing?

titleComponents.name: Where Are You Taking This ... Thing?

gameText: If opponent just drew destiny for Nabrun Leids (or removed a just-lost character from Lost Pile), deploy on table and stack that card here face down. Elis Helrot and Nabrun Leids are canceled. Opponent may use 2 Force to place card stacked here in Used Pile. (Immune to Control.)

title: Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin
lore: On her assignment to kill Sharad Hett, Aurra used her patience and cunning to help track down the Jedi Master.
gameText: Once per game may deploy a device on Aurra from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle: it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 while armed with a rifle).

title: Death Mark & Hutt Bounty
gameText: If on the Hunt on Table, deploy on a 'mark' (opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site). Target an assassin at another site. During any move phase, when reached by target, draw destiny and add target's power; opponent draws two destiny (choosing one) and adds 'mark's defense value. If your total is higher, the 'mark' is 'assassinated': opponent loses 2 Force (4 if a Jedi), the 'mark' is lost, and relocate Death Mark to your side of table. Otherwise, place Death Mark (and may place assassin it targets) in Used Pile. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Join Us Or Die
lore: Vader had to show Luke that giving in to the dark side of the Force was his only destiny.
gameText: Deploy on your Throne Room. While Emperor and Vader here, Take Your Father's Place does not deplete Life Force or cause Force loss. Once per turn, may ▼ So Be It, Jedi or a docking bay. 'Battle' on Insignificant Rebellion is treated as 'battle or duel.' (Immune to Alter.)

title: On The Hunt
lore: Blank.
gameText: Deploy on Contract Killers. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. At end of opponent's turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

title: The Inner Circle
lore: Imperial officers aboard the Death Star considered the Rebellion a minor threat.
gameText: Deploy on Conference Room (only at start of game); deploy Sim Aloo here and [Virtual Block 4] There is No Try from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Players may initiate battle here for free. Once per game may deploy Ord Mantell from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May not be canceled (except by opponent) or placed in Used Pile. Immune to Ineffective Manuever.

title: Well Guarded
lore: Most of Jabba's guards had been sold to the Hutt and were too scared (or too dumb) to leave. Jabba assigned his best guards to watch over his most prized possessions.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (while you have < 13 cards in hand), The Camp, and deployment costs on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Abyssin Ornament
lore: The Abyssins are known for their regenerative abilities. Jabba keeps several statue heads of Abyssin creatures on his repulsor sled.
gameText: USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by a non-droid assassin) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just-lost non-droid assassin into hand.

title: Give Yourself To The Dark Side

titleComponents.name: Give Yourself To The Dark Side

gameText: If Bring Him Before Me on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. A Powerful Ally: While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.

title: Bespin
gameText: Dark: Once per game may deploy Executor here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While I'm Sorry on table (and A Sith's Plans is not), Executor is deploy = 8. Light: May not be converted. Immune to Revolution. If you control, your characters deploy -1 to related locations.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per game may deploy Executor here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While I'm Sorry on table (and A Sith's Plans is not), Executor is deploy = 8.
locationLightSideGameText: May not be converted. Immune to Revolution. If you control, your characters deploy -1 to related locations.

title: Bane Malar, Spice Addict
lore: Black Sun agent, assassin and bounty hunter.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR Peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile where X = number of characters here.

title: Coruscant: Casino
gameText: Dark: Once per turn, an assassin here may place a 'reputation' here in your Used Pile. Light: Assassins, gamblers, scoundrels, smugglers, spies, and thieves are forfeit + 1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per turn, an assassin here may place a 'reputation' here in your Used Pile.
locationLightSideGameText: Assassins, gamblers, scoundrels, smugglers, spies, and thieves are forfeit + 1 here.

title: Coruscant: Sub City Lair
gameText: Dark: During your move phase, may relocate an assassin here to a site you occupy as a regular move. Light: Unless your spy present, Force drain -1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: During your move phase, may relocate an assassin here to a site you occupy as a regular move.
locationLightSideGameText: Unless your spy present, Force drain -1 here.

title: Contract Killers
gameText: Contract Killers: Deploy Coruscant system, Sub City Lair and On The Hunt. For remainder of game, Aurra, Galen, Mara, and your aliens with 'plotting to kill Jabba' in lore are assassins. Your cards with ability are deploy +3 except assassins and [Independent] starships. Characters add 1 to their Death Mark total for each weapon or device they carry. Once per turn, may ▼ a Coruscant battleground. Flip this card if assassins control two battlegrounds (unless opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site) or a [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark attempt is made. Feared Throughout The Galaxy: While this side up, during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force. If two assassins (except Galen) are in battle, add one battle destiny. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a character, an assassin there may gain 'reputation;' retrieve any one card (may only be canceled by Aim High) and stack it face down on that assassin. Assassins with 'reputation' may add 1 to Force drains where present. Flip this card at the end of any turn if opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site (unless [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is on your side of the table).

title: Feared Throughout The Galaxy
gameText: Contract Killers: Deploy Coruscant system, Sub City Lair and On The Hunt. For remainder of game, Aurra, Galen, Mara, and your aliens with 'plotting to kill Jabba' in lore are assassins. Your cards with ability are deploy +3 except assassins and [Independent] starships. Characters add 1 to their Death Mark total for each weapon or device they carry. Once per turn, may ▼ a Coruscant battleground. Flip this card if assassins control two battlegrounds (unless opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site) or a [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark attempt is made. Feared Throughout The Galaxy: While this side up, during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force. If two assassins (except Galen) are in battle, add one battle destiny. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a character, an assassin there may gain 'reputation;' retrieve any one card (may only be canceled by Aim High) and stack it face down on that assassin. Assassins with 'reputation' may add 1 to Force drains where present. Flip this card at the end of any turn if opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site (unless [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is on your side of the table).

title: Mara Jade's Lightsaber
lore: As part of her training to become the Emperor's hand, Mara Jade learned from Palpatine himself how to effectively fight with a lightsaber.
gameText: Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Chewbacca, Walking Carpet
lore: Wookiee scoundrel.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 Force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, may target a just-hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.

title: Han Solo, Innocent Scoundrel
lore: 'Well, that was a long time ago. I'm sure he's forgotten about that.' Since he needed Calrissian's help, Han regretted having introduced Lando to the Tonnika sisters.
gameText: Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle, Han may fire a [Virtual Block 8] blaster twice. Once per turn, if opponent is about to draw a weapon destiny targeting Han, they draw two and you choose one. Immune to attrition < 3 (<4 if armed).

title: Kyle Katarn
lore: Scoundrel.
gameText: May use any stolen weapon. Opponent may not 'react' to or from same site. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each [Scoundrel] Effect on table. Once per game, may make a regular move during your control phase. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if armed).

title: Het Nkik
lore: Jawa scout. Wants to avenge deaths of relatives killed in stormtrooper assault on sandcrawler. Reegesk pilfered the powerpack from his blaster at a critical moment.
gameText: Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = number of deserts you control with a Jawa.

title: Supreme Chancellor Valorum
lore: Although Finis Valorum maintains the Galactic Senate's ultimate title, his real power is mired by endless bureaucracy, petty corruption, and incessant plotting.
gameText: Agenda: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 (and gain [Republic]) here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'governor,' 'political,' or 'Valorum' in lore.

title: Imperial Navigation Charts
gameText: Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, 'steal' this Effect (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Redeemed Apprentice
lore: 'I know there is good in you. The Emperor hasn't driven it from you fully.'
gameText: If you just forfeited a character (or opponent just drew destiny for Elis Helrot) deploy on table. Whenever you must lose Force from a [Virtual Block 4] objective targeting your non-Jedi character, reduce loss by 1. Elis Helrot and Nabrun Leids are canceled. (Immune to Control.)

title: Scoundrel's Bravado
gameText: Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Scoundrel (or starship they pilot) is defense value +2 and immune to attrition <5 (or adds 2 to immunity). Once per turn may lose 1 Force to add a battle destiny anywhere (you draw no more than two battle destiny there).

title: Scoundrel's Charm
lore: Sarcastic. Sardonic. Irreverent. Impertinent. Exasperating. Disrespectful. Outrageous and charming. Han was a scoundrel but Leia began to realize that she loved him.
gameText: Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from opponent's just-drawn destiny.

title: Scoundrel's Ingenuity
gameText: Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Scoundrel is power +2 and his total weapon destiny is +1. During your control phase, may draw destiny. If destiny > 3, your Force drains at same and related locations are +1 for remainder of turn.

title: Scoundrel's Luck
gameText: Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here. Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Nar Shaddaa: Scoundrel's Rest
gameText: Light: Characters (except bounty hunters and scoundrels) are deploy +1 to Nar Shaddaa. Dark: If you occupy, opponent's game text here is canceled.
locationDarkSideGameText: If you occupy, opponent's game text here is canceled.
locationLightSideGameText: Characters (except bounty hunters and scoundrels) are deploy +1 to Nar Shaddaa.

title: Bossk With Mortar Gun
lore: Trandoshan assassin and slaver.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each 'hit.' Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number).

title: Nar Shaddaa: Undercity Street
gameText: Light: Scoundrels may move to or from here using landspeed for free. Dark: Force drain -1 here unless your assassin, bounty hunter, or thief present.
locationDarkSideGameText: Force drain -1 here unless your assassin, bounty hunter, or thief present.
locationLightSideGameText: Scoundrels may move to or from here using landspeed for free.

title: Nar Shaddaa: Undercity
gameText: Light: Scoundrels Guild is immune to No Escape and your Force generation there is +1. Dark: Bounty hunters on Nar Shaddaa are power +1.
locationDarkSideGameText: Bounty hunters on Nar Shaddaa are power +1.
locationLightSideGameText: Scoundrels Guild is immune to No Escape and your Force generation there is +1.

title: Tatooine: Jawa Camp
gameText: Light: Your non-unique Jawas deploy for 1 Force from you only. Your deserts gain one [Light Side Force]. Dark: If you control, opponent's Jawas and Sandcrawlers are power and forfeit -1.
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, opponent's Jawas and Sandcrawlers are power and forfeit -1.
locationLightSideGameText: Your non-unique Jawas deploy for 1 Force from you only. Your deserts gain one [Light Side Force].

title: Yavin 4: Massassi War Room
gameText: Light: Once per game, may deploy Rebel Aces from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) and/or exchange a card in hand with top card of Force Pile. Dark: You lose no more than 2 Force from Force drains at non-liberated systems.
locationDarkSideGameText: You lose no more than 2 Force from Force drains at non-liberated systems.
locationLightSideGameText: Once per game, may deploy Rebel Aces from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) and/or exchange a card in hand with top card of Force Pile.

title: Infiltration
gameText: Infiltration: Deploy Nar Shaddaa, Undercity and Scoundrel's Luck. For reminder of game, your gamblers, information brokers, and spies are scoundrels. You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. 'Luke' on opponent's [Reflections II] objective is treated as 'Kyle Katarn.' Once per turn, may deploy a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to take Imperial Navigation Charts into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.' Unlikely Allies: While this side up, your scoundrels are forfeit +1. Your Force generation is +1 for each battleground you occupy with a scoundrel (to a maximum of +2). 'Once' on Scoundrel's Luck is treated as 'twice.' During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand in your Used Pile or Lost Pile, shuffle that pile and take the top card into hand. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is not on table (unless you have completed a [Virtual Block 8] Kessel Run).

title: Unlikely Allies
gameText: Infiltration: Deploy Nar Shaddaa, Undercity and Scoundrel's Luck. For reminder of game, your gamblers, information brokers, and spies are scoundrels. You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. 'Luke' on opponent's [Reflections II] objective is treated as 'Kyle Katarn.' Once per turn, may deploy a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to take Imperial Navigation Charts into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.' Unlikely Allies: While this side up, your scoundrels are forfeit +1. Your Force generation is +1 for each battleground you occupy with a scoundrel (to a maximum of +2). 'Once' on Scoundrel's Luck is treated as 'twice.' During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand in your Used Pile or Lost Pile, shuffle that pile and take the top card into hand. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is not on table (unless you have completed a [Virtual Block 8] Kessel Run).

title: Errant Venture
gameText: May add 6 pilots. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Unless your [Reflections II] objective on table, once per game may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] scoundrel aboard and while Corran or a Terrik piloting, immune to attrition < 7.

title: Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized
gameText: Deploy on Han. I've Got A Bad Feeling About This is canceled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, its forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.

title: Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle
lore: BlasTech E-11 blaster rifle. Standard issue for Imperial forces. So numerous that many have been stolen by Rebels. Extendable stock. Carries energy for 100 shots.
gameText: Deploy on Kyle Katarn. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (two if Scoundrel's Luck on table). Character or creature hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. Vehicle hit if total destiny -2 > defense value.

title: Jawa Ion Gun
lore: Cobbled-together weapon built from salvaged power cells, droid restraining bolts and an ion accelerator. Fires a stream of ion energy that stuns droids and irritates others.
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on your Jawa. May target a character or vehicle. Draw destiny. Vehicle hit and power = 0, if destiny + X > defense value, where X = the number of Jawas present. Character excluded from battle if destiny = defense value.

title: R'tic H'weei
lore: Jawa.
gameText: Once per game, may ▲ Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.

title: Jet Pack
lore: Mitrinomon Z-6 jet pack. Exhaust vents are used to maneuver in midflight. Gyro-stabilizer automatically applies counterthrust when landing.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free on Jodo Kast or any Fett). Character 'flies' (landspeed = 3 and maneuver = 6), may fire weapons for free, and may move as a 'react' for +1 Force.

title: Chevin
lore: Most Chevin are mercenaries, gun runners and slavers. Have strong communities on their homeworld. Wear clothing only because others do.
gameText: When deployed, may use 1 Force to take a non-unique Trandoshan into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Power +1 while your other slaver present. While in battle at a site with two other slavers, may place this character out of play to satisfy all remaining attrition against you.

title: Assassin's Blaster Rifle
gameText: Deploy on an assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.

title: Anakin Solo
lore: Padawan.
gameText: Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once during battle, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).

title: Vilmarh 'Villie' Grahrk
lore: Devaronian gambler. Smuggler.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While present at Audience Chamber or stacked on your Objective: non-unique Devaronians are deploy -1, power and forfeit +1, and if Yerka Mig is about to be lost, may place it in Used Pile instead.

title: Captain Verrack
lore: Mon Calamari computer technician. Expert in power systems. His skills are desperately needed by Rebel fleet. Gunner.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard your starship, its total weapon destiny is +1. Whenever you hit a starship here, opponent loses 1 Force. During battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel [Coruscant] Watch Your Back!.

title: Loje Nella
lore: Accountant. Descended from a species of cliff boring worms. Reluctant assistant to Mosep. Purposefully mismanages funds to obstruct Jabba's nefarious activities.
gameText: May lose 2 Force to cancel Cold Feet if targeting Bo Shuda. While four or more cards are stacked on I Know That Laugh and/or your Objective, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. If you just Force drained with an alien, may activate 1 Force.

title: Rennek
lore: Nerf herder. Personally oversees the herding of Jabba's nerfs. Scruffy-looking appearance conceals his expertise in unusual combat techniques.
gameText: May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.

title: A Remote Planet
lore: In unfamiliar and potentially hostile territory, Qui-Gon knew that success would require patience and caution.
gameText: Deploy on The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone; treat "4" on it as "2." Your Force generation at City Outskirts is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (and/or their matching weapon). (Immune to Alter.)

title: I Know That Laugh
lore: Jabba's decadent behavior makes him susceptible to deception. Leia and Lando exploited this weakness, posing as Jabba's kind of scum.
gameText: If Agents In The Court on table, deploy on table. While you have < 13 cards in hand, non-unique aliens are immune to Monnok. For each of your aliens in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. If your alien was just lost from a location, may stack it here face down. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Corellian Slip
lore: First perfected by Corellian starship battle tacticians, this dangerous counter-maneuver has saved numerous hot-shot pilots in life-or-death situations.
gameText: Use 2 Force to take an Interrupt from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel an attempt to target your starfighter with Tallon Roll (or a weapon) Starfighter is protected from further attempts for remainder of turn. OR Cancel [Coruscant Icon] Watch Your Back! OR Exchange a card from hand for any 'spice' card you own. (Immune to Sense).

title: A Step Backward & Higher Ground
gameText: During a battle at opponent's site (or your non-<> site), instead of firing one of your character weapons at a target, cause that target to be immunity to attrition -3 (or limited to immunity to attrition < 5) for remainder of turn. OR Find one of your missing characters. OR Cancel a 'react.' OR Once per game, use 1 Force to exchange a card in hand with the top most character of ability < 5 in your Lost Pile.

title: Either Way, You Win
lore: 'Deal!'
gameText: USED: Reveal the top four cards of your Reserve Deck and separate them into two piles of any size. Opponent places one pile in your hand and the other on top of your Used Pile in any order. OR Take Control into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Place an opponent's just-played Interrupt out of play.

title: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

titleComponents.name: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

lore: 'Et tu taka bu Jabba now.'
gameText: When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. [download] Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.

title: Under Jabba's Protection
gameText: When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your Objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh into hand (or stack top card of Lost Pile on it).

title: Hoth: Echo Corridor
gameText: Light: Once per game, may deploy a [Hoth] general here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Non-[Defensive Shield] Chasm is canceled. Dark: While 1st Marker on table, Effects may deploy here instead of on 1st Marker.
locationDarkSideGameText: While 1st Marker on table, Effects may deploy here instead of on 1st Marker.
locationLightSideGameText: Once per game, may deploy a [Hoth] general here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Non-[Defensive Shield] Chasm is canceled.

title: You May Start Your Landing
lore: Echo Base was no match for the Imperial war machine.
gameText: If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-AT (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may take Walker Garrison and/or 3rd Marker into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Sith Fury & End This Destructive Conflict
gameText: During a battle at opponent's site (or your non-<> site), instead of firing one of your character weapons at a target, cause that target to be immunity to attrition -3 (or limited to immunity to attrition < 5) for remainder of turn. OR If you just drew a character for destiny, take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. OR Cancel a 'react.' OR Place Projection Of A Skywalker in opponent's Used Pile.

title: Salacious Crumb
lore: Male Kowakian. Prankster. Humiliates others for Jabba's amusement. His life depends on making Jabba laugh at least once per day.
gameText: Unless R2-D2 present, while with Jabba at Audience Chamber and opponent just drew weapon or battle destiny, may say "AH-hahahahaha!" and place this character in Used Pile to cancel and redraw that destiny (canceled destiny card is lost).

title: You Swindled Me!
lore: Needless to say, Watto was not happy about his loss.
gameText: USED: Reveal the top four cards of your Reserve Deck and separate them into two piles of any size. Opponent places one pile in your hand and the other on top of your Used Pile in any order. OR Take Alter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Place an opponent's just-played Interrupt out of play.

title: Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
locationDarkSideGameText: While [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Occupation on table, Hoth Energy Shield covers only this site and Echo sites. You may not attempt [Hoth] Epic Events from beyond the 3rd Marker.
locationLightSideGameText: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. If 'blown away,' Light Side loses 3 Force (may not be reduced).

title: AT-AT Commander
lore: Leader.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May place AT-AT Commander on bottom of Used Pile to cancel an attempt to target a vehicle he is aboard with Under Attack. Once during each of your turns, may peek at the top card of your Force Pile. Projection Of A Skywalker here is suspended.

title: IG-2000
lore: IG-88's assault starfighter. Custom designed. Boasts a Kuat Galaxy-15 engine from a Nebulon-B frigate. Heavy ion cannon often used to disable starships before boarding.
gameText: May add 1 pilot and 2 passengers. Rebel starships deploy +1 here. During battle, if IG-88 piloting, whenever you draw destiny cumulatively subtract 1 from opponent's total power. Immune to attrition < 3.

title: He Always Wins!
lore: Sebulba is willing to utilize a variety of 'tactics' to maintain his lead position. Mars Guo learned this lesson the hard way.
gameText: Deploy on a junkyard. If a Podrace was just initiated, you may draw two cards from Reserve Deck. May deploy Sebulba or Tatooine system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you have won a Podrace, your total power during battle is +3 and 'free' on You're A Slave? may be treated as '2 Force.' (Immune to Alter.)

title: Spaceport Docking Bay
gameText: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here. Immune to [Reflections III] Ounee Ta. Light: May not be deployed to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your pilots deploy +1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here. Immune to [Reflections III] Ounee Ta.
locationLightSideGameText: May not be deployed to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your pilots deploy +1 here.

title: Tatooine: Imperial Vanguard Camp
gameText: Dark: May deploy Jir here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, may use 1 Force to take a device that deploys on a starship into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: If a player controls this site, they may raise their converted Tatooine system to the top.
locationDarkSideGameText: May deploy Jir here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Once per game, may use 1 Force to take a device that deploys on a starship into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
locationLightSideGameText: If a player controls this site, they may raise their converted Tatooine system to the top.

title: Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard
gameText: Dark: While Watto here, opponent may not draw battle destiny here. Once per game may deploy Watto here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: While Obi-Wan 'communing', may not be converted (and if Watto here, attrition against opponent is reset to 0).
locationDarkSideGameText: While Watto here, opponent may not draw battle destiny here. Once per game may deploy Watto here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
locationLightSideGameText: While Obi-Wan 'communing', may not be converted (and if Watto here, attrition against opponent is reset to 0).

title: Aayla Secura
lore: Female Twi'lek.
gameText: Power +1 for each of opponent's characters here. When with two of your aliens (or clones), adds one battle destiny. May not be targeted by weapons unless each of your other aliens and clones present are 'hit.' Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 5.

title: Palace Raider
lore: Smugglers from many worlds are hunted by the Empire for providing arms and supplies to the Alliance. The Outer Rim is their refuge.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Adds 3 to power of anything he drives. When driving a transport vehicle, it moves for free and he adds one battle destiny. [Reflections 3] Wipe Them Out, All Of Them ignores your non-unique aliens.

title: Sergeant Edian
lore: Veteran of the Cloud City security forces. Loyal to Administrator Calrissian. Disdainful of the corruption of other Cloud City troopers.
gameText: Deploys free to Cloud City. Power +2 in battles you initiate. Once per turn, while present at a battleground, if you just drew an alien (or [Independent] starship) for destiny anywhere, may take that card into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.

title: Trooper Utris M'Toc
lore: Imzig Cloud City trooper and Wing Guard leader. Attempts to protect Cloud City citizens from less reputable members of local constabulary. Never accepts a bribe.
gameText: Deploys free to same site as Lando or Lobot. Power +2 while defending a battle. While present at a battleground, your aliens at same and related locations are forfeit +1 (+2 if a trooper).

title: Uutkik
lore: Experienced Jawa thief. Pilfers equipment and hijacks vehicles from unwary bystanders in Mos Eisley. Het Nkik's ugliest cousin.
gameText: During your move phase, may target a device here. Draw destiny. Device 'pilfered' (lost) if destiny > 4. Once per game, if present at a battleground during opponent's turn, may steal a device, weapon, or transport vehicle from opponent's Lost pile into hand.

title: Greedo With Blaster Pistol
lore: Rodian assassin and bounty hunter.
gameText: Your other assassins at same site are power +1. Permanent weapon is •Greedo's Blaster Pistol (if a battle was just initiated here, may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit if destiny +1 > defense value). Immune to Disarmed.

title: All My Urchins & Cloud City Celebration
gameText: Deploy on table. If Independent Operation on table and all your ability is provided by Leia, Luke, aliens, Cloud Cars, and [Independent] starship pilots: Cloud City Troopers ignore location deployment restrictions (and "power -1") in their game text; immunity to attrition of opponent's characters and starships at Bespin locations is limited to < 6; your total battle destiny is +1 (+2 if your trooper in battle); and you retrieve 2 Force whenever you initiate battle. Place Effect on bottom of Force Pile if canceled.

title: Underworld Contacts & Uncharted Settlements
gameText: Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base; you must choose alien/[Independent] starship. You may not deploy Ellorrs Madak, Revolution or operatives. Your Destiny is canceled. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Virtual Block 1] Yerka Mig may deploy on a Rebel Cell Site, may be placed in Used Pile if it was just lost, and you may retrieve Force with it only once per turn. While Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table, attrition against opponent is +1 for each Rebel Cell site you occupy with an alien. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Out Of Nowhere
lore: Black market sensor-stealth arrays can be used to hide starships from enemy sensor scans. Stellar interference can naturally shield a starship for surprise attacks.
gameText: Use 2 Force to target a system or planet site. For remainder of turn, you may deploy there even without presence or Force icons. (Immune to Sense.) OR If you just deployed a non-Jedi character to a location opponent occupies, take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle.

title: Rug Hug
lore: Wookiees are known to be creatures of great emotion and are very protective of family and friends. Chewbacca has come to treat Luke as a member of his own family.
gameText: Use 2 Force to move one of your characters as a 'react' to a battle opponent just initiated. OR If Luke (or a Jedi) and your alien are in battle together, add one battle destiny. OR Once per game, activate X Force, where X = number of your aliens on table.

title: Rebel Cell - Refugee Quarter
gameText: Light: While [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base on table, your unique (*) aliens are deploy -1 (to a maximum of -1). Dark: Deploys only to same planet as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site.
locationDarkSideGameText: Deploys only to same planet as Rebel Cell - Hidden Landing Site.
locationLightSideGameText: While [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base on table, your unique (*) aliens are deploy -1 (to a maximum of -1).

title: Tatooine: Cantina
gameText: Light: Scoundrels are smugglers. May use 1 Force to [download] Mos Eisley. Immune to Revolution. Dark: You lose no Force to Force drains at opponent's Kessel system. May not be converted.
locationDarkSideGameText: You lose no Force to Force drains at opponent's Kessel system. May not be converted.
locationLightSideGameText: Scoundrels are smugglers. May use 1 Force to [download] Mos Eisley. Immune to Revolution.

title: Kessel Run
gameText: Deploy on Infiltration or non-[Virtual Block 4] Watch Your Step. May [download] Kessel. May target a scoundrel or smuggler at a non-Kessel system (target is immune to Set For Stun). If target is lost, place cards here in Used Pile. When target reaches Kessel, draw five 'parsec' destinies and stack them here (or this Mission is lost). Whenever you win a battle (or at start of your turn), take a card here into hand. When target returns to original system: Mission completed (counts as two Kessel Runs), Infiltration flips, and may [upload] a card. If total 'parsec' destiny < 12 when completed, may subtract 1 from each of opponent's destiny draws. May not be canceled.

title: Black Market Blaster
lore: Illegal weapon easily purchased by Rebel suppliers on the black market. Rechargeable energy packs make it a cost-effective weapon.
gameText: Deploy on Kyle Katarn or your smuggler. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if destiny +2 > defense value. If fired by Kyle Katarn, he is immunity to attrition +1 for remainder of turn.

title: Cloud City Blaster
lore: Black market ties make it possible for the Cloud City quartermaster to acquire powerful weapons such as this. Low refraction index provides minimal beam dispersion.
gameText: Deploy on your alien. When fired in battle, your total power is +1. May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 > defense value. If carried by Lobot or a trooper, "1" on this card is treated as "2."

title: Guardian's Lightsaber
lore: A Jedi learns not only to wield a lightsaber, but how to channel the Force to increase skill and control the lightsaber's damage.
gameText: Deploy on Aayla or [Virtual Block 7] Mace. Once during your control phase, if present at a battleground you control, opponent loses 1 Force. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Lady Valarian
lore: Whiphid female gangster and leader.
gameText: Your total battle destiny here is +1. Unless Jabba on table, 'Jabba' in the game text of your cards (except Hutt Bounty and Jabba's Prize) may be treated as 'Lady Valarian.' Once per turn, may target a Mistryl of ability > 2 here; target is Heroic until end of turn.

title: Luuke
lore: Assassin and clone.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May use any stolen lightsaber. During battle, may steal a lightsaber from opponent's Lost Pile (return weapon to opponent's Lost Pile if it is about to leave table or at end of battle). May use 2 Force to cancel Luke's game text here for remainder of turn.

title: The Modal Nodes' Ommni Box
lore: Difficult-to-play instrument which enhances music. Tech Mo'r plays one for Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes in the Mos Eisley Cantina.
gameText: Deploy on Tech Mo'r or use 2 Force to deploy on your musician (or a site). Your musicians here not carrying this device are Heroic. 'At same site' on your musicians may be treated as 'at battleground sites.' 'Cover charges' only apply to opponent and are limited to 3.

title: Sarlacc
lore: Very patient predator in the Dune Sea. Tentacles can grab prey up to four meters away. Digests victims for 1000 years. Often fed prisoners by Jabba the Hutt.
gameText: * Ferocity = 4 + destiny. Habitat: Great Pit Of Carkoon. X = number of your aliens here. Captives here are power -X. Anything eaten by Sarlacc is placed out of play (if a captive, retrieve up to X Force).

title: Carbonite Chamber Console
lore: Most often used to freeze Tibanna gas for transport. Modified by Ugloste to work on humans. Intended to capture Luke Skywalker, the Emperor's prize.
gameText: Deploy on Carbonite Chamber. Once per game may use 3 Force to take [Virtual Block 6][Jabba's Palace] Boba Fett into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Jabba's Prize on Tatooine, you may add 1 to your destiny draws in battle anywhere, and once per game may take Audience Chamber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Sabotage and Uutkik.

title: B2 Super Battle Droid
gameText: Deploys +1 if In Complete Control on table. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent here (2 if with another [Separatist] card). May fire any [Episode I] weapon for free.

title: Maul's Cape
lore: A Sith Lord can use the Force to reach out and find what he seeks.
gameText: Deploy on your character of ability > 3. Character gains scout skill, their weapon destiny draws are +1, and character is immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5.

title: War Has Begun
gameText: If Separatist Uprising on table, deploy on table. Your Separatist Council Room gains one [Dark Side]. Your Force generation is +1 at each of your battlegrounds you control with a [Separatist] card. Once per turn, may take a [Separatist] Mission into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Join Me!
lore: '...And together, we can rule the galaxy as father and son!'
gameText: During battle, lose 1 Force to target a Skywalker present with your character armed with a lightsaber. Target is power = 0. OR If you just used a lightsaber to hit a Skywalker, opponent must lose 3 Force or place Skywalker (and all cards on them) in Used Pile.

title: Everything Is Going As Planned
gameText: USED: If you just drew a [Separatist] card for destiny, take it into hand (may cancel and redraw it). STARTING: If Separatist Uprising on table, deploy Droid Racks and two Effects that deploy for free, are always [Immune to Alter], and deploy on table. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Geonosis
gameText: Dark: If you control with two [Separatist] starships or two [Trade Federation] starships (or one of each), Force drain +1 here. Light: Unless your [Clone Army] starship here, Force drain -1 here. May not be 'liberated.'
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control with two [Separatist] starships or two [Trade Federation] starships (or one of each), Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Unless your [Clone Army] starship here, Force drain -1 here. May not be 'liberated.'

title: Geonosis: Docking Bay
gameText: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if Dooku on Geonosis). Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if Dooku on Geonosis).
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

title: Geonosis: Petranaki Arena
gameText: Dark: Dooku and Jango are power +1 here. Imprisoned captives released here may Escape. Light: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Petranaki Arena to the top.
locationDarkSideGameText: Dooku and Jango are power +1 here. Imprisoned captives released here may Escape.
locationLightSideGameText: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Petranaki Arena to the top.

title: Geonosis: Rocky Plains
gameText: Dark: Your total power here is +1 for each [Separatist] card present. Light: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Rocky Plains to the top.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your total power here is +1 for each [Separatist] card present.
locationLightSideGameText: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Rocky Plains to the top.

title: Geonosis: Separatist Council Room
gameText: Dark: May deploy Gunray from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While two senators here, they use their game text as if in a senate majority. Light: While Gunray or opponent's senator here, your spies may not deploy here.
locationDarkSideGameText: May deploy Gunray from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While two senators here, they use their game text as if in a senate majority.
locationLightSideGameText: While Gunray or opponent's senator here, your spies may not deploy here.

title: Muunilinst
gameText: Dark: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1. Light: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1.
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1.
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1.

title: Muunilinst: Banking Clan Headquarters
gameText: Dark: If you control with a [Separatist] card, unique (•) [Separatist] cards deploy -1 here. Light: Your combat vehicles and [Clone Army] cards are power +1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control with a [Separatist] card, unique (•) [Separatist] cards deploy -1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Your combat vehicles and [Clone Army] cards are power +1 here.

title: Muunilinst: City Of Harnaidan
gameText: Dark: Your combat vehicles here are power +1 and may move to and from here for free. Light: Unless your [Clone Army] card or combat vehicle here, Force drain -1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your combat vehicles here are power +1 and may move to and from here for free.
locationLightSideGameText: Unless your [Clone Army] card or combat vehicle here, Force drain -1 here.

title: Muunilinst: Docking Bay
gameText: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if a [Separatist] card here). Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if a [Separatist] card here).
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.

title: Muunilinst: Separatist Command Center
gameText: Dark: Battle droids and [Separatist] cards are power +1 here. Light: -
locationDarkSideGameText: Battle droids and [Separatist] cards are power +1 here.

title: Tatooine: Imperial Outpost
gameText: Dark: Once per turn, if an Imperial here, may activate 1 Force. Immune to Expand The Empire. Light: Your character movement from here using landspeed (except scouts) requires +1 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per turn, if an Imperial here, may activate 1 Force. Immune to Expand The Empire.
locationLightSideGameText: Your character movement from here using landspeed (except scouts) requires +1 Force.

title: Arena Execution
gameText:
Deploy on War Has Begun. [Virtual Block 2] Special Delivery is canceled. May deploy Arena Pillars from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Petranaki Arena is a prison. If there are no captives at Petranaki Arena and opponent about to lose a non-droid character, may imprison it there. If opponent controls Petranaki Arena during their control phase, they may release any number of captives there. If an opponent's imprisoned character was just 'executed,' stack it here face down (Mission complete).
{Reward}: Attrition against opponent is +1.
{Turn the Tide}: If opponent controls Petranaki Arena during their control phase, place this Mission in Used Pile.

title: Defense Of Muunilinst
gameText:
Deploy on War Has Begun. Unless a card stacked here, if you control three Muunilinst locations (and opponent controls no Muunilinst locations), opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down (Mission complete).
{Reward}: Your Force drains at Muunilinst locations are +1 and, once per turn, may raise your converted Muunilinst site to the top.
{Turn The Tide}: If opponent controls two Muunilinst locations, place this Mission in Used Pile.

title: Rally To Our Cause
gameText:
Deploy on War Has Begun. During your control phase, for each system where you occupy a related site, may draw one destiny; if destiny + X + Y > 7, stack top card of Lost Pile under that system (limit one per system); it is 'aligned' (Mission complete).
X = number of 'aligned' systems on table.
Y = number of unique (•) [Separatist] characters on table.
{Reward}: Your battle destiny draws are +X (limit +2).
{Turn the Tide}: If opponent just initiated a Force drain at an 'aligned' system, place stacked cards there in Used Pile (system no longer 'aligned'). If there are no 'aligned' systems on table, place this Mission in Used Pile.

title: Separatist Uprising
gameText: Separatist Uprising: Deploy Separatist Council Room and War Has Begun. For remainder of game, Galen, Imperials, and Imperial starships are lost. Your Republic characters and [Episode I] vehicles gain [Separatist]. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. While this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to deploy an [Episode I] battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if a complete [Separatist] Mission on table. At War With Itself: Immediately, may retrieve up to 3 Force (Force retrieved this way may be taken into hand) once per game. While this side up, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. Once during your control phase, may use 2 Force to take a [Separatist] character, vehicle, or starship into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your total power in battles is +X, and whenever you win a battle, opponent loses X Force, where X = the number of complete [Separatist] Missions on table. Flip this card if no complete [Separatist] Missions on table.

title: At War With Itself
gameText: Separatist Uprising: Deploy Separatist Council Room and War Has Begun. For remainder of game, Galen, Imperials, and Imperial starships are lost. Your Republic characters and [Episode I] vehicles gain [Separatist]. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. While this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to deploy an [Episode I] battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if a complete [Separatist] Mission on table. At War With Itself: Immediately, may retrieve up to 3 Force (Force retrieved this way may be taken into hand) once per game. While this side up, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. Once during your control phase, may use 2 Force to take a [Separatist] character, vehicle, or starship into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your total power in battles is +X, and whenever you win a battle, opponent loses X Force, where X = the number of complete [Separatist] Missions on table. Flip this card if no complete [Separatist] Missions on table.

title: DSD1 Dwarf Spider Droid
gameText: While with a [Clone Army] card or another spider droid, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is Self-Destruct (may target a character present; draw destiny; if destiny +2 > defense value, target hit and forfeit -4, and this character also hit).

title: Dooku's Solar Sailer
gameText: May add 1 pilot and 2 passengers. Dooku deploys free aboard. While Dooku aboard, immune to attrition and opponent must have at least two piloted starships to initiate battle at same system.

title: Fanblade Starfighter
gameText: May add 1 pilot (suspends permanent pilot) and 1 passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Forfeit +2 while with a [Clone Army] card. Unless defending, power +2 and adds one battle destiny.

title: IG-227 'Hailfire' Droid Tank
lore: Enclosed.
gameText: Deploys -1 to same location as a [Separatist] card. Permanent weapon is Missile Battery (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; add 2 if targeting a vehicle; target hit if total destiny +1 > defense value).

title: Clone Infantry Squad
lore: Clone trooper.
gameText: Adds one battle destiny if with another clone. During battle, if you are about to draw a battle destiny, may draw two and choose one.

title: Clone Sniper
lore: Clone trooper and scout.
gameText: When deployed, may deploy A280 Sharpshooter Rifle on him from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. A280 Sharpsooter Rifle may deploy on Clone Sniper. When firing a rifle at an adjacent site, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one. Immune to Undercover.

title: Clone Specialist
lore: Clone trooper.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [Clone Army] starship or vehicle, adds 1 to its defense value and he is forfeit +2. Once per battle, when starship or vehicle he is piloting fires a weapon, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one.

title: Commander Adar Tallon
lore: Leader.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Adar is a matching pilot for any unique (•) [Republic] starfighter and, while piloting one, adds one battle destiny. Your [Republic] starfighters here are power and maneuver +1 and may add ability of pilot to total when targeted by Tallon Roll.

title: Captain Khurgee
lore: Docking bay security officer. Leader. Honored for bravery aboard the Star Destroyer Thunderflare where he rescued five officers from the wreckage of a shuttle crash.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While at a battleground system, once during your turn may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck; if it is a Rebel, may lose 1 Force to make it lost. Forfeit +2 (to a maximum of 7) aboard Thunderflare or with a leader.

title: Foul Moudama
lore: Talz.
gameText: If at your prison, Light Side goes first. Deploys -2 to Coruscant or a mobile site. May carry a character of power < 4 (as if riding a creature vehicle). Guardian's Lightsaber may deploy on Foul. Once per game, may take a clone or a non-Jedi alien into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: General Bel Iblis
lore: Insurgent leader. Corellian.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a non-[Episode I] corvette or a stolen starship, adds one battle destiny and it is immune to attrition < 5. 'Exiled' (placed out of play) if at Corellia. Once per game, may steal a Dreadnaught from opponent's Lost Pile into hand.

title: Leebo
lore: Smuggler. Heavily modified Cybot Galactica LE-series repair droid. Information broker. Provides information gained through underworld channels to the Alliance.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While piloting, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and your battle destiny draws (and total battle destiny) here may not be reduced. During battle, if aboard Outrider, may use 1 Force: all immunity to attrition here is limited to < 5.

title: Max Rebo
lore: Ortolan musician and gambler. Leader of The Max Rebo Band. Signed a lifetime contract to Jabba in exchange for unlimited food.
gameText: If just lost (even from Life Force), opponent 'steals' Max into Lost Pile. While at a battleground site: you may play Bith Shuffle or Ommni Box to cancel a Force drain at a related location, they are Lost Interrupts, and once per turn may take one of them into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Nien Nunb, Sullustan Smuggler
lore: Brilliant navigator. Former SoroSuub employee. Turned to pirating when that corporation backed the Empire. Tall for a Sullustan.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand (except Obi-Wan) of the same card type as the top card of your Lost Pile out of play to retrieve 1 Force (may be taken into hand).

title: Voolvif Monn
lore: Shistavanen.
gameText: May deploy -2 to Geonosis or Muunilinst as a 'react.' During battle, may lose 2 Force (or use 3 Force) to cancel any just drawn weapon destiny targeting Voolvif. During battle, unless another Jedi here, Voolvif is power +2 and immune to attrition < 5.

title: A Grand Army Of The Republic

titleComponents.name: A Grand Army Of The Republic

gameText: Deploy on table. Once per turn, if you just deployed a combat vehicle, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. During your deploy phase, may use 1 Force and reveal one [Clone Army] vehicle from hand to take into hand a clone pilot of ability < 3 (or vice versa) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle and deploy both simultaneously. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Nute Gunray
lore: Commanding Viceroy of the Trade Federation forces assigned to the blockade of Naboo. Takes responsibility for his own actions. Neimoidian leader.
gameText: Deploys -1 to Council Room. Adds 1 to any attempt to 'align' a system. If an 'aligned' system on table, once per turn during any battle, may lose 1 Force to add 1 to your total power for each unique (•) [Separatist] character on table.

title: Begun, The Clone War Has
gameText: If Republic At War on table, deploy on table. Forward Command Center gains one [Light Side Force]. Your Force generation is +1 at each of your battlegrounds you control with a [Clone Army] card. Your clones gain [Clone Army]. Once per turn, may take a [Clone Army] Mission into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Cloning Cylinders
gameText: Use 4 Force to deploy on table. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to stack a clone from your Lost Pile here face down. At the start of your turn, turn all cards here face up. You may deploy any face up card stacked here (as if from hand). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Much to Learn, You Still Have

titleComponents.name: Much to Learn, You Still Have

lore: Yoda calls upon the Force often to try and foresee what destiny has in store.
gameText: Deploy on any location. While on a battleground, adds one [Light Side Force] and [Dark Side Force]. While on opponent's non-battleground planet location (except a Kashyyyk location or docking bay), their gametext here is canceled and your Force generation is +1. [Clone Army] troopers are power +1.

title: This Is More Like It
lore: 'You like me because I'm a scoundrel. There aren't enough scoundrels in your life.' 'I happen to like nice men.' 'I'm a nice man.' 'No you're not, you're ..'
gameText: Cancel an attempt to target a scoundrel (or a starship or vehicle piloted by a scoundrel) with a weapon. OR At any time during your turn, deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from under Scoundrel's Luck (or transfer a [Scoundrel] Effect to another scoundrel on table).

title: What About That Blue One?
lore: "You haven't finished with me yet!"
gameText: Deploy on table. Your total Force generation is +1. Once per game may take an astromech into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Fire Extinguisher may only cancel battles you initiate and [Virtual Block 4] Wokling is canceled. Once per game may retrieve a Rebel of ability < 5 or a Rebel starfighter. (Immune to Alter.)

title: The Dark Side Is Growing
gameText: USED: If you just drew a [Clone Army] card for destiny, take it into hand (may cancel and redraw it). STARTING: If Republic At War on table, deploy Cloning Cylinders and two Effects that deploy for free, are always [Immune to Alter], and deploy on table. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Geonosis: Docking Bay
gameText: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if Yoda on Geonosis). Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if Yoda on Geonosis).

title: Geonosis: Forward Command Center
gameText: Light: [Episode I] Yoda ignores location deployment restrictions here. Once per game may [download] Yoda here. Dark: If you control, opponent's Forward Command Center game text is canceled.
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, opponent's Forward Command Center game text is canceled.
locationLightSideGameText: [Episode I] Yoda ignores location deployment restrictions here. Once per game may [download] Yoda here.

title: Geonosis: Petranaki Arena
gameText: Light: Amidala, Anakin, and Obi-Wan deploy -1 here. Dark: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Petranaki Arena to the top.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Petranaki Arena to the top.
locationLightSideGameText: Amidala, Anakin, and Obi-Wan deploy -1 here.

title: Geonosis: Rocky Plains
gameText: Light: Your total power here is +1 for each [Clone Army] card present. Dark: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Rocky Plains to the top.
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per turn, if you control, may raise your converted Rocky Plains to the top.
locationLightSideGameText: Your total power here is +1 for each [Clone Army] card present.

title: Durge
lore: Gen'Dai bounty hunter and assassin.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Power +1 for each opponent's character present with ability > 3. While present on Muunilinst, adds one battle destiny. If Durge was just lost, may use 2 Force to 'regenerate' (take him into hand).

title: Muunilinst
gameText: Light: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1. Dark: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1.
locationDarkSideGameText: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1.
locationLightSideGameText: If you control, attrition against opponent in battles on Muunilinst is +1.

title: Muunilinst: City Of Harnaidan
gameText: Light: Your combat vehicles here are power +1 and add 1 to each of their weapon destiny draws. Dark: Unless opponent controls this site, [Presence Droid] and [Separatist] cards may move to and from here for free.
locationDarkSideGameText: Unless opponent controls this site, [Presence Droid] and [Separatist] cards may move to and from here for free.
locationLightSideGameText: Your combat vehicles here are power +1 and add 1 to each of their weapon destiny draws.

title: Muunilinst: Docking Bay
gameText: Light: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if a [Clone Army] card here). Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force (free if a [Clone Army] card here).

title: Muunilinst: Harnaidan Plains
gameText: Light: - Dark: Battle droids and [Separatist] cards are forfeit -1 and power +1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Battle droids and [Separatist] cards are forfeit -1 and power +1 here.

title: Muunilinst: Republic Landing Site
gameText: Light: Your [Clone Army] characters and [Clone Army] combat vehicles may shuttle to and from this site for free. Dark: Unless you control with a [Separatist] card, Force drain -1 here.
locationDarkSideGameText: Unless you control with a [Separatist] card, Force drain -1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: Your [Clone Army] characters and [Clone Army] combat vehicles may shuttle to and from this site for free.

title: Assault On Muunilinst
gameText:
Deploy on Begun, The Clone War Has. Unless a card stacked here, if you control three Muunilinst locations (and opponent controls no Muunilinst locations), opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down (Mission complete).
{Reward}: Your Force drains at Muunilinst locations are +1 and, once per turn, may raise your converted Muunilinst site to the top.
{Turn The Tide}: If opponent controls two Muunilinst locations, place this Mission in Used Pile.

title: Hunt Down The Dark Acolyte
gameText:
Deploy on Begun, The Clone War Has. Opponent's characters of ability > 4 are 'acolytes.'
