gameText: While no other characters present, if opponent just lost a Jedi from table, may lose 1 Force to place that Jedi out of play. While on Coruscant, may use 1 Force to add one battle destiny in a battle your Neimoidian is in. Immune to attrition.

title: Darth Sidious
lore: Mysterious Sith Master who is manipulating the Trade Federation for his own nefarious ends. Shrouded in mystery, his identity and agenda remain unclear.
gameText: While no other characters present, if opponent just lost a Jedi from table, may lose 1 Force to place that Jedi out of play. While on Coruscant, may use 1 Force to add one battle destiny in a battle your Neimoidian is in. Immune to attrition.

title: Corporal Rushing
lore: Royal Naboo security officer in charge of protecting Amidala's Throne Room. His wife and children were captured when the Trade Federation invaded the planet.
gameText: Deploys -1 to Naboo. While firing a blaster, adds one to total weapon destiny. Once per battle, if a battle droid was just hit by a blaster here, battle droid is lost and opponent loses 1 Force.

title: Infantry Battle Droid
lore: Main unit of the Trade Federation droid army. Cheap to manufacture. Required to be in contact with a Droid Control Ship at all times.
gameText: Power +1 in battles you initiate. Once per turn, if this droid just fired a blaster and 'hit' an opponent's character, opponent loses 1 Force. Opponent's Gungans and Republic characters present are forfeit -1.

title: Nute Gunray, Neimoidian Viceroy
lore: Neimoidian leader. Viceroy to the Trade Federation, but primarily under the influence of Darth Sidious. Ordered to take control of Naboo, and force the Queen to sign a treaty.
gameText: Your [Presence] droids and AATs are destiny +1 if drawn for battle or weapon destiny. Once per turn, may take Take Them Away into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < X, where X = twice the number of [Presence] droids present.

title: Nute Gunray, Neimoidian Viceroy
lore: Neimoidian leader. Viceroy to the Trade Federation, but primarily under the influence of Darth Sidious. Ordered to take control of Naboo, and force the Queen to sign a treaty.
gameText: Your [Presence] droids and AATs are destiny +1 if drawn for battle or weapon destiny. Once per turn, may take Take Them Away into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < X, where X = twice the number of [Presence] droids present.

title: OOM-9
lore: Officer battle droid who acted as a unit leader in the attack against the Gungans. Required advice from the Droid Control Ship in order to defeat the Gungan energy shield.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. May add or subtract one from a just drawn Energy Shell weapon destiny draw here. While at Battle Plains, twice per game may take Open Fire! or Cease Fire! into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: OWO-1 With Backup
lore: Trade Federation battle droid leader assigned to take a squad and destroy what was left of the Jedi ambassadors. His mission went unaccomplished.
gameText: Requires +2 Force to use Landspeed. Power +1 for each opponent's Jedi present. While with a battle droid at a site, draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Opponent's Force drains are -1 at adjacent sites.

title: Rayno Vaca
lore: Coruscant taxi driver who barely makes enough money to get by. Will try any trick in the book to get an extra credit from his customer.
gameText: Your characters may move from here using their landspeed for free. During your control phase, may place Vaca in Used Pile to take Lana Dobreed into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Rune Haako, Legal Counsel
lore: The Trade Federation's only Neimoidian leader to have ever encountered a Jedi Knight. Assumed Daultay Dofine's responsibilities after Dofine questioned their Sith Lord's plans.
gameText: While at Theed Palace Throne Room, your attrition against opponent in battles at same and related Naboo sites is +X, where X = number of battle droids present at that site. While with a battle droid, Haako is power and defense value +2.

title: Rune Haako, Legal Counsel
lore: The Trade Federation's only Neimoidian leader to have ever encountered a Jedi Knight. Assumed Daultay Dofine's responsibilities after Dofine questioned their Sith Lord's plans.
gameText: While at Theed Palace Throne Room, your attrition against opponent in battles at same and related Naboo sites is +X, where X = number of battle droids present at that site. While with a battle droid, Haako is power and defense value +2.

title: Sil Unch
lore: Neimoidian Trade Federation Droid Control Ship officer. Specialized in battle droid control programming and interfaces. Does not enjoy being commanded by Daultay Dofine.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard a battleship, that battleship is immune to attrition < 4 and draws a battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

title: SSA-1015
lore: Security battle droid whose programming assured him a Jedi could be subdued. Supposed to be designated SSA-101, but a mistake in production pushed him back to 1015.
gameText: While with an opponent's Jedi, your other battle droids present are power +1. Opponent's Jedi are deploy +4 to same site. While with another battle droid at a site, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.

title: Dams Denna
lore: Knowledgable animal trainer and herd-master. Collector of Linn'con memorabilia.
gameText: Once during your deploy phase, you may deploy a Kaadu, Fambaa or Eopie to same site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just lost a creature vehicle from same site, you may place that creature in your Used Pile.

title: SSA-306
lore: Security battle droid was assigned guard duty at Theed Palace. His shift can only be ended by a blaster shot.
gameText: At same site, opponent's spies and smugglers are deploy +4 and may not apply their ability toward drawing battle destiny. While with another battle droid at a site, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.

title: SSA-719
lore: Security battle droid assigned to quell uprisings before they have a chance to gather momentum. Believes the best form of defense is offense.
gameText: While with another battle droid, power +3. If with a battle droid on Naboo and you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, may lose 2 Force to search that Reserve Deck and place one card you find there out of play.

title: Tank Commander
lore: AATs require officer battle droids to command them and relay orders from the Droid Control Ship. Programmed with sophisticated tank warfare tactics.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of any AAT he pilots. While piloting an AAT, forfeit +2, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and your other [Presence] droids at this site are immune to attrition < 4.

title: Activate The Droids
lore: The activation of droids requires a transmission from a Droid Control Ship on a top-secret frequency. Only a Trade Federation captain has access to these frequencies.
gameText: Deploy on your Blockade Flagship (may not deploy on a site). Whenever you initiate a battle at a related planet site where you have a battle droid, you may activate 2 Force or retrieve 1 Force.

title: After Her!
lore: 'This one's a decoy!'
gameText: If opponent just Force drained you at a location, deploy on that location. Opponent's Force drains here are +1. Your battle destiny draws here are +1. If you control this location, may place Immediate Effect in Used Pile to retrieve 4 Force. (Immune to Control.)

title: At Last We Are Getting Results

titleComponents.name: At Last We Are Getting Results

lore: First sign that your blockade is going well: the Queen's on the comlink.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your [Trade Federation] starfighters are forfeit +2. During every draw phase, opponent loses 1 Force unless they occupy a battleground system. Effect lost if you do not occupy two battleground systems with [Trade Federation] starships.

title: Droid Racks
lore: The Trade Federation utilizes such efficient methods of droid deployment that it is rumored even they do not know exactly how many battle droids are in circulation
gameText: Use 4 Force to deploy on table. If your battle droid was just lost, may place it here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force (1 Force if your piloted MTT on table) to take any battle droid from here into hand. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Fighters Straight Ahead
lore: Sometimes a swarm of starfighters can look more imposing than it really is. Mostly though, it's just best to avoid them altogether.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at systems you control. Opponent's non-unique starfighters are deploy +1 (or +2 to a system you occupy). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Naboo Occupation
lore: Battle droid armies require less credits to maintain than the average soldier. Trade Federation tactics are designed to take advantage of these numbers.
gameText: Deploy on table. During your draw phase, may use 3 Force: until end of next turn, opponent generates no Force at Naboo sites you control with a battle droid. Place Effect in Lost Pile if you have no battle droids on Naboo. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Open Fire!
lore: When given the attack coordinates, AAT weaponry can be programmed to track and fire automatically for maximum destruction.
gameText: Deploy on your AAT. Once during your control phase may use 3 Force to fire your AAT Laser Cannon on this AAT for free.

title: 2-1B
lore: Member of the droid pool on the rebel base of Hoth. Worked on Luke Skywalker and other members of Rogue Squadron who needed medical treatment.

title: Owen
lore: Only Owen Lars knew what kind of impact Anakin’s past would have on Luke. That’s what he was afraid of.

title: Lost In The Wilderness & Yub Yub!
gameText: USED: Add 1 to forfeit of each of your Ewoks for remainder of turn. LOST: Cancel a Force drain at an exterior planet site where opponent has no vehicles or starships. Draw destiny. If destiny > number of opponent's characters at that site, choose one of those characters to be missing.

title: Luke! We're Going To Have Company

titleComponents.name: Luke! We're Going To Have Company

lore: "Who is this? What's your operating number?"

title: Might Of The Republic
gameText: Once per game, retrieve 1 Force for each of your senators at Galactic Senate. (Immune to Sense.) OR Take one senator (or Coruscant Guard, Sei Taria or Mas Amedda) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Mindful Of The Future & Inconsequential Barriers
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy a unique (•) battleground not on table, from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Imperial Barrier, None Shall Pass, or Set For Stun. OR Peek at the top card of your Force Pile; either return it, or place it under your Force Pile or Reserve Deck.

title: Mission Briefing
lore: Before the Battle of Hoth, rebel officers would fall silent the moment their commander came into the room to brief them.

title: My Loyal Bodyguard & Might Of The Republic
gameText: Once per game, retrieve 1 Force for each of your senators at Galactic Senate. (Immune to Sense.) OR Deploy a handmaiden to Amidala's location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated battle at same site as your handmaiden and Amidala, add one battle destiny. OR Take one senator (or Coruscant Guard, Sei Taria or Mas Amedda) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Nabrun Leids & Quite A Mercenary
gameText: If Elis Helrot just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Elis and all characters transported are lost. (Immune to Sense.) OR At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile. OR Prevent a smuggler from moving this turn.

title: Narrow Escape
gameText: If opponent just initiated battle at a site where you have a Rebel of ability > 2 present, move all of your cards with ability there away (using their landspeed at normal use of Force) and cancel battle.

title: Neck And Neck
gameText: If difference between opponent's and your highest race totals < 4, lose 1 Force. Opponent draws no race destiny next control phase. OR If both players have < 10 Life Force remaining, both players retrieve 4 Force.

title: Neck And Neck & Changing The Odds
gameText: USED: If opponent just drew battle destiny (or destiny for Watto's Chance Cube), subtract one from that destiny. OR If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, search that Reserve Deck and place one Interrupt found there out of play. LOST: If difference between opponent's and your highest race totals < 4, lose 1 Force. Opponent draws no race destiny next control phase. OR If both players have < 10 Life Force remaining, both players retrieve 4 Force.

title: Palpatine, Senator To Naboo
lore: "A tragedy has occurred, which started right here with the taxation of trade routes and has now engulfed our entire planet in the oppression of the Trade Federation."

title: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By

titleComponents.name: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By

gameText: Send one of your missing characters at same site as one of your piloted or driven vehicles to your Used Pile. OR Cancel any attempt by one character to 'hide' from a battle.

title: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By & Visored Vision

titleComponents.name: Nice Of You Guys To Drop By

gameText: USED: Send one of your missing characters at same site as one of your piloted or driven vehicles to your Used Pile. OR Cancel any attempt by one character to 'hide' from a battle. OR Name an Interrupt card. Opponent must reveal entire Used Pile, without shuffling, Then you choose: USED: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each copy of that Interrupt found there. LOST: Each copy of that Interrupt found there is lost.

title: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!

titleComponents.name: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!

gameText: If you just lost a Gungan from table, place him in your hand. OR If Jar Jar and Tarpals are in a battle together, add two battle destiny.

title: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar & Gimme A Lift!

titleComponents.name: No Giben Up, General Jar Jar!

gameText: If you just lost a Gungan from table, place him in your hand. OR If Jar Jar and Tarpals are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. OR Relocate Jar Jar to a battle just initiated at an adjacent site. OR Increase Jar Jar's landspeed by 1 for remainder of turn. OR If Jar Jar on Brisky Morning Munchen, take him to hand.

title: Off The Edge
gameText: Target one of your characters at a Cloud City site. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's destiny number, retrieve Force equal to the difference. If destiny < character's destiny number, lose difference. If destiny = character's destiny number, character is lost.

title: Old Ben & Noble Sacrifice
gameText: Use 1 Force if any of your characters (except Obi-Wan) was just forfeited from a Tatooine site. Mysterious "crazy wizard" steps in and revives (relocates) that character back to same site. OR If opponent just deployed a character, sacrifice (place out of play) from table one of your characters with the same power (even a captured character). Retrieve Force equal to your sacrificed character's forfeit value.

title: Old Smoothies
lore: Lando did his best to appear delighted that his old buddy had come back to see him.

title: On The Edge & Surprise Assault
gameText: Use 1 Force and target a Rebel of ability > 2. Choose a number from 1 to 6. You may retrieve that amount of Force if you now draw destiny > chosen number. If you fail, Rebel is lost. OR Use 1 Force to cancel an opponent's Force drain at a location. Draw one destiny for each character, starship, and vehicle the opponent has present (limit 2). Compare your destiny total to opponent's power total. Player with lowest total loses Force equal to the difference.

title: Ouch Time
lore: Captain Tarpals had a way of describing certain situations to perfection.

title: Out Of Commission
gameText: During your control phase, use 2 Force to release a starship held by any Tractor Beam. (Not effective on Death Star Tractor Beam if Central Core in play.) OR Randomly select one card from opponent's Lost Pile or Blaster Rack and place out of play.

title: Rakes Jevorik
lore: Mercenary who turned against Jabba when Luke Skywalker and his friends destroyed his sail barge at the great pit of carkoon. Now seeking a new employer.

title: Perimeter Scan & Under Attack
gameText: Use 1 Force to glance at any one card which is face-down at a location. OR Use 1 Force to glance at opponent's hand. You may place each droid spy and Infantry Mine you find there in opponent's Used Pile. OR During your control phase, target a vehicle with armor present with your warrior. Draw destiny. If warrior has a Concussion Grenade or a lightsaber add 3 to destiny draw (7 if both). Vehicle (and grenade) lost if total destiny > armor.

title: Podrace Prep & Too Close For Comfort
gameText: LOST: Cancel Hit Racer or Podracer Collision. STARTING: Deploy Podrace Arena (with a Podracer, opponent may also deploy a Podracer there), Boonta Eve Podrace, and any Effect that deploys for free. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.

title: Quite A Mercenary
gameText: If Elis Helrot just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Elis and all characters transported are lost. (Immune to Sense.) OR Prevent a just-deployed smuggler from moving this turn.

title: Rebel Leadership
gameText: Your admirals and generals are forfeit +1 for remainder of turn. OR If your admiral is in a battle at a system (or your general, except Obi-Wan, is in a battle at a site), either add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny.

title: Rebel Leadership & Throw Me Another Charge
gameText: If your admiral is in battle at a system (or your general, except Obi-Wan, is in battle at a site), you may either add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny. OR Take one automated weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Add 1 to Deactivate The Shield Generator total. OR Cancel Trooper Charge, Blasted Droid, Trooper Assault, or Dark Jedi Presence.

title: Recoil In Fear
gameText: Use 3 Force. Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand.

title: Return Of A Jedi & Luke's Back
gameText: Use 1 Force to retrieve Obi-Wan or Luke from Lost Pile. OR Use 3 Force to take Obi-Wan or Luke into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Sabotage & Slight Weapons Malfunction
gameText: During your control phase, target one weapon, device, or vehicle at same site as your Undercover spy. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's deploy cost, target is lost (may be stolen instead if spy also a thief). OR Cancel Informant. OR If your weapon (except a lightsaber) was just fired during a battle, add one battle destiny.

title: See You At The Rendezvous
lore: Most rebels had their minds set on regrouping with the fleet as soon as possible. Luke had other plans.

title: Skull & Mandalorian Mishap
gameText: During a battle or attack, place out of play one non-droid character, creature, or creature vehicle from your Lost Pile. Add its destiny number to your total power. OR Take Fallen Portal into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If Boba Fett is defending a battle, draw one battle destiny. Subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power.

title: Senator Organa
lore: "Aren’t you a little short for a Stormtrooper?"

title: Smoke Screen
gameText: During a battle at a site, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the ability number of one of your characters involved in the battle.

title: Smoke Screen & It's A Trap!
gameText: Use 3 force to cancel any battle just initiated at a site. (Immune to Sense.) OR During a battle at a site, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the ability number of one of your characters involved in the battle.

title: Sorry About The Mess
gameText: During your control phase, fire one of your weapons. If Han firing, may add 1 to each weapon destiny draw. (A seeker may be targeted by a character weapon using defense value 4.) Any 'hit' targets are immediately lost.

title: Speak With The Jedi Council & Vote Now!
gameText: USED: If the Jedi Council Chamber is not on table, you may deploy it from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate. LOST: Deploy one Jedi Council member to the Jedi Council Chamber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Stay Here
lore: "But I..."

title: Strangle
gameText: Target an escort alone and its captive. Draw destiny. Escort lost if destiny + captive's power > escort's ability + power. OR During a battle at a site where Leia is an escorted captive, add one battle destiny.

title: Strike Blocked
gameText: Take top card of Force Pile into hand. OR If opponent just revealed a combat card, it is canceled (place in opponent's Used Pile) and opponent must draw destiny instead (that destiny is reduced by 1). OR Cancel Maul Strikes, Dark Strike, or You Are Beaten.

title: Taking On The Whole Empire By Myself

titleComponents.name: Taking On The Whole Empire By Myself

lore: Rogue Squadron took pride in its dedication to serve the alliance, even if it meant never returning home from the battlefield.

title: The Force Is Strong With This One & Jedi Presence

titleComponents.name: The Force Is Strong With This One

gameText: If Luke and an Imperial with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, add one battle destiny (add 2 if Imperial is Vader). OR if one of your Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Rebels there to battle at double power.

title: The Signal & Jedi Mind Trick
gameText: USED: Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle. OR Cancel a Force drain at a site if Luke is at an adjacent site. LOST: If your character of ability > 4 is present with an opponent's leader, release a captive from a related prison (canceled if opponent loses 2 Force).

title: Solo
lore: "I’m captain of the Millennium Falcon. Chewie tells me you’re looking for passage to the Alderaan system."

title: This Is More Like It & I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This

titleComponents.name: I Have A Really Bad Feeling About This

gameText: USED: During a battle, lose X Force to reduce attrition against you by X. LOST: Use 3 Force to relocate any Effect (except those immune to Alter) deployed on a location to another appropriate location.

title: Too Close For Comfort
gameText: USED: If your character was just targeted by a weapon, opponent must use 2 Force or the targeting is canceled. LOST: Cancel Hit Racer or Podracer Collision.

title: Under Attack
gameText: During your control phase, target a vehicle with armor at same site as one of your warriors. Draw destiny. If warrior has a Concussion Grenade or a lightsaber, add 3 to destiny draw (7 if both). Vehicle (and grenade) lost if total destiny > armor.

title: Vote Now!
gameText: During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate.

title: Walker Sighting
gameText: If opponent just moved or deployed an AT-AT to a planet site, deploy up to three related exterior sites from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: We Can Still Outmaneuver Them
gameText: USED: Take Collision! or Egregious Pilot Error into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: If opponent just initiated a battle with at least two capital starships at a system where you have a lone starfighter, add two battle destiny.

title: We Don't Need Their Scum
gameText: USED: Cancel Res Luk Ra'auf. LOST: If two bounty hunters (or an Imperial and a bounty hunter) are in a battle together, use 2 Force to draw two destiny. Subtract total from opponent's attrition and total power (cannot fall below zero).

title: We Don't Want To Cause Any Trouble

titleComponents.name: We Don't Want To Cause Any Trouble

lore: By leaving their droids out of the action, our heroes were able to find success in one of the most wretched spaceports in the entire galaxy.

title: We Wish To Board At Once

titleComponents.name: We Wish To Board At Once

gameText: Use 3 Force to take one Effect of any kind into hand from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Take Radiant VII, or one Interrupt with the word 'Podracer(s)' in its game text, into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: We Wish To Board At Once & Are You Brain Dead?!

titleComponents.name: We Wish To Board At Once

gameText: USED: Take Radiant VII, or one Interrupt with the word "Podracer(s)" in its game text, into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Use 3 Force to take one Effect of any kind into hand from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Target your Episode I Jedi defending a battle. Target is immune to attrition for rest of turn (unless a Dark Jedi present). LOST: In a battle you lost, place a Jedi Council Member you just forfeited into Used Pile to cancel all battle damage and attrition against you.

title: Tiinn
lore: Jawa accountant involved with tracking Coilen in and around the Dune Sea. Transmits Coilen’s activities to Tatooine officials every day; he’s still waiting to hear back from them.

title: Were You Looking For Me? & I Know
gameText: USED: Take one or two communications or protocol droids (or one of each) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Retrieve C-3PO. OR If C-3PO is in battle at a site, add one battle destiny (or two if with three Ewoks). OR If Leia and Han are in a battle together, add two battle destiny. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Han, you may 'react' by deploying there (for free) Leia and/or her matching weapon from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Wookiee Strangle & We'll Find Han
gameText: Use 2 Force to target an opponent's non-droid character present with one of your Wookiees. Both players draw destiny. Add ability and power. Target is lost if Wookiee's total destiny > target's total destiny. OR If Chewie and your Lando are in a battle together, subtract 3 from attrition against you (cannot fall below zero). OR Cancel I Had No Choice.

title: Yoda I Must Know
lore: Fearing Ben Kenobi had lied to him, Luke needed to hear the truth from Yoda himself.

title: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

titleComponents.name: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

gameText: If Jabba is at a Jabba's Palace site, relocate one of your characters to that location from a related site. OR During your deploy phase, deploy one alien (at normal use of the Force) from Reserve Deck to the Audience Chamber; reshuffle.

title: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now & Strangle

titleComponents.name: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

gameText: USED: If Jabba is at a Jabba's Palace site, relocate one of your characters to that location from a related site. OR During your deploy phase, deploy one alien from Reserve Deck to Audience Chamber; reshuffle. LOST: Target an escort alone and its captive. Draw destiny. Escort lost if destiny + captive's power > escort's ability + power. OR During a battle at a site where Leia is an escorted captive, add one battle destiny.

title: Yousa Guys Bombad!
lore: Jedi tend to slice through battle droids like butter.

title: Boba Fett
lore: Most feared bounty hunter in the entire galaxy. "He’s no good to me dead."

title: Coilen
lore: Leader of the Jawa pack who captured R2-D2 on Tatooine and a nefarious thief. Nemesis to Rachalt Hyst - both have stolen goods from one another on multiple occasions.

title: Darth Maul, Sidious' Apprentice
lore: "I told you there was more to this. The Jedi are involved."

title: Wedge
lore: Rogue Squadron leader who assisted Gold Squadron One during its historic attack run on the second Death Star.

title: Emperor
lore: "Soon you will call me master."

title: Emperor's Royal Guard
lore: The Emperor brought his most trusted members of the royal guard with him to the second Death Star, where he was to oversee its construction and completion.

title: Governor Tarkin
lore: Commander of the original Death Star. Tarkin will stop at nothing to ensure the destruction of the Rebellion at Yavin IV. Despiser of non-human races.

title: Griff Mirtong
lore: Griff took 28:1 odds on Mawhonic winning the entire Boonta Eve Podrace. It’s aliens like these who Jabba and Watto making a living off of.

title: Gweeta
lore: Rodian smuggler with a reputation for selling goods that are low in supply and high in demand. Will switch her prospective buyers at a moment’s notice if the price is right.

title: Lord Vader, Lord Of The Sith

titleComponents.name: Lord Vader, Lord Of The Sith

lore: "That is the system, and I’m sure Skywalker’s with them"

title: SSA-33
lore: Infantry battle droid assigned guard duty in the Theed Palace docking bay. Experimented with brand new security subroutines that were to be used in the newer model battle droids.

title: TK-420
lore: One of several Stormtroopers in charge of prisoner detail on the Death Star. Despises races such as the Wookiees and Calamarians.

title: Watto, Junk Dealer
lore: "So-o-o-o...let-a me take-a thee out back...huh?"

title: Security Activators
lore: Device used in Theed Palace to prevent a mass invasion of the Theed Palace generator core - or to split up a pair of Jedi battling the worst enemy their generation has ever seen.

title: Yoda, Jedi Master
lore: "No! No, no! Stay and help you I will."

title: Alert My Star Destroyer!
gameText: If your admiral, moff or Dark Jedi just shuttled aboard your Star Destroyer, deploy on that character. Star Destroyer is immune to attrition and Flagship deploys free on that starship. Immediate Effect lost if character not aboard that starship.

title: Aratech Corporation
gameText: Deploy on Carida system. Your speeder bikes piloted by biker scouts are power +1 and forfeit +1 and may follow (for free) an opponent's vehicle or character that just moved from same site (if within range). (Immune to Alter while you occupy Carida.)

title: Back On Schedule
lore: The Emperor is coming here?

title: Battle Plains Victory
lore: Battle droid officers knew the Battle of Naboo was theirs to win - the planned cleanup and aftermath of the battle was even planned out beforehand for efficiency.

title: Begin Landing Your Troops & Activate The Droids
gameText: Deploy on your Blockade Flagship (may not deploy on a site). Whenever you initiate battle at a related planet site where you have a battle droid, you may activate 2 Force or retrieve 1 Force. Your unique (•) Republic Characters are forfeit +2 and immune to Goo Nee Tay. Unless Imperial Arrest Order on table, once during your deploy phase, may deploy one docking bay from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Blast Door Controls & Reactor Terminal
gameText: Deploy on table. Cancels: Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy, Narrow Escape, Blast The Door Kid!, and Rebel Barrier. Also, during your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.

title: Boonta Eve Wagering
lore: Not every bet at Boonta Eve took place through Watto or Jabba.

title: Crossfire
gameText: Deploy on table. When you fire two weapons (except lightsabers) in a battle, your total power is +5. Also, S-foils and Maneuvering Flaps are suspended where you have a weapon present or a starship with maneuver > 3 present. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Emperor's Power & Overseeing It Personally
gameText: Deploy on your Throne Room. You may not Force drain here. While Emperor here, opponent's characters are deploy +2 to Death Star II sites and, once per turn, you may lose Effect (or 1 Force from top of Reserve Deck) to add one battle destiny anywhere. Also, while Emperor is at a battleground planet site you control, at each related site where an Imperial is present, your Force drains are +1. Effect lost if Emperor lost from table. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Establish Secret Base & Ominous Rumors
gameText: Deploy on Endor system. Your Force drains at X other battleground systems are +1, where X = number of Endor sites you occupy. Your Force drains here are +2 while you control at least 2 Endor battleground sites with AT-STs and/or biker scouts. Place Effect in Used Pile if opponent controls this system or three Endor sites.

title: Young Skywalker
lore: "Luke’s just not a farmer, Owen. He has too much of his father in him."

title: Ewok Superstitions
lore: With Ewoks and droids it's a very love and hate type relationship.

title: Expand The Empire
gameText: Deploy on any site. 'Expands' your 'game text' for that site to add to your 'game text' at the adjacent sites.

title: Flagship Operations
gameText: Deploy on your Star Destroyer if at least 4 Executor sites on table. Your TIEs are deploy -1, forfeit +2 and destiny +1. At systems where you have a TIE, your Imperial capital starships are deploy -3 and your battle destiny draws are +1 each.

title: I Had No Choice
gameText: Deploy on an opponent's gambler. Cancels gambler's game text. If a battle was just initiated, you may use X Force to exclude gambler from that battle, where X = gambler's ability.

title: I Will Find Them Quickly Master

titleComponents.name: I Will Find Them Quickly, Master

gameText: Deploy on table. Opponent may deploy Amidala from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Maul is present with Amidala and no Jedi, she is captured. Once per game may take If The Trace Was Correct into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Imperial Compensation
lore: The Empire is known to call upon any resource in their arsenal in order to eliminate their enemies - including the worst kind of scum in the galaxy.

title: Imperial Decree & The Dark Path
gameText: Deploy on table. Whenever you control any two Rebel Base locations, or any one planet site and two systems, the effects of Revolution and all opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. Also, once per turn, you may peek at the top three cards of your Reserve Deck. Place two of those three in your Lost pile. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Imperial Firepower
lore: The only option the rebels had available to them at the Battle of Hoth was to evacuate as many resources as possible before they were overwhelmed.

title: Imperial Justice
gameText: If opponent is generating at least 4 more Force than you, deploy on a location to cancel all Force generation at that location. OR Deploy on a location. It is now immune to Revolution.

title: Jabba's Droid Pool
lore: EV-9D9 uses a wide variety of methods to insure the loyalty of his droids

title: Gungan Celebration Trumpet
lore: Instrument used by the Gungans at celebratory occasions. Its sound was never heard in Theed until the aftermath of the Battle of Naboo.

title: Jedi Rocks
lore: The Max Rebo Band! Playing every night and at every other time Jabba wants them to play.

title: Krayt Dragon Bones & Imperial Justice
gameText: If opponent is generating at least 4 more Force than you, deploy on a location to cancel all Force generation at that location. OR Deploy on a location, it is now immune to Revolution. Also, each opponent's destiny draw, you do the following: (0) Put top used card in hand; (1) lose 1 Force; (2) activate 1 Force; (3) lose this Effect; (4) retrieve 1 Force; (5) deploy a character for free; (6+) nothing.

title: Name The System!
lore: Senator Organa pressured into revealing the location of her Rebellious operations eventually lied to Tarkin in order to buy precious time for her rebel friends.

title: Not Worth The Trouble
lore: The lesson that Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba failed to learn was that when a Jedi wants to buy you a drink it's usually best to take him up on the offer.

title: One Arm's Frozen Lunch
lore: For lunch there was a frozen tauntaun to feast on. For dessert there was a warm Jedi apprentice to look forward to.

title: Open Fire!
gameText: Deploy on your AAT. Once during your control phase may use 3 Force to fire your AAT Laser Cannon on this AAT for free.

title: Perfect Hibernation
lore: Freezing Han Solo in carbonite proved to be an efficient delivery system for Boba Fett's prize.

title: Performing Under Pressure
lore: Scrambling to repair your freighter while being chased by a fleet of Star Destroyers can take its toll on a smuggler's mind. For Han Solo it brought chaos to his entire ship.

title: Perimeter Patrol
gameText: Deploy on Bunker. While you control Bunker, each time opponent deploys a vehicle, starship or Rebel to an Endor site (except Rebel Landing Site), that card cannot move or battle for remainder of turn and opponent must lose 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Presence Of The Force & Dark Waters
gameText: Deploy on any exterior planet site (except Hoth) to add one [Dark] and one [Light]. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. (Immune to Alter when a swamp creature is present.)

title: Anakin Skywalker
lore: Vader. "He can help you." "You refer to the prophecy of the one who will bring balance to the Force." "The boy is dangerous. They all sense it. Why can’t you?"

title: A Gift
gameText: If you just moved a droid to Audience Chamber, deploy on that droid. Droid is an undercover spy. Wherever opponent has an alien, opponent's battle destiny draws are -2 and Force drains are -1. Effect lost if droid leaves Tatooine. (Immune to Control.)

title: Quick Reflexes & All Wrapped Up
gameText: Deploy on table. We Have A Prisoner plays for free and is immune to Sense. Also, whenever opponent forfeits a character, your bounty hunter present may capture that character. Also, during your draw phase, you may use 2 Force to search through your Lost Pile and take any one Hidden Weapons into hand. (Immune to Alter while you occupy three Jabba's Palace sites.)

title: Quietly Observing
gameText: Deploy on Aurra Sing. While Aurra is alone at a site, your total ability here = 0. During your move phase, may lose Effect to target an opponent's lightsaber present. Draw destiny. If destiny > 3, Aurra may 'steal' that lightsaber.

title: Relentless Tracking
gameText: Deploy on opponent's non-droid character at same or adjacent site as your scout. During each of your control phases, if your scout is at this site (and not Undercover), opponent loses 2 Force (or 3 Force if that scout is also a biker scout).

title: Responsibility Of Command
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on any war room at a Rebel Base. Target a Rebel with forfeit > 4 or an opponent's leader. Opponent may not initiate a battle or a Force drain at same location as target. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.

title: Sarlacc Tentacles
lore: Don’t get caught too close.

title: Scum And Villainy
gameText: Deploy on Audience Chamber. While all your ability on table is provided by aliens and independent starship pilots, your aliens and starships deploy -1 and you retrieve 2 Force whenever you initiate battle. (Immune to Alter if you control at least three Jabba's Palace sites.)

title: Scum And Villainy & Information Exchange
gameText: Deploy on Audience Chamber. Whenever you have an Information Broker at a location where you just initiated a battle, you may examine the top four cards of opponent's Reserve Deck. You may then lose 1 Force to cancel the battle. Also, while all of your ability on table is provided only by aliens and independent starship pilots, your aliens and starships deploy -1 and you retrieve 2 Force whenever you initiate battle. (Immune to Alter if you control three Jabba's Palace sites.)

title: Search And Destroy
gameText: Deploy on table. During every draw phase, unless opponent's character of destiny < 4 occupies a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. Biker scouts are forfeit +1. Effect canceled unless your characters of destiny < 4 occupy two battleground sites.

title: Security Precautions
gameText: Deploy on a location. Your Force generation is +1 here. If you 'probe' opponent's "Hidden Base" system, opponent loses X Force; X = 15 - number of systems on table. You take no battle damage where you have a 'probe' card. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Tatooine Resale Operations
lore: Jawas such as Coilen are known to sell the cheapest droids at the highest prices. For Tatooine citizens it's the only droid resource they have.

title: Ackbar's Assault Plan
lore: Admiral Ackbar and General Madine's plan to eliminate the Empire had its fair share of setbacks.

title: Tatooine Underground Operations
lore: The agendas and intentions of some Tatooine citizens have consequences that border on the improper.

title: This Is Outrageous! & Motion Supported
gameText: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to cancel an opponent's Force drain or to add 2 to your next Force drain at a battleground this turn. If a trade agenda here, once during your turn, you may place a card from hand in Lost Pile, shuffle that pile, and take top card into hand. If a wealth agenda here, once per turn, you may lose your just drawn battle destiny to substitute it with a card from hand.

title: Visage Of A Viceroy
lore: They must be dead by now. Destroy what’s left of them. Hologram.

title: Watto's Box & Quietly Observing
gameText: Deploy on table if all of your race totals = 0. When a player wins a Podrace, adds 5 to the amount retrieved. When a player loses a Podrace, adds 5 to the amount lost. Also, while Aurra Sing is alone at a site, your total ability at that site = 0. During your move phase, may lose Effect to target an opponent's lightsaber present with Aurra Sing. Draw destiny. If destiny > 3, Aurra Sing may 'steal' that lightsaber. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Weapon Malfunction
gameText: Deploy on any docking bay. Target a weapon deployed on a starfighter or vehicle. That weapon cannot be fired. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.

title: Well Guarded & Security Precautions
gameText: Deploy on table. If you 'probe' opponent's "Hidden Base" system, opponent loses X Force, where X = 15 - number of systems on table. You take no battle damage where you have a 'probe' card. Also, while you have fewer than 13 cards in your hand, your non-unique cards in hand (except effects of any kind and any interrupts) are immune to Grimtaash. (Immune to Alter while you occupy 2 battlegrounds).

title: Well-earned Command
gameText: Deploy on your general or commander. When battling, adds 1 to your total battle destiny (or 2 if Igar). Once during your control phase, may take Imperial Propaganda into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your Force drains are +1 at holosites.

title: Worry
lore: It was almost too much for Shmi to take in as she watched her son take part in one of the most dangerous sports in the galaxy.

title: Your Destiny & Insignificant Rebellion
gameText: Deploy on Bring Him Before Me. When Vader is present at a battleground site, at start of your turn opponent loses 3 Force unless Luke is captured, out of play or present at a battleground site. Luke is immune to Responsibility Of Command. Also, each time you win a battle, opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down. When attempting to cross Luke over (except with Epic Duel), add 3 to total destiny for each card in stack. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Always Thinking With Your Stomach & Scout Recon
gameText: USED: Add 1 to landspeed of your scout at an exterior planet site for remainder of turn. OR if Igar is with Grond or Dyer in battle, draw one destiny and subtract it from opponent's attrition against you. LOST: Cancel a Force drain at an exterior planet site where opponent has no vehicles or starships. Draw destiny. If destiny > number of opponent's characters at that site, choose one of those characters to be missing.

title: Aim High
gameText: Deploy on table. When you fire two weapons (except lightsabers) in a battle, your total power is +5. Also, whenever opponent retrieves X cards, opponent must first use X Force or that retrieval is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Atmospheric Assault
gameText: If you just initiated a battle at a Cloud City sector, add one battle destiny. OR During your deploy phase, deploy one TIE Assault Squadron for free (no replacement is necessary).

title: Begin Retreat!
lore: The rebels knew when the time had come to abandon their posts.

title: Ben?
lore: After being attacked by a one armed wampa and stranded on an ice plain, Ben chose to approach Luke about his next objective.

title: Blow Parried
gameText: Take top card of Force Pile into hand. OR Cancel a just-revealed combat card (place in opponent's Used Pile) and opponent must draw destiny instead (that destiny is reduced by 1). OR Cancel Glancing Blow, Clash Of Sabers, or Obi-Wan's Journal.

title: Boba Fett? Where?!
lore: Fett's opportunity to capture a Jedi Knight was just too good to pass up.

title: Brief Loss Of Control & Imperial Supply
gameText: USED: Lose 1 Force to activate 2 Force. LOST: Just after the weapons phase of a battle, use 2 Force to cause each player to target one of that player's characters involved in the battle. Target characters cannot apply their ability toward drawing battle destiny this turn. OR Lose 1 Force to activate 4 Force.

title: Cannon Fire
lore: When all else fails, just fire as much as possible.

title: Cold Feet & He Hasn't Come Back Yet
gameText: Target a character at any marker site. Draw destiny. If total destiny > ability, character may not move for remainder of turn. OR During your control phase, target any character alone at one of your exterior planet sites (except a docking bay). Draw destiny. Target is missing if destiny +3 > ability.

title: Combat Readiness & Prepared Defenses
gameText: USED: If a battle was just initiated, draw destiny and activate up to that much Force. STARTING: If you have not deployed an Objective, deploy from Reserve Deck one battleground site related to your starting location. Also, you may deploy up to two Effects if each of them deploys for free, is always immune to Alter and has "Deploy on table" (or "deploy on your side of table") in its game text. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Counter Surprise Assault
gameText: Cancel Surprise Assault. OR Use 4 Force to cancel opponent's Force drain at a mobile site. Deploy (for free) from Reserve Deck any number of non-unique troopers to that site. (Light Side characters, vehicles and starships here may 'escape' to Used Pile).

title: Bad Lifters And Faulty Wings
lore: "No, no! No! This one goes there, that one goes there, right?"

title: Dark Collaboration & Charming To The Last
gameText: If Tarkin and either Tagge or Motti are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. (If Tarkin is also with Leia, add two additional battle destiny.)

title: Dark Jedi Presence
gameText: If one of your Dark Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Imperials there to battle at double power.

title: Dark Jedi Presence & Vader's Eye
gameText: If Vader is defending a battle alone at a site, add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. OR If any other Imperial with ability > 2 is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny. OR If one of your Dark Jedi is present during any battle, use 1 Force to cause all other Imperials there to battle at double power.

title: Dark Maneuvers
gameText: Add 2 to maneuver and 1 to power of any starfighter for remainder of turn. If it has hyperdrive, also add 2 to hyperspeed. (Interrupt may even affect the result immediately after a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver.)

title: Dioxis
gameText: Use 2 Force to target two opponent's Jedi at same interior battleground. Targets may not participate in battle for remainder of turn. OR Target opponent's Jedi. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn.

title: Dioxis & They're Still Coming Through!
gameText: USED: Cancel Rebel Barrier, It's A Trap!, or Smoke Screen. OR Re-target Fallen Portal by choosing up to two of opponent's characters there instead of your own. OR Peek at the top card of your Force Pile; either return it, or place it under your Force Pile or Reserve Deck. LOST: Target opponent's Jedi. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn.

title: Disciplinary Actions
lore: Vader had to kill someone from time to time just to keep the rest of his officers in check.

title: Drop Your Weapons & Halt!
gameText: If your battle droid just fired a blaster and hit a character, all opponent's weapons at same site are lost. OR During any deploy phase, target a character at same site as your battle droid. Target is landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn. OR If opponent just deployed a character to same site as your battle droid, opponent must use 1 Force or place that character in hand.

title: Elis Helrot & Oo-ta Goo-ta Solo?
gameText: If Nabrun Leids just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Nabrun is lost and all Rebels transported are captured. (Immune to Sense.) OR At any time (except during battle), target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to any one other site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile. OR Prevent a smuggler from moving this turn. OR Cancel a Kessel Run.

title: Entry Denied
lore: After injecting so much fury into his battle with the Jedi, Darth Maul was forced to play a waiting game in order to eliminate his targets.

title: Beggar & Revolution
gameText: Use 3 Force to deploy on a location. Rotate the location so that the icons and game texts switch direction. (If Expand the Empire present, it also switches.) If Effect later canceled, location rotates back again. Also, you may use any amount of Force in the opponent's Force Pile during your turns. However, if you use more than 1 of the opponent's Force in a turn, Effect is lost at the end of that turn.

title: Flag Emblems
lore: Before a podrace, flags of the participating pilots are raised in a salute to what usually promises to be an exciting event.

title: Force Lightning
gameText: Target a character (even a captive) present with Emperor. USED: Target is defense value -4 for rest of turn. LOST: Emperor loses immunity to attrition and is defense value -2 for rest of turn. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value.

title: Force Lightning & Rise, My Friend
gameText: Target any character (even a captive) present with Emperor. USED: Target is defense value -4 for remainder of turn. LOST: Emperor loses immunity to attrition and is defense value -2 for remainder of turn. Draw Destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value. OR If Emperor on Death Star II, take Vader into hand from a location you control (cards on him go to owner's hand).

title: Great Interest
lore: Senator Palpatine was curious to find out more about Anakin Skywalker's past as well as his future.

title: Hidden Weapons & Twi'lek Advisor
gameText: If Boba Fett, or your character with Mandalorian Armor is present during the weapons phase of a battle, target one opponent's character present. Draw Destiny: (0-1) no effect; (2-3) character immediately captured; (4-5) character is hit; (6+) character immediately lost. OR Use 3 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Effect of any kind into hand; reshuffle.

title: Hit Racer
gameText: During your control phase, use 2 Force to target an opponent's Podracer with a race total within 4 of one of your race totals. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's destiny number, opponent may not draw race destiny this turn and target is 'damaged.'

title: I Didn't Mean To...
lore: Eliminating 3PO was the only way to keep the Empire's secret safe on Cloud City. Fortunately for them Han blamed the droid's curiosity for his disappearance.

title: I Have You Now & Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man

titleComponents.name: Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man

gameText: If a Dark Jedi and a Rebel with ability > 2 are involved in the same battle, you may add one battle destiny (add two destiny if Rebel is Luke, three destiny if Rebel is Obi-Wan).

title: Imbalance & Shocking Revelation
gameText: Target a location. Scomp Links there cannot be used for remainder of turn. OR If opponent is about to scan or otherwise look through your hand (unless using Grimtaash), opponent continues but must lose 4 Force plus the card allowing the scan. OR If opponent just retrieved Force, opponent must lose X Force, where X = one-half the number of cards retrieved (round up).

title: Imperial Command
gameText: Take one admiral or general into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your admiral is in battle at a system (or your general is in battle at a site) either add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny.

title: Bring Me The Hydrospanners!
lore: When nothing works, just start hitting things and something's bound to happen.

title: Imperial Command & It's An Older Code
gameText: USED: Take one admiral or general into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your admiral is in battle at a system (or your general is in a battle at a site), you may either add one battle destiny or prevent opponent from drawing more than one battle destiny. LOST: Use 2 Force to 'scan' (reveal) opponent's hand. You may place one starship you find there in opponent's Used Pile.

title: Imperial Data Network
lore: Used as a central information resource the Imperial data network can be used to track intruders, access information or rescue damsels in distress.

title: Imperial Detachments
lore: The last place an undercover operative wants to be in is a spaceport that's flooded with Imperial troops on the lookout for anything suspicious.

title: Imperial Supply
gameText: USED: Lose 1 Force to activate 2 Force. LOST: Lose 1 Force to activate 4 Force.

title: In The Pits
lore: Statistically, racers that have human crews tending to them perform better than racers tended by pit droids. Most pilots however will take anything they can get.

title: Informant & Takeel
gameText: USED: If a battle was just initiated at same site as your Undercover spy, your characters at adjacent sites may move there as a 'react' (for free). OR Cancel Sabotage. LOST: If both players just drew one battle destiny, use 1 Force to switch numbers.

title: Is There Something Alive Down Here?

titleComponents.name: Is There Something Alive Down Here?

lore: Something just moved past my leg!

title: I've Got A Problem Here & Physical Choke
gameText: Use 1 Force to target opponent's starfighter with maneuver at a system or sector where a battle just finished. Draw destiny. Starfighter lost if destiny > maneuver. OR If a Dark Jedi is present at a battle you have just won, use 1 Force to attempt to choke an opposing character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's ability, target is lost.

title: Jabba's Through With You
gameText: If your bounty hunter just fired a character weapon during a battle, add one battle destiny. OR During your deploy phase, deploy on your bounty hunter one character weapon from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Jabba's Through With You & Nevar Yalnal
gameText: If your bounty hunter just fired a character weapon during a battle, add one battle destiny. OR During your deploy phase, deploy on your bounty hunter one character weapon from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Target an opponent's spy at same site as your spy or bounty hunter, draw destiny. Target is lost if destiny > 2. If target is Undercover, it is lost if destiny > 0.

title: Brisky Morning Munchen
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, may deploy Jar Jar from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just lost Jar Jar from a site, may place him here. At any time, may use 3 Force to take Jar Jar from here into hand.

title: Local Trouble
gameText: Use 1 Force at the beginning of your battle phase to allow any two Stormtroopers in the Cantina to battle any one opponent's character (your choice). You may add one battle destiny. No other battles may occur in Cantina this turn.

title: Locked Door
lore: Luke's first attempted escape from the rancor pit got him nothing but a mocking from Jabba's court.

title: Look Sir, Droids & Counter Assault
gameText: USED: Use 1 Force to search opponent's Used Pile and place any droids you find there to opponent's Lost Pile. LOST: Use X Force to destroy any one droid on table where X = that droid's deploy cost. OR Use 1 Force to cancel an opponent's Force drain at a location. Draw one destiny for each character, starship, and vehicle the opponent has present (limit 2). Compare your destiny total with opponent's total power. Player with lowest total loses Force equal to difference.

title: Master, Destroyers! & Rolling, Rolling, Rolling
gameText: USED: Target a character at same site as two of your destroyer droids. For remainder of turn, target may not fire weapons and is power -2. OR Take any non-unique destroyer droid into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your deploy phase, relocate your destroyer droid to an adjacent site. LOST: Lose 1 Force to take up to three non-unique destroyer droids into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Maul Strikes & No Match For A Sith
gameText: If Maul in battle with a Jedi, add one battle destiny (two if Jedi is Qui-Gon). OR Use 1 Force to take any lightsaber into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Target a Jedi present with Maul; they duel: Both players draw 2 destiny. Loser (lowest total) is lost. OR if Maul armed with a lightsaber in battle, use 2 Force to draw two destiny. Opponent draws two destiny. If any of your destinies equal any of opponent's destinies, opponent's Jedi is power = 0 for remainder of battle.

title: None Shall Pass
gameText: If opponent just deployed a Rebel to a Jabba's Palace site, (and you have no Imperials at a Jabba's Palace site), return Rebel to opponent's hand. Any Force used to deploy that Rebel remains used, and Rebel may not be deployed for the remainder of the turn.

title: Oo-ta Goo-ta Solo?
gameText: If Nabrun Leids just completed a transport, use 2 Force. Nabrun is lost and all Rebels transported are captured. (Immune to Sense.) OR Prevent a just-deployed smuggler from moving this turn. OR Cancel a Kessel Run.

title: Operational As Planned & Wounded Warrior
gameText: USED: Cancel Leia's game text for remainder of turn. OR If your weapon (except a lightsaber) just 'hit' an opponent's character, for rest of turn that character is power = 0 and may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny. OR Place one card from hand on top of Force Pile. STARTING: If Endor system on table, take Death Star II system, Jerjerrod and any Effect into hand from Reserve Deck. When you draw your starting hand, draw only six more cards. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Our First Catch Of The Day

titleComponents.name: Our First Catch Of The Day

gameText: Add 2 to a tractor beam destiny draw. OR Cancel The First Transport Is Away! or Hyper Escape.

title: Overwhelmed & A Dark Time For The Rebellion

titleComponents.name: A Dark Time For The Rebellion

gameText: During your deploy phase, target a system where your total power is more than double opponent's total power and opponent has no Jedi or starship weapon. Place all opponent's starships there (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. OR If opponent just deployed a planet site, deploy the related system from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Close Air Support
gameText: Deploy on table. While your Z-95 occupies a system or cloud sector, once per turn your scout at a related exterior site may add one battle destiny (if Z-95 is Tala 1 or Tala 2, may also add one destiny to total power only).

title: Pit Crews
gameText: Use 3 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has 3 or more of in hand are lost. OR Use 1 Force to 'repair' your Podracer. OR Target a Podracer. Draw destiny. If destiny > Podracer's destiny number, target Podracer is 'damaged.'

title: Podracer Collision
gameText: USED: If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, search that Reserve Deck and place one Interrupt found there out of play. LOST: Lose 1 Force to remove a race destiny (random selection) from any Podracer and place it in owner's hand.

title: Podracer Collision & Hit Racer
gameText: During your control phase, use 2 Force to target opponent's Podracer with a race total within 4 of one of your race totals. Draw destiny. If destiny > target Podracer's destiny number, opponent may not draw race destiny this turn and target Podracer is 'damaged.' OR Lose 1 Force to remove a race destiny (random selection) from any Podracer and place it in owner's hand.

title: Point Man & Slip Sliding Away
gameText: Relocate a card from the top of any Deck or Pile to the bottom (without looking). OR Cancel Demotion, Restricted Deployment, Commence Recharging, Logistical Delay, They're On Dantooine, Asteroid Sanctuary, Scramble, Order To Engage, No Disintegrations, Asteroids Do Not Concern Me, Report To Lord Vader or What Is Thy Bidding, My Master?

title: Projective Telepathy
gameText: Cancel Anger, Fear, Aggression when it is inserted or revealed. OR If your opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain, opponent must choose to use 2 Force, or cancel that battle or Force drain.

title: Put All Sections On Alert & Full Scale Alert
gameText: USED: Target one Rebel at a Death Star (or Executor) site. Target may not use its game text and may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny. (Immune to Sense). LOST: Use 2 Force. Draw Destiny. If destiny < number of Imperials of ability = 3 on table, all opponent's movement is blocked for the remainder of this turn (except for smugglers and the starships they are aboard).

title: Release Your Anger & Unexpected Interruption
gameText: Use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one Interrupt into hand. Shuffle, cut, and replace. OR If opponent just initiated a battle, you may do one of the following: Add one destiny to your total power only. OR If you have a character weapon present, select one opponent's character present to lose all immunity to attrition for remainder of battle.

title: Rolling, Rolling, Rolling
gameText: Take any non-unique destroyer droid into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your deploy phase, relocate your destroyer droid to an adjacent site.

title: Security Sweep
lore: Stormtroopers securing areas of the Death Star found evidence that intruders were aboard their battle station and that these intruders enjoyed locking droids in closets.

title: Short Range Fighters
gameText: Once per game, target one non-unique starfighter on table. Draw destiny. If destiny < X, retrieve X Force, where X = number of copies of that card you have on table. (Immune to Sense.) OR Take one non-unique starfighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Close Air Support & Commando Training
gameText: Deploy on table. While your Z-95 occupies a system or cloud sector, once per turn your scout at a related exterior site may add one battle destiny (if Z-95 is Tala 1 or Tala 2, may also add one destiny to total power only). Also, each of your non-unique Rebels armed with a non-unique blaster is forfeit +2, adds 1 to his total weapon destiny and, where present, cumulatively adds 1 to total battle destiny. (Immune to Alter while your non-unique blaster is on table.)

title: Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down & Voyeur

titleComponents.name: Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down

gameText: USED: Cancel Death Star Plans, The Professor, Bacta Tank, How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Shoo! Shoo! or Thank The Maker. OR Name an Interrupt card. Opponent must reveal entire Used Pile, without shuffling. Then you choose: USED: Opponent must lose 1 Force for each copy of that interrupt found there. LOST: Each copy of that Interrupt found there is lost.

title: Sniper
gameText: During your control phase, fire one of your weapons. If URoRRuR'R'R firing, may add 2 to each weapon destiny draw. (A seeker may be targeted by a character weapon using a defense value of 4.) Any 'hit' targets are immediately lost.

title: Something Hit Us! & Why Didn't You Tell Me?
gameText: USED: Cancel Noble Sacrifice, Gift Of The Mentor, or Old Ben. LOST: If Luke is defending a battle, draw one destiny. Subtract that amount from opponent's attrition and total power (cannot fall below zero). OR During a battle, lose 1 Force. Cumulatively adds 1 to attrition against opponent.

title: Speeder Downed
lore: The last place a pilot wants to be in is a crashed vehicle at the mercy of an AT-AT pilot.

title: Squabbling Delegates
gameText: Once per game, retrieve 1 Force for each of your senators at Galactic Senate. (Immune to Sense.) OR Take one senator (or Coruscant Guard) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Start Your Engines! & Pit Crews
gameText: LOST: Use 3 Force to reveal opponent's hand. All cards opponent has 3 or more of in hand are lost. OR Use 1 Force to 'repair' your Podracer. OR Target a Podracer. Draw destiny. If destiny > Podracer's destiny number, target Podracer is 'damaged.' STARTING: Deploy Podrace Arena (with a Podracer, opponent may also deploy a Podracer there), Boonta Eve Podrace, and any Effect that deploys for free. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.

title: Surprise & E Chu Ta
gameText: USED: One of your protocol Droids 'insults' one character present, canceling that character's game text for remainder of turn. OR During your battle phase, initiate a battle where both players have droids (but no presence or spies). Both sides add one battle destiny. LOST: Use 3 Force to relocate any Effect (except those immune to Alter) deployed on a location to another appropriate location.

title: Tactical Support
gameText: Lose 1 Force to take up to three troopers into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Tallon Roll
gameText: Target two starfighters (your TIE/ln and any Rebel starfighter) present at same system or sector. Each player draws destiny. Opponent totals destiny and starship's power. You total destiny, TIE's power and TIE's maneuver. Lowest total loses starfighter.

title: The Circle Is Now Complete
gameText: If Vader and Obi-Wan are present at same site, use 1 Force to initiate a duel between them. Compare their power, and add 2 if that character is armed with a lightsaber. Loser (lowest total) of duel is placed out of play.

title: Congratulations
lore: Rebel officers hadn't celebrated in years when they destroyed the second Death Star. Finally, their moment of triumph had arrived.

title: The Circle Is Now Complete & Vader's Obsession
gameText: If Vader and Obi-Wan are present at same site, use 1 Force to initiate a duel between them. Compare their power, and add 2 if that character is armed with a lightsaber. Loser (lowest total) of duel is placed out of play. OR During your move phase, if Vader moves to Luke's site from an adjacent site, begin a duel between them. Each adds two destiny to power. Winner retrieves lost Force equal to the difference. Loser loses same amount of Force, plus the character.

title: They're Still Coming Through
gameText: Cancel Rebel Barrier, It's A Trap!, or Smoke Screen. OR Re-target Fallen Portal by choosing up to two of opponent's characters there instead of your own. OR Peek at the top card of your Force Pile; either return it, or place it under your Force Pile or Reserve Deck.

title: Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
gameText: USED: Cancel Nabrun Leids. LOST: During your move phase, cancel Landing Claw. OR Cancel Hyper Escape, Closer?! or one 'react.'

title: Through The Corridor
gameText: If opponent just initiated battle against Maul where opponent has two Jedi, cancel that battle and you may relocate one of those Jedi (your choice) to any adjacent site. That Jedi may not move for remainder of turn. (Immune to Sense.)

title: Trade Federation Tactics & We're Hit Artoo
gameText: USED: Once during battle, target a participating starfighter present with your droid starfighter. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's defense value, target 'hit.' OR If opponent's starfighter was just 'hit' where your droid starfighter is present, activate up to 4 Force. LOST: During battle, add X to your total power, where x = armor of one of your Trade Federation starships in that battle.

title: Trample & Lightsaber Deficiency
gameText: Target a character, 'crashed' vehicle or unpiloted vehicle with maneuver at same exterior site as one of your piloted AT-ATs or AT-STs. Draw destiny. Character lost if destiny > ability. Vehicle lost if destiny < 7. OR Cancel Lightsaber Proficiency. OR Target a character with ability < 4 using a lightsaber in a battle or a Force drain. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > ability. Lightsaber lost if destiny = ability.

title: Trap Door
gameText: If you have no characters in the rancor pit at the end of your deploy phase, target a character (even a captive) at audience chamber. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > ability, target relocated to Rancor Pit, and, if captive, released to Light Side of Rancor Pit.

title: Trooper Assault & Tactical Support
gameText: USED: If a battle was just initiated at a site, each of your troopers present is power +2 and immune to attrition until end of turn. LOST: Lose 1 Force to take up to three troopers from your Reserve Deck into hand; reshuffle.

title: Twilight Fading
lore: "There is...another...Sky...walker."

title: Uncertain Is The Future
gameText: Use 3 Force. Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand.

title: Chewbacca
lore: Smuggler. Was attempting to repair the Millennium Falcon before the Empire located the rebel base on the planet Hoth. Known to enjoy the rug hug.

title: Crack Shot & Quick Draw
gameText: Deploy on table. Any card which is 'hit' may not be used to satisfy attrition. Also, once during your draw phase, you may use 2 Force to deploy a blaster from your Lost Pile (for free). (Immune to Alter.)

title: Unexpected Interruption
gameText: Use 2 Force to take one Interrupt into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

title: Vote Now!
gameText: During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate.

title: Watto's Chance Cube & You Swindled Me!
gameText: USED: If Watto is in a battle at a site, draw destiny. If destiny is odd, your total battle destiny = 0 this battle. If destiny is even, add two battle destiny. LOST: Opponent chooses: opponent may activate up to 2 Force and you may activate up to 4 Force, or opponent retrieves 1 Force and you retrieve 3 Force.

title: We Have A Prisoner
gameText: Use 1 Force if opponent just lost or forfeited a character from battle. Character is captured instead. OR Use X Force to capture all characters aboard a captured starship, where X = twice the number of characters.

title: We Must Accelerate Our Plans & Vote Now!
gameText: Use 3 Force to take one Effect of any kind into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Deploy a Blockade Flagship site from your Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Take one Interrupt with the word "Podracer(s)" in its game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your control phase, draw destiny. If destiny > 2, draw up to X cards (maximum 4) from Reserve Deck, where X = your total politics at Galactic Senate minus opponent's total politics at Galactic Senate.

title: We Would Be Honored If You Would Join Us

titleComponents.name: We Would Be Honored If You Would Join Us

lore: I had no choice. They arrived right before you did.

title: Where Are You Taking This...Thing?
lore: Escorting Wookiees around a Death Star isn't exactly an activity you want to perform if you're trying not to be noticed.

title: You Are Beaten
gameText: Use 2 Force to target a character present with your warrior with a lightsaber. Target cannot move or battle until end of your next turn. OR Use 1 Force to take I Am Your Father into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel Uncontrollable Fury.

title: You Will Meet Your Destiny
lore: Vader was going to make sure Luke paid the price for not giving into his anger. Having been down the same path himself he knew he would get his son to turn eventually.

title: Star Destroyer Executor
lore: Command ship at the Battle of Endor. Given orders to stay out of combat during the battle because the Emperor had something special planned for them.

title: Crash Site Memorial
gameText: Deploy on table. You may place lost vehicles, droids, weapons and devices here instead of Lost Pile. Once each turn, during your deploy phase, you may exchange any one hand card with one card from your 'memorial'.

title: Blizzard Scout 4
lore: AT-ST walker assigned to the left flank at the Battle of Hoth. One of the first Imperial units to break through the Rebel defense perimeter. Enclosed.

title: Credits Will Do Fine & We're Leaving
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. If you just initiated a Force drain (or won a battle) at Watto's Junkyard, opponent loses 1 Force (cannot be reduced) and stacks lost card here face down. Also, if you just forfeited all your cards that participated in a battle that opponent initiated, you may place this Effect out of play to cancel all remaining battle damage; place all cards here in owner's Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Gungan Energy Shield
gameText: Deploy on an exterior site. While your Fambaa here: your characters here may not be targeted by weapons, opponent's battle destiny draws here are -1, and characters must use +1 Force when moving to or from here using their landspeed.

title: Hiding In The Garbage
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on table. At any time, you may declare a card type. Use Force one by one, revealing each card used, until a card of that type is revealed (take it into hand) or Force Pile is depleted.

title: I Hope She's All Right
gameText: Deploy on table. During every draw phase, unless opponent's character of destiny < 4 occupies a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. Effect canceled unless your characters of destiny < 4 occupy two battleground sites.

title: I Must Be Allowed To Speak

titleComponents.name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak

gameText: Deploy on a Jabba's Palace site. Luke may deploy at this site regardless of presence or location deployment restrictions. When he is deployed here, relocate Effect to Luke, he is immune to attrition while on Tatooine. (Immune to Alter.)

title: I Must Be Allowed To Speak & Goo Nee Tay

titleComponents.name: I Must Be Allowed To Speak

gameText: Deploy on a Jabba's Palace site. Luke may deploy at this site regardless of presence or location deployment restrictions. When he is deployed here, relocate Effect to Luke, he is immune to attrition while on Tatooine and all opponent's characters of ability > 2 are deploy +2 here. (Immune to Alter.)

title: I Thought He Was Blind
lore: He apparently can see much better now.

title: I Will Not Defer & Plea To The Court
gameText: Deploy on table. If no senator here, you may place a senator here from hand to cancel an opponent's Force drain or to add 2 to your next Force drain at a battleground this turn. If a peace agenda here, once per turn you may activate up to 2 Force when opponent initiates battle. If a justice agenda here, during a battle where opponent has a weapon and you do not, may cancel a just drawn weapon destiny to cause a re-draw.

title: Commander Myron Konkle
lore: Electronics expert who assisted in the analysis of the Death Star data supplied by R2-D2. Former Imperial engineer who defected from the Star Destroyer Avenger.

title: Inspecting The Garbage
lore: Chewbacca made some new friends when he found C-3PO in the Cloud City incinerator.

title: Is Your Strike Team Assembled?
lore: "My team's assembled but I don't have a command crew for the shuttle."

title: Lapti Nek
lore: "Rat a ran wim joct co jappi qaff."

title: Launching The Assault
gameText: Deploy on a system. Once per game, you may take Home One into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Force drains are +1 at battleground systems where you have a Star Cruiser piloted by a character. Effect canceled if Rendezvous Point on table. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Looking To The Future
lore: With Cloud City and Hoth behind them it was time for the Rebel Alliance to regroup and rebuild.

title: Obi-Wan's Cape & Lightsaber Proficiency
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on a character with ability > 2 armed with a lightsaber. That character is power +3 in battles, immune to attrition < 5, and may add 1 to Force drain where present. Also, when present at the start of a battle, may use 1 Force to cause one opponent's character of ability = 1 (your choice) to move away (for free), or that character is immediately lost. Effect lost if character loses lightsaber.

title: Prisoner Transfer
lore: Using Stormtrooper uniforms to disguise yourself in an Imperial battlestation - good plan.

title: Projection Of A Skywalker & Yarna d'al' Gargan
gameText: Deploy on any planet site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Also, while you have fewer than 13 cards in hand, your non-unique cards in hand (except Effects of any kind and Interrupts) are immune to Monnok. (Immune to Alter while you occupy 2 battlegrounds.)

title: Revolution
gameText: Use 3 Force to deploy on any location. Rotate the location so that icons and game texts switch direction. (If Expand the Empire present, it also switches.) If Revolution later canceled, location rotates back again.

title: Scramble
gameText: Deploy on opponent's side of table. Opponent's pilots (except Vader) present at sites may not use ability to draw battle destiny. Effect canceled when opponent has no pilots at sites.

title: Drem Redins
lore: Ishi Tib gambler responsible for handling and paying out on small wagers at Boonta Eve. Rumored to be losing money because of his odds not being as desirable as Jabba’s.

title: Scramble & Hiding In The Garbage
gameText: Deploy on table. At any time, you may declare a card type. Use Force one by one, revealing each card used, until a card of that type is revealed (take it into hand) or Force Pile is depleted. Also, opponent's pilots (except Vader) present at sites may not use ability to draw battle destiny. Effect canceled when opponent has no pilots at sites.

title: That's The Real Trick
lore: "Let's just say we'd like to avoid any Imperial entanglements."

title: They All Broken
lore: The weakness of battle droids is in that they must rely on a central command source. Gungans on the other hand rely on leaders such as Jar Jar Binks to guide them.

title: This Is Your Father's Lightsaber
lore: "Not as clumsy or random as a blaster."

title: Through The Planet Core
lore: "Master what's a bongo?" The way to Theed was a bit more complicated than that of an underwater joy ride.

title: Traffic Control
gameText: Use 1 Force to deploy on table. During your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.

title: Traffic Control & Crash Site Memorial
gameText: Deploy on table. You may place lost vehicles, droids, weapons, and devices here instead of Lost Pile. Once during your deploy phase, you may exchange any one card from hand with one card from your 'memorial.' Also, during your control phase, you may return any cards from your hand to the top of your Used Pile.

title: We Are Brave, Your Highness
lore: "Then I will plead our case to the Senate."

title: You Must Complete Your Training
