gameText: May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. While Rebel Aces on table, pilot is forfeit +2 and this starship may not be lost before the damage segment of battle. Matching starship for any Rogue Squadron pilot.

title: Mercenary Shadow Pirate
lore: ISB. Female.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Opponent may not add destiny draws to power or attrition here. Ice Storm and Sandwhirl are canceled at same and related locations.

title: Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach
lore: Leader.
gameText: [Pilot] 3. Once per game, may [upload] a TIE Defender. While piloting, opponent may not cancel or substitute battle destiny draws here. While piloting an Imperial starfighter, it is maneuver +2 and he draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.

title: Guild Of Assassins
lore: Greedo cheskopokuta klees ruya Solo. Hoko yanee boopa gush Cantina. Cheeco wa Solo's anye nyuma Greedo vakee. Jabba kul steeka et en anpaw.
gameText: Deploy on table. Maul is lost. Once per character, when you deploy Aurra, Galen, Guri, or Mara to a Coruscant or Tatooine site, may take any one card from Used Pile into hand; reshuffle. At locations you occupy, your Force generation may not be prevented or canceled. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Cloud City: Dining Room
locationDarkSideGameText: Vader, your Boba Fett, and your Lando deploy -1 here. May [download] Lando here.
locationLightSideGameText: Chewie, Han, Leia, and your Lando move to here using landspeed for free.

title: Rystall
lore: Musician. Raised by Ortolans. Grew up on the streets of Coruscant. Rescued from the Black Sun crime cartel by Lando Calrissian.
gameText: Power and forfeit +2 at a Coruscant site. Once per turn, if you just deployed a Black Sun agent to same site, may retrieve 1 Force. If opponent's [Maintenance] card just deployed here, it may not battle for remainder of turn.

title: Salacious Crumb
lore: Male Kowakian. Prankster. Humiliates others for Jabba's amusement. His life depends on making Jabba laugh at least once per day.
gameText: When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and place the other in Used Pile. Unless Crumb is 'hit', your leaders here may not be targeted by weapons. Undercover spies here are lost. ('AH-hahahaha!')

title: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time

titleComponents.name: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time

gameText: Deploy a Cloud City battleground site and [Cloud City] I'm Sorry. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Admiral's Orders, Endor Shield, [Death Star II] Executor, or [Episode I] (or [Episode VII]) cards with ability. During your deploy phase, your Lando may make a regular move. While this side up, opponent loses no Force to Cloud City Occupation or your Force drains at Bespin system. Once during your turn, may [upload] Dark Deal or [Special Edition] Bespin. Flip this card if you control three Bespin locations and opponent controls fewer than three Bespin locations.

title: Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further

titleComponents.name: Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further

gameText: While this side up, Force drain bonuses at same site as your Lando or your Lobot may not be canceled. While Vader at a Bespin location, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and Alter may not be played. If your alien/Imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2. Once per battle involving your Lando (twice if any Lobot also there), may a subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. Flip this card if opponent controls more Bespin locations than you.

title: Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus
gameText: If Dooku is your apprentice, choose: [Upload] Petranaki Arena or The Works. OR If Dooku and Sidious on table, cancel Sense. OR Once per game, if Darth Tyranus in battle at a site and you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, instead use his ability number.

title: Fallen Order
gameText: If The Hidden Path on table, deploy on table. When deployed, stack three Jedi survivors from Reserve Deck here. During your deploy phase, Jedi survivors here may deploy as if from hand. The Light Will Fade: While The Hidden Path on table, Jedi survivors are deploy = 3, power = 3, forfeit = 3, deploy only to Safehouse, move using landspeed for free, and their game text is canceled. But It Is Never Forgotten: If your Jedi survivor was just lost, may lose 1 Force to stack it here. (Immune to Cold Feet.)

title: Jabiim: Path Operations Center
locationLightSideGameText: Once per turn, may [download] a lightsaber on your character here.

title: Jabiim: Starship Hangar
locationDarkSideGameText: Once per game, may [download] (or deploy from Lost Pile) Grand Inquisitor here.
locationLightSideGameText: While a Jedi Survivor present, you lose no Force to Visage Of The Emperor.

title: Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut
locationLightSideGameText: Deploys only as a starting location. Once per game, may [upload] a Wookiee. While Wookiee Homestead on table, no Force Drains here.

title: Kelleran Beq
lore: Jedi survivor.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Adds one battle destiny with Grogu or a Padawan. Any lightsaber may deploy on Beq. Once per game, may deploy a lightsaber on Beq from Lost Pile. Your other characters here are defense value +1 for each lightsaber on Beq. Immune to attrition < 6.

title: Kelnacca
lore: Wookiee.
gameText: Once per turn, if Wookiee Homestead on table, may place a card from hand on top of Force Pile to draw bottom card from Force Pile. Once per game, may [download] a unique (•) Forest. Immune to Wookiee Strangle and You Are Beaten.

title: Coruscant
locationDarkSideGameText: Invisible Hand is hyperspeed +3 when moving to or from here. Your [Episode I] pilots deploy -1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: If Invisible Hand controls this system, Menace Fades is suspended.

title: Launching The Assault
lore: By recruiting the Mon Calamari, a race of master shipwrights, the Rebel starfleet gained capital starships rivaling the dreaded Imperial Star Destroyers.
gameText: If your Endor (or Rebel Base) location on table, deploy on table. May [download] Home One or Sullust. Home One is deploy = 8 to an [Endor] or [Death Star II] system and its power may not be reduced. Once per game, Home One may move as a 'react' to [Death Star II] Falcon's location (or vice versa). [Immune to Alter.]

title: Mapuzo: Mining Village
locationDarkSideGameText: While Vader or an Inquisitor present, your Force drains here may not be modified.
locationLightSideGameText: Your miners are power +1 here. Once per game, may [download] Tala Durith here.

title: Mapuzo: Safehouse
locationDarkSideGameText: Unless Third Sister here, Force drain -1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: The first Jedi you deploy here each turn is immune to Imperial Barrier.

title: Mapuzo: Underground Corridor
locationLightSideGameText: During your move phase, Jedi survivors may move from here to a Jabiim site (or to opponent's battleground site).

title: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile
lore: Jedi survivor.
gameText: Adds one battle destiny with Maul, Sidious, or Vader. Opponent's characters here are power and forfeit -1. Once per game, may [upload] (or retrieve into hand) Glancing Blow or Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 6.

title: Peli Motto
lore: Female mechanic and scavenger.
gameText: While at Starship Graveyard, a docking bay, or on Tatooine, power +3 and may cancel I’ve Lost Artoo! or Lateral Damage (or Restraining Bolt here). During your control phase, if at a battleground with a Jawa, landed starfighter or Grogu, may retrieve 1 Force.

title: Quinlan Vos
lore: Jedi survivor.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Adds one battle destiny with Dooku, Grievous, or Ventress. Once per turn, may peek at the top card of any Reserve Deck or subtract 1 from a just drawn weapon destiny here. Dark Approach is a Used interrupt. Immune to Sniper and attrition < 6 (< 8 if alone).

title: Something About This Boy
lore: 'What'd he mean by that?' 'I'll tell you later.'
gameText: LOST: Relocate Prophecy Of The Force to a site. STARTING: If your starting location was Skywalker Hut, deploy Prophecy Of The Force there, Do, Or Do Not and Jedi Business. Light Side goes first. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.

title: The Hidden Path
gameText: Deploy Mining Village, Safehouse, Underground Corridor, and Fallen Order. For remainder of game, you may not deploy <> locations, Anakin, or Jedi (except Jedi survivors) or play A Jedi's Resilience. Weapon Levitation may not steal weapons. Once per turn, may [download] a Jabiim location. While this side up, you may not play Nabrun Leids. Your Force drains at Mapuzo sites are -1. Once per turn, may [download] a holocron. Flip this card if Jedi occupy two non-Mapuzo sites.

title: Gather Allies And Train
gameText: While this side up, Jedi survivors are deploy -1. If your holocron is about to leave table, place it in Used Pile. Opponent's total battle destiny where they have a character of ability > 4 is -1. During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Jedi between a Jabiim site and a battleground site as a regular move. At the end of opponent's turn, if Jedi occupy two battleground sites, opponent loses 1 Force. Flip this card if Jedi do not occupy two non-Mapuzo sites.

title: Endless Legions
gameText: If your stormtroopers occupy three battleground and/or Rebel Base locations, choose: Draw three cards from Force Pile, then place two cards from hand on Force Pile. OR Once per game, if you just lost a non-[Maintenance] stormtrooper, take it into hand.

title: Garindan, Imperial Spy
lore: Long-nosed, male Kubaz from Kubindi. Spy. Squealed on Obi-Wan and Luke outside Docking Bay 94. Works for Jabba the Hutt or the highest bidder. Not particularly brave.
gameText: Imperials move to here for free using landspeed. If present at a site and not 'hit,' may place Garindan in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting your other character here (or to make an Undercover spy here lost).

title: Guri
lore: Human-replica droid. Programmed to function as Xizor's personal bodyguard and assassin. Black Sun agent. Cost 9 million credits. Worth every decicred.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. While Guri and Xizor present at same site, Force drain +1 here and Xizor may not be targeted by weapons (unless Guri 'hit'). While your [Reflections II] objective on table, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and immune to attrition < 5

title: I'm Sorry
lore: 'I'm sorry, too.'
gameText: If your [Cloud City] objective on table, deploy on table. Elis Helrot, Stunning Leader, and Surreptitious Glance may not be played. Once per turn, may [download] an interior Cloud City site. Your unique (•) characters with printed forfeit < 5 are forfeit +2 (to a maximum of +2). [Immune to Alter.]

title: Information Exchange
lore: 'Chisa nyooda ishaley. Kun Jabba neguda len malta.' 'Ikkit ui! Yobbit, yobbit. Nelan tui ke bada.'
gameText: Deploy on table. Black Sun agents are defense value +1 and forfeit +1. Once per turn, if you just deployed an information broker, may exchange the top card of Force Pile with any one card in hand. [Reflections II] Emperor deploys -1 and moves for free. [Immune to Alter.]

title: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
lore: Spy. Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named 'Arica' in order to sneak into Jabba's palace.
gameText: Functions as your apprentice. Battle destiny draws may not be added here. May [download] Mara Jade's Lightsaber here. If you just won a battle here, may retrieve a card with 'Mara' in game text. Immune to Rebel Barrier and attrition < 4 (< 5 if Luke on table).

title: Ommni Box & It's Worse
gameText: USED: For remainder of turn, you lose no Force to the following cards on table (if any): A Good Blaster At Your Side, No Disintegrations!, Stardust, and They Will Be Lost And Confused. OR Cancel Blast The Door, Kid! or It Could Be Worse. (Immune to It's A Hit!) OR Shuffle any player's Reserve Deck or Lost Pile. LOST: If opponent just lost a battle, they lose 2 Force.

title: Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi
lore: Leader. "He's no Jedi."
gameText: [Virtual Block 5] Dark Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Cyborg Commander. Jedi present are power -1 (-2 if a Jedi Council Member). While armed with a lightsaber, your battle destiny draws here are +1 and his forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked

titleComponents.name: I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked

lore: Imperials use sensitive equipment to search captured ships for shielded compartments. Scanning crew BT-445 planned to search the Millennium Falcon.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may [download] Vader. May place this Effect in Used Pile to [upload] a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to [download] or [upload] a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.

title: Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi
lore: Leader. "He's no Jedi."
gameText: [Virtual Block 5] Dark Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Cyborg. Jedi present are power -1 (-2 if a Jedi Council Member). While armed with a lightsaber, your battle destiny draws are +1 here and Cyborg Commander's forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man

titleComponents.name: Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man

lore: Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of Emperor. Encased in armor with cybernetic life support. Student of Obi-Wan Kenobi. Was the best starpilot in the galaxy. Cunning warrior.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5. May not be Disarmed.

title: DS-61-5
gameText: [Pilot] 2, 3: Black 5. While piloting Black 5, it is maneuver +1 and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If at opponent's system, instead of Force draining here, may take any card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.

title: Saber Squadron Pilot
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Matching pilot for Saber Squadron TIE and while piloting it: it may relocate using [Virtual Block 7] Combat Response, adds one destiny to total power only, and may add 1 to Force drains here (opponent loses no more than 2 Force to that drain).

title: A Sith's Weapon
lore: Lightsaber confrontations are a complex dance of feints, strikes, parries and footwork. Mistakes are rarely forgiven.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per turn, if your character of ability > 4 just failed to 'hit' an [Episode I] Jedi (or [Virtual Block 6] Luke) with a non-[Permanent Weapon] lightsaber, may lose 1 Force to 'swing' at target again. May place in Used Pile to cancel Obi-Wan's Journal.

title: Combat Response
lore: Being stationed at Endor during the construction of the second Death Star allows Imperial pilots time to train in the latest starfighter combat techniques.
gameText: Deploy on table. Tallon Roll is canceled. Once per turn, may reveal an unpiloted starfighter from hand to take its matching pilot character into hand from Reserve Deck (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. Your unique (•) TIEs (except Scythe Squadron TIEs) at systems may use 1 Force to relocate (as a regular move) to a system within 3 parsecs. (Immune to Alter.)

title: I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked

titleComponents.name: I Want Every Part Of This Ship Checked

lore: Imperials use sensitive equipment to search captured ships for shielded compartments. Scanning crew BT-445 planned to search the Millennium Falcon.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, if Obi-Wan on table, may deploy Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take a [Grabber] into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just attempted to take a card into hand or deploy a card from Reserve Deck, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card instead.

title: I'll Take Them Myself
lore: 'Several fighters have broken off from the main group. Come with me.' Darth Vader targets his TIE fighter's fire-linked blaster cannons at the Rebel pilots in the trench.
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, may [upload] a [Setup] card. May place this card in Used Pile to [upload] an Immediate Effect. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Imperial Security Bureau
gameText: Deploy on table. Sunsdown is canceled. ISB agents who are leaders deploy -2 to sites with 'ISB' in title. Once per game, may [upload] a [Setup] Mission. Look Sir, Droids and your Interrupts with 'advisor' in title may be played as follows: 'USED: Use 1 Force to [upload] an ISB agent.' (Immune to Alter.)

title: Commence Primary Ignition
gameText: If Death Star orbits Alderaan (and [Virtual Block 7] Central Core on table), deploy on Death Star and fire Superlaser at Alderaan; it is 'blown away.' Once during your control phase, if Death Star orbiting a planet (except a Rebel Base) without related sites, may fire Superlaser at planet (regardless of Objective restrictions) as follows: Draw destiny. Add 2 if you control that system. If (destiny + Y - Z) > 8, target is 'blown away' and opponent loses 4 Force from Life Force. Y = total Death Star sites where opponent has no presence. Z = total sites at Yavin 4.

title: Rise Of The Dark Lord
gameText: Deploy on table (deploys only at start of game) with three different [Vader] Effects from your Reserve Deck face down under here. Once per turn, may deploy a [Vader] Effect from here (never from elsewhere). Limit one [Vader] Effect on table and, when lost, stack it under here. You may cancel your [Vader] Effect at any time. Twisted And Evil: Dark Jedi Presence, Jedi Presence, Revenge Of The Sith and Sith Tests are canceled. When using The Empire's Back to deploy Vader from Reserve Deck, it is a Used Interrupt. If you just drew a [Vader] card for destiny, may take it into hand.

title: Biggs, Rogue Legend
lore: Piloted Red 3 at Battle of Yavin. Childhood friend of Luke. Led mutiny on Rand Ecliptic and theft of Ecliptic from shipyards on Bestine. Ecliptic Evaders emblem on helmet.
gameText: [Pilot] 2, 3: Red 3. While piloting Red 3, it is maneuver +1 and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If at opponent's system, instead of Force draining here, may take any card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.

title: Princess Leia, Lost Scion
gameText: While present at a battleground, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. While armed with Anakin's Lightsaber, her forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Field Dressing
lore: The Alliance lost many fine soldiers at conflicts such as the Battle of Hoth. The Rebel High Command is aware of the cost of freedom from Imperial tyranny.
gameText: If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, deploy on that character (who remains at same site and, if 'hit,' is restored to normal). Character is forfeit = 0 (even if forfeit may not normally be reduced). May play First Aid to place this card in Used Pile. Immune to your Control.

title: Luke, Trust Me
lore: Luke's piloting skills and Force abilities made his X-wing a difficult target for Darth Vader as they raced down the Death Star trench.
gameText: If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Even at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Massassi Base Sentry
lore: Rebel sentries are stationed on raised sensor platforms. On watch for Imperial scouts and other hazards, they supplement data gathered by Yavin Base's main sensors.
gameText: Deploy on Yavin 4; it is 'liberated'. At sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, if you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.

title: Oh, He's Not Dead, Not Yet

titleComponents.name: Oh, He's Not Dead, Not Yet

lore: 'Where did you dig up that old fossil?' 'I don't think he exists anymore.' 'Surely he must be dead by now.' 'I can't believe he's gone.' 'Oh, he's not dead, not yet.' Obi's back!
gameText: Deploy on table. Once per game, if Vader on table, may [download] Obi-Wan. May place this Effect in Used Pile to [upload] a [Grabber]. If you just attempted to [upload] or [download] a card, and the card was not found, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to search your Force Pile for that card; reshuffle.

title: Rebel Aces
gameText: Deploy on table. Your Sandwhirl is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may deploy Close Air Support from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacit (except Falcon or Artoo-Detoo In Red 5) gain 'May add 1 astromech.'

title: Restore Freedom To The Galaxy
gameText: Deploy on Yavin 4 system. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck face up there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.

title: Vader's Mask
lore: Darth Vader's armored mask and life-support system provide him with extraordinary physical protection in duels and battles, in addition to his Dark Jedi combat skill.
gameText: Deploy on [Vader] Vader. During your battle phase, may cancel this Effect to allow Vader to make a regular move. In order for opponent's character to move away from here, opponent must first lose 1 Force. While defending a battle at opponent's site, Vader is power +2 and immune to attrition. (Immune to Alter.)

lore: Remote surveillance viewers with droid controllers supplement security. Can activate alarms and automated weapons when needed, bringing help to endangered locations.

title: Admiral Pellaeon
lore: Corellian leader. Lied about his age to enter the Academy. Took command of Chimaera when its captain was killed at the Battle of Endor. Admires Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Opponent's passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier may lose one force to move away from battle as a react (at hyperspeed +2).

title: Garindan
lore: Long-nosed, male Kubaz from Kubindi. Spy. Squealed on Obi-Wan and Luke outside Docking Bay 94. Works for Jabba the Hutt or the highest bidder. Not particularly brave.
gameText: [Pilot] 1. May deploy -1 as a 'react'; shuffle any Reserve Deck. Ignores Objective deployment restrictions. Unless alone, may place Garindan in Used Pile to cancel a just drawn Weapons Destiny here. [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Domination ignores Garindan.

title: Insidious Prisoner
gameText: If A Stunning Move on table, deploy on Palpatine's Quarters (if [Virtual Block 5] We Have A Plan on table, this card always relocates to Palpatine if possible (even if a captive)); opponent may deploy a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here. Evil is Everywhere: Opponent may not Force drain here. Adds one [Dark Side] at same site. If just lost, relocate to Blockade Flagship: Prison. Once per turn, it a player controls this site, they may have this card (unless on Palpatine) follow their first character to move from here using landspeed or docking bay transit to a non-shielded site.

title: A Dark Time For The Rebellion

titleComponents.name: A Dark Time For The Rebellion

lore: Absolute control wielded by the Emperor enables the Imperial forces to dominate planetary systems before the Rebel Alliance can gain a foothold.
gameText: If opponent went first this game, retrieve 1 force when you play this Interrupt. Add or subtract 1 from opponent's just drwn destiny. OR Activate up to 2 Force. Or take Control into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Until end of turn, battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled (unless being redrawn).

title: Evacuate?
lore: Escape pods are on many starships allowing those in peril to flee, an act considered cowardly by Imperial officers. 'We've analyzed their attack, sir, and there is a danger . . .'
gameText: Use 1 Force to traget your character of ability > 3 alone at a site. USED: During any move phase, take target into hand. LOST: If opponent has exactly one non-spy character at target's site, place target in Used Pile.

title: Dack Ralter
lore: Born in an Imperial labor camp on Kalist 6. Joined the Rebellion after his escape. Young student of Commander Skywalker. Experienced crackshot gunner.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Heroic. Rogue Squadron Pilot. During battle when Dack (or a starship or vehicle he pilots) fires a weapon, may add 1 to total weapon destiny and hit targets are power -2. If Dack is about to leave table may place him in Used Pile instead.

title: Captain Antilles
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette it is immune to attrition <5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 force to move ship away (for free).

title: Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian
lore: Defected from the Empire with Biggs Darklighter. Aided in mutiny aboard the transport Rand Ecliptic. Served in the Ecliptic Evaders. Luke's wingman at the Battle of Hoth.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Rogue 4 (or any X-Wing), draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is Rogue Blaster (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit and it's forfeit = 0, if destiny + 1 > defense value).

title: Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero
lore: Rogue Squadron pilot.
gameText: Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 force to deploy from lost pile) a blaster on Luke; reshuffle. While armed with a blaster, it may not be stolen and characters hit by Luke may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Master Kenobi
lore: A user of the Force can alter the environment to affect the minds of others. 'The Force can have a strong influence on the weak-minded.'
gameText: While 'communing': you may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may place one just forfeited in Used Pile; Once per turn, may deploy from Reserve Deck a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan's Hut); reshuffle.

title: Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran
lore: Served for many years as a gunner with friend Jek Porkins in the Tierfon Yellow Aces. Expert marksmanship helped the Alliance earn some of its earliest victories.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn may deploy from Reserve Deck (or deploy from hand) Disrupter Pistol for free on Wes; reshuffle. May fire Disruptor Pistol for 1 Force. Power and Forfeit +1 when with Hobbie or Wedge. If about to leave table place cards aboard Wes in owner's Used Pile.

title: Bacta Infirmary
lore: Medical wonder invented centuries ago by the Vratix insectoid species. Gelatinous red bacta is suspended in a synthetic solution to create a healing bacterial medium.
gameText: If Center of Tyranny on Table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and if lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase may use 2 force to take a character here into hand. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Communing
gameText: If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. [download] two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; [upload] and stack a Jedi here. Luminous Beings: Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile.

title: Use The Force
lore: 'Use the Force. Yes... Now, the stone. Feel it.'
gameText: Choose up to X of the following in any order, where X = the number of cards stacked on Communing: peek at the top card of any deck or pile: may then shuffle it. OR draw 2 cards from reserve deck. OR retrieve 1 force. OR activate X force. OR your next destiny draw is + X.

title: Yub Yub, Commander
gameText:
USED: Deploy a Rogue Squadron pilot to a location you occupy with a Rogue Squadron pilot from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. 
LOST: Cancel an attempt by opponent to target a Rogue Sqaudron pilot to be captured or excluded from battle. Or if two Rogue Squadron pilots are in battle together, add one battle destiny.

title: The Shield Is Down!
lore: Lando's confidence in the Rebel strike team on the forest moon was rewarded, and proved to be a decisive factor at the Battle of Endor.
gameText: If [Virtual Block 7] Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Your [Endor] Epic Event total is +1 for each non-Jedi scout at Bunker. For each of your non-Jedi scouts in battle, attrition against opponent is +1. While opponent's [Endor] objective on table, Bunker may not be converted. Once per turn may take Bunker into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Trophy Of A Kill

title: Insidious Prisoner
gameText: If A Stunning Move on table, deploy on Palpatine's Quarters (if [Virtual Block 5] We Have A Plan on table, this card always relocates to Palpatine if possible (even if a captive)); opponent may deploy a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here. lore: Absolute control wielded by the Emperor enables the Imperial forces to dominate planetary systems before the Rebel Alliance can gain a foothold.

title: Evacuate?

gameText: Dark: While Insidious Prisoner on table, Cyborg Commander is immune to attrition. Light: Force drain -1 here . Jedi here may not have their power reduced.

title: Spice Mine Operations
gameText: If your [Virtual Block 7] office on table, deploy on table. Program Trap is canceled. Cards stacked here are 'spice' cards. Once per turn, if you control Extraction Facility, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to draw up to 2 cards from Reserve Deck. Once during your turn, may: use 2 Force to stack a card from Lost Pile here, [download] a non-character card with "Kessel" in title, and/or 'mine' (opponent draws destiny; draw up to X destiny, where X = 1 plus number of Kessel locations you occupy; if any of the printed destiny numbers match, stack opponent's destiny or top card of your Lost Pile here).

title: Admiral Pellaeon
lore: Corellian leader. Lied about his age to enter the Academy. Took command of Chimaera when its captain was killed at the Battle of Endor. Admires Grand Admiral Thrawn.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. May be revealed from hand to take Justifier into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle and deploy both simultaneously (for -1 Force each). Opponent's passengers here are forfeit = 0. Once per game, if aboard Justifier, may lose 1 Force to move away from battle as a 'react' (at hyperspeed +2).

title: A Stunning Move

title: 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix)

gameText: [Pilot] 2. Power +1 while with your leader. If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate 1 Force; 4-6, you may draw top card of your Reserve Deck; 0 or 7, you may retrieve 1 Force.

title: Kessel Surveillance System

title: Captain Antilles
gameText: [Pilot] 2, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette, it is immune to attrition < 5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 Force to move starship he pilots away (for free).

title: Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian
lore: Defected from the Empire with Biggs Darklighter. Aided in mutiny aboard the transport Rand Ecliptic. Served in the Ecliptic Evaders. Luke's wingman at the Battle of Hoth.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. While piloting Rogue 4 (or any X-wing), draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is Rogue Blaster (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).

title: Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero
lore: Rogue Squadron pilot.
gameText: Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 Force to deploy from Lost Pile) a blaster on Luke; reshuffle. While armed with a blaster, it may not be stolen and characters hit by Luke may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 4.

title: Master Kenobi
lore: A user of the Force can alter the environment to affect the minds of others. 'The Force can have a strong influence on the weak-minded.'

title: Wes Janson, Rogue Veteran
lore: Served for many years as a gunner with friend Jek Porkins in the Tierfon Yellow Aces. Expert marksmanship helped the Alliance earn some of its earliest victories.

title: Gardulla The Hutt

gameText: Deploy on your non-[Reflections 2] astromech droid. Droid is power +2, gains [Presence Droid], and if present at a site, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During any move phase, may place this device in Lost Pile to [upload] one What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? or R2-D2.

title: Tibanna Floating Refinery
lore: Refines Tibanna gas at mines like those at Cloud City. Also used for moisture collection on dry planets.
gameText: Deploy on a cloud sector (limit one per sector). Your Force generation is +1 at cloud sectors you occupy. Once during your control phase, if you occupy this sector, may draw destiny. If destiny > 2, retrieve 1 Force. If lost from table, place this Device in Used Pile.

title: Desperate Counter
lore: The Empire relied on the skill of its pilot corps to defend the Death Star reactor core from attack.
gameText: Unless Imperial Propaganda on table, if you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 4 (ignore other modifiers); opponent may [upload] any one card. [Immune to Control.] OR Use 2 Force to deploy on table and stack a just-played Interrupt here.

title: Occupied Territory
lore: 'I advise everyone to leave before more Imperial troops arrive.'
gameText: Deploy on a battleground. If you occupy, during battle here or at a related location, may place this Effect in Used Pile and choose: Draw up to two cards from Reserve Deck OR Prevent opponent from drawing any destinies during the power segment of that battle (except battle destiny).

title: Shadows Of The Empire
lore: Imposing. Ominous. Intimidating. Instrument for the evil Emperor's sinister reach across the galaxy. Used on a secret frequency of the Imperial HoloNet.
gameText: Deploy on Agents Of Black Sun. Mistryl are lost. Once per game, may [upload] Secret Plans. May use 3 Force to [download] Imperial Square, and once per turn, if Emperor Palpatine there, may draw a card from Force Pile (and if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force). [Immune to Alter.]

title: Podrace Prep
lore: Advanced preparation in Podracing is usually the key to winning. A little extra work at the start can mean a lot in the long run.
gameText: If Credits Will Do Fine on table, deploy Podrace Arena, a Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, and three Effects that deploy for free and are always [Immune to Alter]. Opponent may deploy a Podracer (or play a Defensive Shield from under their Starting Effect). Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.

title: Geonosis: Petranaki Arena
locationDarkSideGameText: If your [Separatist] leader here, Force drain +1 here.
locationLightSideGameText: During battle here, you must first use 1 Force to play an Interrupt.

title: More Systems Will Rally To Our Cause

titleComponents.name: More Systems Will Rally To Our Cause

gameText: Deploy [Separatist] Geonosis system, a Geonosis site, a [Clone Army] system, and Droid Racks. Stack six (••• •••) cards from outside your deck on here. For remainder of game, you may not deploy cards with ability except [Episode I] cards. If your [Episode I] system was just converted, raise it to the top. Your (••• •••) cards stacked on Droid Racks may deploy as if from hand. Once per turn, may [download] Invisible Hand: Bridge or a [Separatist] location. Flip this card at the end of turn if your [Clone Army] systems not on table.

title: The Galaxy Torn Apart
gameText: May immediately retrieve up to 2 Force. While this side up, during your control phase, opponent loses X Force, where X = number of systems you control (limit 3). Once per turn, may deploy a (••• •••) card stacked here as if from hand. If you just lost a battle involving a (••• •••) card, opponent loses 1 Force. title: Run'heb Voend
lore: Jawa mechanic.
gameText: Once per game, may [DOWNLOAD] a Sandcrawler here. While driving a Sandcrawler it moves for free, may not be targeted by weapons and adds one battle destiny. Once during your turn, may select a player to activate 1 Force.

title: Separatist Command Center
locationDarkSideGameText: While you occupy with a non-unique [Presence] card, your non-unique [Presence] cards are power +1 at same and related sites.

title: Utapau: Pau City
locationDarkSideGameText: During opponent's turn, if you control with a [Separatist] leader, may activate 1 Force.
locationLightSideGameText: During battle here, you must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon.

title: Warrant Officer Bachenkall
lore: Warrant Officer Bachenkall is typical of the many graduates of the Imperial Training Academy on Raithal. The sector naval school trains pilots in capital starship helm tactics.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Devastator deploys -2 here. While piloting a Star Destroyer, it is hyperspeed +1 and opponent must first use 1 Force (if possible) to draw a card for battle destiny here. Once per game, may deploy Imperial Pilot here from outside your deck.

title: Beckett's Stolen AT-Hauler
gameText: May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Players may not draw more than two battle destiny (one if piloted by Rio) here. While Beckett on table or out of play, power +3.

title: Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice
gameText: Deploy on table. Sense and Alter are Lost Interrupts. When any player makes a destiny draw for Sense or Alter, and that destiny draw is successful, that player loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). May [download] Bog Clearing. [Dagobah] Luke is a Padawan. Once per game, during a battle involving [Dagobah] Luke, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Sense] Interrupt. Yoda and Padawans are immune to Imperial Barrier and Stunning Leader and may move free using landspeed. While she is alone, Jedi Ahsoka’s gametext is canceled. [Immune to Alter.]

title: Behind Everything
lore: Mysterious Sith Master who is manipulating the Trade Federation for his own nefarious ends. Shrouded in mystery, his identity and agenda remain unclear.
gameText: If Revenge Of The Sith on table, deploy on table. While Sidious alone on Coruscant, he adds one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon there. While your apprentice in battle, Blast The Door, Kid! and It's A Trap! may not be played and, once per battle, may choose a player to activate 1 Force. [Immune to Alter.]

title: Grogu In Razor Crest
gameText: May add 1 pilot and 1 passenger. Permanent pilot is •Grogu, who provides ability of 4. Unless opponent has total ability > 6 piloting here, reset opponent's total battle destiny here to 0.

title: Luthen Rael
lore: Spy. Leader. Massassi Group.
gameText: Once per turn, if at a site you control and your spy is in battle, may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny. If alone at a non-battleground, may lose 1 Force to place Luthen out of play; may activate up to 2 Force.

title: Qui-Gon Jinn
lore: Accepted Obi-Wan Kenobi as his Padawan learner. Was given orders to protect Queen Amidala at all costs.
gameText: Where present, [Tatooine] Anakin deploys -2 and, while with Qui-Gon, may not be targeted by weapons and adds one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon here. Once per game, may stack top card of Lost Pile on your Podracer. Immune to Dark Strike, Maul Strikes, and attrition.

title: Sacrifice For Something Bigger
gameText: If Zero Hour on table, deploy on table. Once per game, may [DOWNLOAD] Kanan. If Kanan just lost, place him out of play, relocate this Effect to a Lothal site, and flip this card. [Immune to Alter.]

title: Sacrifice For Something Bigger
gameText: Moves like a character at normal use of the Force. Where present, your Rebels gain Phoenix Squadron, your total power is +3, and opponent's immunity to attrition is canceled. If a Dark Jedi (or two Imperials) control this location, place this Effect out of play. [Immune to Alter.]

title: The Force Will Be With You, Always

titleComponents.name: The Force Will Be With You, Always

lore: You can't win Darth. If you strike me down I shall become more powerful than you can possibly imagine.' Obi-Wan's sacrifice gave the Rebels time to escape.
gameText: If a Jedi 'communing,' choose: [Upload] Coruscant: Jedi Temple. OR Once per game, draw bottom card of your Force Pile. OR Once per game, take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.

title: The Greatest Of All The Jedi

titleComponents.name: The Greatest Of All The Jedi

lore: Din Djarin. Foundling child. Mandalorians.
gameText: [Pilot] 3. While piloting or at a site, draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Once per game, may [upload] (or retrieve) Beskar Deflection. Immune to None Shall Pass.

lore: Many pilots for the Rebellion learned their skills using modified T-47s and other airspeeders. Being able to weave in and out of combat has become second nature to them.
gameText: Add 2 to power and maneuver of your T-47 until end of turn. (Interrupt may even affect the result of a destiny draw targeting the T-47's maneuver.) OR Once per game, if you are about to lose Force, reduce the loss by 1 for each marker site you occupy.

locationDarkSideGameText: If you just took a card into hand with A Valuable Hostage, retrieve 1 Force.

lore: The heroes of the Rebellion know that where there is life, there is hope.
gameText: For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel battle destiny draws. OR If Luke or Leia in battle alone, draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. OR If an Alderaan or Tatooine location on table, ▲ Luke (or a Lars) or Leia (or Bail) with printed deploy < 4.

title: Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk
lore: Wookiee scout. Volunteered for Han's Endor strike team. Keeps his distance, but doesn't look like he's keeping his distance. Always thinks with his stomach.

title: Commando Training
lore: Han's Rebel strike team on the forest moon of Endor was highly trained in the use of blasters and explosives.
gameText: If Rebel Strike Team or They Have No Idea We're Coming on table, deploy on table. Your personal Force generation = 2. You initiate battles for free where you have two Rebels. At end of opponent’s turn, if you occupy three battlegrounds, opponent loses 1 Force. [Immune to Alter.]

title: B1 Clanker
lore: Manufactured by the Baktoid Combat Automata, battle droids are used by the Trade Federation throughout the galaxy in order to secure and protect sites of strategic importance.

title: Dark Lightning
gameText: Target a character present with your Dark Jedi Master. Draw destiny. If destiny + 2 > target's ability, target's game text is canceled for remainder of turn and, if target is Anakin, Luke, or Rey, opponent loses 1 Force (2 Force if a [Skywalker] Epic Event is also on table).

title: Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin

Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 while armed with a rifle).

If your total is higher, 'mark' is 'assassinated:' opponent loses 2 Force (4 if a Jedi), 'mark' is lost, and relocate Death Mark to your side of table. title: Bossk With Mortar Gun
lore: Trandoshan assassin and slaver.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each 'hit'. Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit =0, if destiny matches target's destiny number).

title: Ket Maliss, Shadow Killer
lore: Highly valued by Jabba the Hutt and other gangsters. Ket Maliss, Prince Xizor's “shadow killer,” has unknown but undoubtedly lethal business in Mos Eisley. Assassin.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While with opponent's character of ability > 2, Ket Maliss is power +1 and defense value + 2 and draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Whenever opponent's character was lost from same site, opponent loses 1 Force.

title: R'tic H'weei
lore: Jawa.
gameText: Once per game, may take one Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or gametext into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If present at a Tatooine battleground, once per turn, if there is more than 1 card in opponent's Force Pile, may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.

title: Jet Pack
lore: Mitrinomon Z-6 jet pack. Exhaust vents are used to maneuver in midflight. Gyro-stabilizer automatically applies counterthrust when landing.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free Jodo Kast or any Fett). Character 'flies' (landspeed = 3 and maneuver = 6), may fire weapons for free, and may move as a 'react' for +1 Force.

title: Jango Fett, The Assassin
lore: Trade Federation assassin and scout.
gameText: Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny. SD-17 Homing Missile may deploy on (and is a matching weapon for) him, fires for free, and when fired may go to lost pile instead. While piloting Slave I with Boba (unless your [Block 4] objective on table), it is immune to attrition <9.

title: Join Us Or Die
lore: Vader had to show Luke that giving in to the dark side of the Force was his only destiny.

Once per turn, may deploy a docking bay or So Be It, Jedi from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. 'Battle' on Insignificant Rebellion is treated as 'battle or duel. (Immune to Alter).

lore: Jawa scout. Wants to avenge deaths of relatives killed in stormtrooper assault on sandcrawler. Reegesk pilfered the powerpack from his blaster at a critical moment.

gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: Until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR Peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile where X = number of characters here.

title: Bossk With Mortar Gun
lore: Trandoshan assassin and slaver.
gameText: Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. May not be targeted by weapons unless your other slavers present are each 'hit.' Permanent weapon is •Bossk's Mortar Gun (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny = target's destiny number).

title: Ket Maliss, Shadow Killer
lore: Highly valued by Jabba the Hutt and other gangsters. Ket Maliss, Prince Xizor's “shadow killer,” has unknown but undoubtedly lethal business in Mos Eisley. Assassin.
gameText: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While with opponent's character of ability > 2, Ket Maliss is power +1, defense value +2, and draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Whenever an opponent's character is lost from same site, opponent loses 1 Force.

title: R'tic H'weei
lore: Jawa.
gameText: Once per game, may ▲ Jawa Blaster or a card with 'sandcrawler' in title or gametext. Once per turn, if present at a Tatooine battleground and there is more than 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile, you may use 1 Force in opponent's Force Pile.

title: Jet Pack
lore: Mitrinomon Z-6 jet pack. Exhaust vents are used to maneuver in midflight. Gyro-stabilizer automatically applies counterthrust when landing.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free on Jodo Kast or any Fett). Character 'flies' (landspeed = 3 and maneuver = 6), may fire weapons for free, and may move as a 'react' for +1 Force.

title: Join Us Or Die
lore: Vader had to show Luke that giving in to the dark side of the Force was his only destiny.
gameText: Deploy on your Throne Room. While Emperor and Vader here, Take Your Father's Place does not deplete Life Force or cause Force loss. Once per turn, may ▼ So Be It, Jedi or a docking bay. 'Battle' on Insignificant Rebellion is treated as 'battle or duel.' (Immune to Alter.)

title: On The Hunt
lore: Blank.
gameText: Deploy on Contract Killers. Assassins are defense value +1. Once per game may retrieve [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. At end of opponent's turn, if their character targeted by [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is at a non-battleground or aboard their starship, opponent loses 3 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

title: You'll Be Dead!
gameText: Deploy on table. Non-lightsaber weapons carried by your non-Dark Jedi characters may not be stolen. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each battleground site you control with a non-[Permanent Weapon] blaster present. Imperial Artillery is a Lost Interrupt. Immune to Alter.

title: Well Guarded
lore: Most of Jabba's guards had been sold to the Hutt and were too scared (or too dumb) to leave. Jabba assigned his best guards to watch over his most prized possessions.
gameText: Deploy on table. Your non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (while you have < 13 cards in hand), The Camp, and deployment costs on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Abyssin Ornament
lore: The Abyssins are known for their regenerative abilities. Jabba keeps several statue heads of Abyssin creatures on his repulsor sled.
gameText: USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by a non-droid assassin) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just-lost non-droid assassin into hand.

title: Sonic Bombardment
lore: Oouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioouioo-
gameText: Once per game ▲ a prison. OR Use 1 Force to ▲ a non-droid assassin (or slaver) of ability < 5. OR During battle involving an assassin, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starfighter piloted by your alien.

title: Give Yourself To The Dark Side

titleComponents.name: Give Yourself To The Dark Side

gameText: If Bring Him Before Me on table, play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ an Endor site and two always-[Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; may ▲ and stack Son Of Vader here. A Powerful Ally: While Son Of Vader on table, Jedi, Rebels, and Rebel starships lose all immunity to attrition and opponent loses 1 Force at the end of each turn. When Son Of Vader leaves table, stack him here. If Luke crossed over, Your Destiny is lost and may deploy (or persona replace) Son Of Vader from here as if from hand.

title: Mara Jade's Lightsaber
lore: As part of her training to become the Emperor's hand, Mara Jade learned from Palpatine himself how to effectively fight with a lightsaber.
gameText: Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

title: Chewbacca, Walking Carpet
lore: Wookiee scoundrel.
gameText: [Pilot] 2. Adds 2 to maneuver of any starfighter he pilots. Your total ability here may not be reduced. Once per game, may lose 1 Force to deploy a droid from Lost Pile. During battle, may target a just-hit character. Target's forfeit is restored to normal.

title: Het Nkik
lore: Jawa scout. Wants to avenge deaths of relatives killed in stormtrooper assault on sandcrawler. Reegesk pilfered the powerpack from his blaster at a critical moment.
gameText: Deploys only on Tatooine. While with another Jawa, your Force drains and Force drain bonuses here may not be canceled. During your control phase, may draw X cards from Reserve Deck, where X = the number of deserts you control with a Jawa.

title: Supreme Chancellor Valorum
lore: Although Finis Valorum maintains the Galactic Senate's ultimate title, his real power is mired by endless bureaucracy, petty corruption, and incessant plotting.
gameText: Agenda: order. May be targeted by Might Of The Republic. Your characters with politics (except Wedge and senators) are deploy -1 (and gain [Republic]) here. During your turn, may use 1 Force to ▲ a card with 'governor,' 'political,' or 'Valorum' in lore.

title: Imperial Navigation Charts
gameText: Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, may 'steal' (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. (Immune to Alter).

title: Redeemed Apprentice
lore: 'I know there is good in you. The Emperor hasn't driven it from you fully.'
gameText: If you just forfeited a character (or opponent just drew destiny for Elis Helrot) deploy on table. Whenever you must lose Force from a [Virtual Block 4] objective targeting your non-Jedi character, reduce loss by 1. Elis Helrot and Nabrun Leids are canceled. (Immune to Control.)

title: Scoundrel's Charm
lore: Sarcastic. Sardonic. Irreverent. Impertinent. Exasperating. Disrespectful. Outrageous and charming. Han was a scoundrel but Leia began to realize that she loved him.
gameText: Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from opponent's just-drawn destiny.

title: Scoundrel's Ingenuity
gameText: Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Scoundrel is power +2 and his total weapon destiny is +1. During your control phase, may draw destiny. If destiny > 3, your Force drains at same and related locations are +1 for remainder of turn.

title: Scoundrel's Luck
gameText: Deploy on Infiltration with three [Scoundrel] cards from Reserve Deck face down under here. Once during your turn, at any time, may deploy a [Scoundrel] Effect from here. If a [Scoundrel] Effect just left table, stack it under here. At the start of your turn, stack all [Scoundrel] Effects under here. Once per turn, may place any card in Lost Pile out of play to deploy a character weapon (except a grenade) from Lost Pile. While two non-droid scoundrels present at battlegrounds, Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe flips and may not flip back. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized
gameText: Deploy on Han. I've Got a Bad Feeling About This is canceled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.

title: Slave I, Symbol Of Fear
lore: Originally designed as a planetary defense craft. Uses restricted jamming technology, allowing it to appear out of nowhere. Contains many hidden armaments.
gameText: May reveal from hand to ▲ a [Virtual Block 8] Fett and deploy both simultaneously. May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Any [Virtual Block 8] Fett deploys -2 aboard. Immune to attrition < 5.

title: Contract Killers
gameText: Contract Killers: Deploy Coruscant system, Sub City Lair and On The Hunt. For remainder of game, Aurra, Galen, Mara, and your aliens with 'plotting to kill Jabba' in lore are assassins. Your cards with ability are deploy +3 except assassins and [Independent] starships. Characters add 1 to their Death Mark total for each weapon or device they carry. Once per turn, may ▼ a Coruscant battleground. Flip this card if assassins control two battlegrounds (unless opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site) or you just drew destiny for [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark. Feared Throughout The Galaxy: While this side up, during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force. If two assassins (except Galen) are in battle, add one battle destiny. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a character, an assassin there may gain 'reputation;' retrieve any one card (may only be canceled by Aim High) and stack it face down on that assassin. Assassins with 'reputation' may add 1 to Force drains where present. Flip this card at the end of any turn if opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site (unless [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is on your side of the table).

title: Han Solo, Innocent Scoundrel
lore: 'Well, that was a long time ago. I'm sure he's forgotten about that.' Since he needed Calrissian's help, Han regretted having introduced Lando to the Tonnika sisters.
gameText: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle, may fire a [Virtual Block 8] blaster twice. Once per turn, if opponent is about to draw weapon destiny targeting Han, they draw two and you choose one. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 if armed).

title: Kyle Katarn
lore: Scoundrel.
gameText: May use any stolen weapon. Opponent may not 'react' to or from same site. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each [Scoundrel] Effect on table. Once per game, may make a regular move during your control phase. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if armed).

title: Infiltration
gameText: Infiltration: Deploy Nar Shaddaa, Undercity and Scoundrel's Luck. For reminder of game, your gamblers, information brokers, and spies are scoundrels. You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. 'Luke' on opponent's [Reflections II] objective is treated as 'Rebel Agent.' Once per turn, may deploy a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to take Imperial Navigation Charts into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.' Unlikely Allies: While this side up, your scoundrels are forfeit +1. Your Force generation is +1 for each battleground you occupy with a scoundrel (to a maximum of +2). 'Once' on Scoundrel's Luck is treated as 'twice.' During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand in your Used Pile or Lost Pile, shuffle that pile and take the top card into hand. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is not on table (unless you have completed a [Virtual Block 8] Kessel Run).

title: Errant Venture
gameText: May add 6 pilots. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Unless your [Reflections II] objective on table, once per game may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] scoundrel aboard and while Corran or a Terrik piloting, immune to attrition < 7.

title: Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle
lore: BlasTech E-11 blaster rifle. Standard issue for Imperial forces. So numerous that many have been stolen by Rebels. Extendable stock. Carries energy for 100 shots.
gameText: Deploy on Rebel Agent. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny (two if Scoundrel's Luck on table). Character or creature hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. Vehicle hit if total destiny -2 > defense value.

title: Jango Fett, The Assassin
lore: Trade Federation assassin and scout.
gameText: Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. Adds one battle destiny. SD-17 Homing Missile may deploy on (and is a matching weapon for) him, fires for free, and when fired may go to Lost Pile instead. While piloted by two Fetts (unless your [Block 4] objective on table), Slave I is immune to attrition < 9.

title: Wookiee Slaving Operation
gameText:
Deploy Kashyyyk system, Slaving Camp Headquarters, and [Block 8] Special Delivery.
For remainder of game, your Trandoshans are slavers. Scum And Villainy may deploy on Slaving Camp Headquarters and may not be canceled while you occupy that site. While you have < 13 cards in hand, your non-unique slavers are immune to Grimtaash.
Flip this card if your slavers control two Kashyyyk battlegrounds and opponent controls no Kashyyyk locations.

title: You May Start Your Landing
lore: Echo Base was no match for the Imperial war machine.
gameText: If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-At (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may take Walker Garrrison and/or 3rd Marker into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Assassin's Blaster Rifle
gameText: Deploy on an assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.

title: Anakin Solo
lore: Padawan.
gameText: Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once during battle, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition <3 (<5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).

title: Lando Calrissian, Unlikely Hero
lore: Ever since Lando's 'little' maneuver at the Battle of Taanab, his piloting skills had become legendary. Scoundrel and gambler.
gameText: Adds 3 to anything he pilots. May reveal from hand to take Luxury Yacht into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; and deploy both simultaneously. While piloting (or with a female), adds one battle destiny. During battle, may target a card here. Draw destiny. If destiny < twice the number of scoundrels here, target is forfeit = 0.

title: Captain Verrack
lore: Mon Calamari computer technician. Expert in power systems. His skills are desperately needed by Rebel fleet. Gunner.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard your starship, adds 1 to its total weapon destiny. Whenever you hit a starship here, opponent loses 1 Force. During battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel [Coruscant] Watch Your Back!.

title: Rennek
lore: Nerf herder. Personally oversees the herding of Jabba's nerfs. Scruffy-looking appearance conceals his expertise in unusual combat techniques.
gameText: May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand for 2 force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reduce a participating character's forfeit to 0.

title: A Remote Planet
lore: In unfamiliar and potentially hostile territory, Qui-Gon knew that success would require patience and caution.
gameText: Deploy on The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone: treat '4' on it as '2'. Your Force generation at City Outskirts is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may deploy Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (an/or their matching weapon_ from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: A Step Backward & Higher Ground
gameText: During a battle at opponent's site (or your non-<> site), instead of firing one of your character weapons at a target, cause that target to be immunity to attrition -3 (or limited to immunity to attrition < 5) for remainder of turn. OR Find one of your missing characters. OR Cancel a 'react.' OR Once per game, use 1 Force to exchange a card in hand with the top most character of ability < 5 in your Lost Pile.

title: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

titleComponents.name: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

lore: 'Et tu taka bu Jabba now.'
gameText: When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. May [download] Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 Aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.

title: Under Jabba's Protection
gameText: When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to: take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh in hand (or stack top card of lost pile on it).

title: Indentured To The Empire
gameText:
While this side up, whenever you 'enslave' a character, opponent must choose to use 2 Force or lose 1 Force. Once per turn, during battle may add or subtract up to X from your just drawn destiny, where X = the number of Kashyyyk locations you control with a slaver. Once per turn, if you just retrieved Force during battle, may take a slaver, starship, or vehicle retrieved into hand.
Flip this card if opponent controls two Kashyyyk battlegrounds.

lore: Devaronian gambler. Smuggler.

title: Captain Verrack
lore: Mon Calamari computer technician. Expert in power systems. His skills are desperately needed by Rebel fleet. Gunner.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. While aboard your starship, its total weapon destiny is +1. Whenever you hit a starship here, opponent loses 1 Force. During battle, may lose 1 Force to cancel [Coruscant] Watch Your Back!.

title: Rennek
lore: Nerf herder. Personally oversees the herding of Jabba's nerfs. Scruffy-looking appearance conceals his expertise in unusual combat techniques.
gameText: May be stacked on I Know That Laugh from hand, using 2 Force. While stacked on I Know That Laugh, stack face-up and during any battle may draw destiny. If destiny < number of your aliens in battle, reset a participating character's forfeit to 0.

title: A Remote Planet
lore: In unfamiliar and potentially hostile territory, Qui-Gon knew that success would require patience and caution.
gameText: Deploy on The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone; treat "4" on it as "2." Your Force generation at City Outskirts is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (and/or their matching weapon). (Immune to Alter.)

title: You May Start Your Landing
lore: Echo Base was no match for the Imperial war machine.
gameText: If 5th Marker on table, deploy on table. During your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each marker site you control with an AT-AT (limit 1 unless [Virtual Block 2] Imperial Control on table). Once per game, may take Walker Garrison and/or 3rd Marker into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Assassin's Blaster Rifle
gameText: Deploy on your assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured this turn, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.

title: Anakin Solo
lore: Padawan.
gameText: Power +2 while armed with a lightsaber. May use any 'stolen' lightsaber. Once per turn, where present, may steal an opponent's just-lost lightsaber. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while armed with a 'stolen' lightsaber).

title: A Step Backward & Higher Ground
gameText: During a battle at opponent's site (or your non-<> site), instead of firing one of your character weapons at a target, cause that target to be immunity to attrition -3 (or limited to immunity to attrition < 5) for remainder of turn. OR Find one of your missing characters. OR Cancel a 'react.' OR Once per game, use 1 Force to exchange a card in hand with the top most character of ability < 5 in your Lost Pile.

title: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

titleComponents.name: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now

lore: 'Et tu taka bu Jabba now.'
gameText: When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. [download] Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.

title: Under Jabba's Protection
gameText: When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your Objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh into hand (or stack top card of Lost Pile on it).

title: Lady Luck
gameText: May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Scoundrels deploy -1 aboard. May reveal from hand to ▲ [Cloud City] Lando and deploy both simultaneously. While Lando piloting, immune to attrition < 5 (< 6 if at Bespin).

title: Spaceport Docking Bay
gameText: Dark: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here. Immune to [Reflections III] Ounee Ta. Light: May not be deployed to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force.
locationDarkSideGameText: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. Your starfighters deploy -1 (or -2 if freighter) here. Immune to [Reflections III] Ounee Ta.
locationLightSideGameText: May not be deployed to Bespin, Dagobah, Endor, Hoth or Yavin 4. Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force.

title: Underworld Contacts & Uncharted Settlements
gameText: Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base; you must choose alien/[Independent] starship. You may not deploy Ellorrs Madak, Revolution or operatives. Your Destiny is canceled. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Virtual Block 1] Yerka Mig may deploy on a Rebel Cell Site, may be placed in Used Pile if it was just canceled, and you may retrieve Force with it only once per turn. While Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table, attrition against opponent is +1 for each Rebel Cell site you occupy with an alien. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Lady Valarian
lore: Whiphid female gangster and leader.
gameText: Your total battle destiny here is +1. Unless Jabba on table, 'Jabba' in the game text of your cards (except Hutt Bounty) may be treated as 'Lady Valarian.' Once per turn, may target a Mistryl of ability > 2 here; target gains Heroic until end of turn.

title: Begin Landing Your Troops & Dark Forces
gameText: Deploy on table. Your [Separatist] droids are power +1 and may shuttle from battleground systems for free. During battle, may place this Effect out of play to cancel and redraw your just-drawn destiny. Once per turn, each player may ignore any deploy cost on [Virtual Block 4] Watch Your Step and once per game, while that Objective on table, you may take a starfighter into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or draw two cards from Reserve Deck). Jedi Tests may not modify your battle or weapon destiny draws. Lost if your [Virtual Block 4] objective on table. (Immune to Alter.)

title: Geonosis: Separatist Council Room
gameText: Dark: May deploy Gunray from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While two senators here, they may use their game text as if in a senate majority. Light: While Gunray or opponent's senator here, your spies may not deploy here.
locationDarkSideGameText: May deploy Gunray from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While two senators here, they may use their game text as if in a senate majority.
locationLightSideGameText: While Gunray or opponent's senator here, your spies may not deploy here.

title: Republic At War
gameText: Republic At War: Deploy Forward Command Center and Begun, The Clone War Has. For remainder of game, Rebels and Rebel starships are lost. You may forfeit non-lightsaber weapons (using forfeit value = 3); place your just forfeited weapon in Used Pile. Your Destiny is suspended. You lose no Force to Vengeance Of The Dark Prince. While this side up, once per turn, may deploy an [Episode I] battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if a complete [Clone Army] Mission on table. Aggressive Negotiations: Immediately, may place X cards from hand on bottom of Force Pile to draw up to X+1 cards from Reserve Deck once per game. While this side up, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take a [Clone Army] character, starship or vehicle into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your total power in battles is +Y, and whenever you win a battle, retrieve up to Y Force, where Y = the number of complete [Clone Army] Missions on table. Flip this card if no complete [Clone Army] Missions on table.

title: Arcona
lore: Unut Poll is a typical male Arcona. Unlike many other Arcona, he has avoided salt. Scout known to cooperate with Alliance operatives.
gameText: Power +1 under 'nighttime conditions.' May move away from a battle at same site as a 'react.'

title: Hunchback
lore: What hump?
gameText: On a hunch, if opponent just initiated a Force drain at an adjacent site, you may use 1 Force to search opponent's Force Pile and place out of play one card there that has 'back' in the title; reshuffle.

title: R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix)
lore: R3 units have larger memory and more advanced circuitry than their R1 predecessors, allowing for more efficient astrogation plots. R3-T6 served on the Death Star.
gameText: While aboard your capital starship, adds 1 to power and 2 to hyperspeed, and that starship is immune to attrition < 4. While at Death Star: Central Core, hyperspeed of Death Star system = 2.

title: R5-A2 (Arfive-Aytoo)
lore: Seldom used for navigation purposes, R5 units are known for their ability to perform hull maintenance and repair damage caused by ionization.
gameText: While aboard any starship, adds 1 to power and maneuver. During your control phase, if aboard your starship damaged by an Ion cannon, restores armor/maneuver and hyperspeed.

title: Reegesk
lore: Ranat thief and scavenger from Aralia. Regularly trades with Jawas. Adept at pilfering items without alerting the owner. Willing to steal anything, even trash.
gameText: Once during each of your control phases, may lose 1 Force to take one vehicle, droid, weapon or device from opponent's Lost Pile or Crash Site Memorial into hand to use as your own.

title: Reserve Pilot
lore: Injuries kept Lord Vader's best TIE wingman out of the primary wave of starfighters. He remains on reserve duty, ready to replace lost pilots.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 2, Black 3 or Black 4, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

title: Rodian
lore: Thuku is a typical male Rodian. Sent to hunt down Greedo by Navik the Red, head of the Chattza tribe. Rodians enjoy 'the hunt,' so many are employed as assassins.
gameText: Adds 1 to power of each of your bounty hunters and smugglers (but subtracts 1 from Greedo's power) at same site. Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots.

title: Tech Mo'r
lore: Male Bith musician. Plays Ommni Box in Figrin D'an's band. Lost ownership of instrument to Figrin while gambling.
gameText: After using Ommni Box, peek at top X cards of pile or deck just shuffled, where X = number of other musicians at same site. May reshuffle without peeking.

title: Trooper Davin Felth
lore: Dispatched to Tatooine to apprehend renegade droids fleeing the Tantive IV. Suspected to have misgivings about Imperial methods. Allegedly shot his commander in the back.
gameText: While on Tatooine, Local Trouble and Look Sir, Droids are Used Interrupts. Opponent may select target when using Friendly Fire at same site as Felth.

title: U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)
lore: This protocol droid served in the House of Alderaan's Diplomatic Corps. Imperials altered its programming for espionage, making the droid an unwitting spy for the Empire.
gameText: Deploys only to a site as an Undercover spy. If Undercover at a battle, adds his power to Light Side. If U-3PO just had his 'cover broken,' Light Side may steal him.

title: URoRRuR'R'R
lore: Leader of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. Skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes in search of unwary travelers.
gameText: Deploys only on Tatooine. When at same site as another Tusken Raider, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

title: WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid
lore: Multi-armed maintenance droid fiercely loyal to the Empire. Specializes in extending effective operational life of Imperial resources. Nicknamed for an insect from Eriadu.
gameText: * Forfeit value begins at 7. When 'forfeited,' droid remains in play (unless 'hit'), but forfeit value is reduced by the amount of attrition or battle damage absorbed. Droid lost when forfeit value reaches zero.

title: Ickabel G'ont
lore: Male Bith musician. His favorite cantina song is 'Tears of Aquanna' (mainly because it features him on Fanfar).
gameText: Opponent must use X Force when Force draining at any adjacent site, where X = the number of other musicians present with Ickabel.

title: Dianoga
lore: 'Garbage squid' from Vodran's jungles. Changes color to match last meal. When unfed, turns transparent. Eats almost anything. Flexible eyestalk. 7 tentacles. Up to 6 meters long.
gameText: * Ferocity = (power/ferocity of last character or creature eaten) + destiny. Habitat: exterior Dagobah sites, Trash Compactor and Dark Waters.

title: Death Star Tractor Beam
lore: 'Why are we moving towards it?'
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on Docking Bay 327. At the end of a battle at Death Star system, may target an opponent's starship present (except a Mon Calamari star cruiser) using 2 Force. Draw two destiny. Target captured if total destiny > defense value.

title: Hypo
lore: Truth drugs like Bavo Six decrease resistance to interrogation. The enormous needle adds psychological pressure, facilitating the interrogation process.
gameText: Deploy on your IT-O. Once during each of your control phases, if present with a captive: You may ask one yes-or-no question about cards in opponent's hand. Opponent must answer truthfully or lose 1 Force. OR May add 1 to Force drain where present.

title: Laser Gate
lore: Security corridors are guarded by a grid of laser emplacements which can be activated upon demand to seal off sensitive areas from intrusion.
gameText: Deploy between any two interior mobile sites. To pass, a character must have (power + ability) > 4 or use a Lift Tube (all other vehicles are blocked). Laser Gate defense value = 3; may be targeted (as if a character) by a character weapon from either site.

title: Magnetic Suction Tube
lore: 'Slurp.'
gameText: Deploy on your Sandcrawler. Once during each of your control phases, may target one character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's ability, 'suck up' character (relocate to related interior Sandcrawler site or owner's Used Pile).

title: Tractor Beam
lore: Captures enemy vessels for boarding. When used in conjunction with an ion cannon, tractor beams can ensnare even the most maneuverable starships.
gameText: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Star Destroyer. At the end of a battle at same system or sector, may target an opponent's starship present (except a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser) using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Target captured if destiny > defense value.

title: Astromech Shortage
lore: Imperial pilots often target astromech aboard Rebel starfighters in an attempt to prevent hyper-escapes. Scarcity of undamaged astromechs can delay starfighter deployment.
gameText: Use 3 Force to deploy on opponent's side of table. All opponent's starships with a [Nav Computer] icon are deploy +1.

title: Besieged
